company.name: SMBC
company.description: Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (SMBC) is a major Japanese bank and part of the SMBC Group, offering a broad range of corporate, investment, and retail banking services. Headquartered in Tokyo, SMBC has a global presence, particularly in Asia, the Americas, and EMEA. The bank provides services in project finance, trade finance, syndicated lending, and capital markets, with a strong reputation in infrastructure and energy financing. It works with multinational corporates, financial institutions, and public sector entities, and has expanded its footprint in sustainable finance, ESG advisory, and cross-border investment solutions.

company.name: M&T Bank
company.description: M&T Bank is a diversified financial services company providing commercial and retail banking, trust services, and investment management. Founded in 1856 and headquartered in Buffalo, New York, the bank operates a broad network of branches and automated teller machines across the northeastern and mid-Atlantic regions of the United States. M&T Bank is recognized for its conservative approach to lending and its focus on community based banking. It offers a comprehensive suite of financial products to individuals, businesses, and institutional clients while emphasizing long term customer relationships and operational stability.

company.name: Huntington National Bank
company.description: Huntington National Bank is a regional bank holding company providing a full range of financial services to individuals, small businesses, and commercial clients. Founded in 1866 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, the bank operates across several Midwestern states. Huntington offers consumer and business banking, mortgage lending, wealth management, and corporate banking solutions. It is known for its customer service, community involvement, and focus on relationship banking within its geographic footprint. The bank emphasizes personalized financial guidance and comprehensive support for its diverse client base.

company.name: Voloridge Investment Management
company.description: Voloridge is a Florida-based quantitative hedge fund that applies machine learning and data science to develop systematic trading strategies. The firm trades across global markets using predictive models informed by large and diverse datasets, with a strong emphasis on research, iteration, and data-driven decision-making. Voloridge manages capital for institutional clients and is known for its low-profile, technology-intensive approach to alpha generation. The firm is also active in sustainable investing and climate-focused initiatives, both within and beyond its investment strategies.

company.name: Capital One
company.description: Capital One is a US-based financial services company offering credit cards, retail banking, auto loans, and commercial lending. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, it is one of the largest banks in the United States by assets and a major player in the credit card market. Founded in 1994, Capital One is known for its strong technology orientation and early adoption of digital banking. The firm serves both consumers and businesses, and has invested heavily in data, AI, and cybersecurity to modernise financial services delivery.

company.name: Castleton Commodities International
company.description: Castleton Commodities International (CCI) is a global trading and investment firm focused on energy and commodities markets. Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, CCI trades physical and financial products across oil, natural gas, power, and metals. The firm also owns and operates energy infrastructure, including storage, transportation, and processing assets. CCI blends proprietary trading with strategic asset investment, and is known for its expertise in market fundamentals, logistics, and supply chain optimisation.

company.name: Armanino
company.description: Armanino is a US-based accounting and consulting firm providing audit, tax, and advisory services to clients ranging from early-stage companies to established enterprises. Headquartered in California, it has grown into one of the top independent firms in the country, with particular strength in technology, nonprofit, and cannabis sectors. Armanino also offers consulting in areas like digital transformation, M&A, and ESG strategy, supporting businesses through periods of change and growth. It blends traditional financial services with forward-thinking advisory work.

company.name: Capital Group
company.description: Capital Group is one of the world’s largest investment management firms, known for its long-term, research-driven approach to active investing. Founded in 1931 and headquartered in Los Angeles, it manages equity, fixed income, and multi-asset strategies for individuals and institutions globally. The firm is best known for the American Funds range and its unique multimanager system, which blends different investment styles within a single portfolio. Capital Group operates with a strong focus on governance, investor outcomes, and consistency over market cycles.

company.name: KWC CPAs
company.description: KWC CPAs is a certified public accounting firm, offering a comprehensive range of services including tax planning and compliance, audit and assurance, and business consulting. Founded in 1983 and based in Alexandria, Virginia, the firm serves businesses of all sizes, non-profit organizations, and high net worth individuals. KWC CPAs is known for its personalized approach, deep expertise across various industries, and commitment to delivering practical, strategic financial guidance. The firm combines a strong understanding of client needs with proactive solutions to help achieve specific financial goals and ensure compliance.

company.name: Morningstar
company.description: Morningstar is a prominent financial services firm that provides investment research, investment management, and data analytics. Founded in 1984 and based in Chicago, the company serves individual investors, financial advisors, and institutional clients through its suite of software and research platforms. It is widely recognized for its proprietary star rating system for mutual funds and exchange traded funds. Morningstar focuses on independent analysis and transparent data to help investors make informed decisions across global financial markets.

company.name: D.E. Shaw
company.description: The D.E. Shaw Group is a global investment and technology development firm known for its quantitative and discretionary investment strategies. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in New York, it manages capital across hedge fund, private credit, and venture strategies for institutional investors. D.E. Shaw combines advanced mathematical modelling, data science, and proprietary technology in its investment approach, and attracts talent from both financial and scientific backgrounds. The firm is one of the most prominent quantitative hedge funds in the industry.

company.name: Q Advisors
company.description: Q Advisors is a boutique investment bank headquartered in Denver and San Francisco, specialising in M&A and capital raising for technology, telecoms, and software companies. The firm serves growth-stage businesses and private equity sponsors, advising on sell-side and buy-side transactions, recapitalisations, and strategic partnerships. With deep sector knowledge and a strong international network, Q Advisors frequently works on cross-border deals and emerging tech verticals such as SaaS, IoT, and cybersecurity. It is known for its tailored, partner-led execution and for advising companies at critical inflection points in their growth and funding cycles.

company.name: LionTree
company.description: LionTree is a global investment and merchant banking firm headquartered in New York, specialising in the technology, media, and telecommunications (TMT) sectors. The firm advises corporates, entrepreneurs, and private equity sponsors on M&A, capital raising, and strategic partnerships, and is known for its deep industry relationships and thematic insight into digital transformation. LionTree has worked on some of the most high-profile TMT transactions in recent years, and also operates a merchant banking arm that invests directly in clients and sector opportunities. The firm is recognised for its relationship-driven model, long-term advisory approach, and thought leadership, including its Kindred Media platform. With offices in New York, San Francisco, London, and Paris, LionTree plays a significant role in shaping strategy and capital flows in the global media and tech ecosystem.

company.name: Wedbush Securities
company.description: Wedbush Securities is a financial services and investment firm providing services for private and institutional clients. Founded in 1955 and headquartered in Los Angeles, the firm offers wealth management, investment banking, and trading services. Wedbush focuses on emerging growth companies and special situations. It is known for its equity research, particularly in the technology and consumer sectors, and operates a network of retail brokerage offices across the United States.

company.name: Shea & Company
company.description: Shea & Company is a boutique investment bank headquartered in Boston, focused exclusively on software and technology M&A. The firm advises private and public software companies, as well as private equity investors, on buy-side and sell-side transactions. With a research-driven approach and deep sector expertise, Shea & Company often supports vertical and horizontal consolidation plays, growth equity deals, and strategic exits. Its team is known for its disciplined execution and long-term client relationships, operating across enterprise software segments such as SaaS, infrastructure, security, and analytics.

company.name: Koch
company.description: Koch Industries is one of the world’s largest privately held conglomerates, with operations spanning manufacturing, refining, chemicals, electronics, and enterprise software. Founded in 1940 and based in Wichita, Kansas, the company oversees a diverse portfolio of major businesses including Georgia-Pacific, Molex, and Infor. Koch is known for its immense scale, long-term investment horizon, and its proprietary management philosophy. It combines continuous capital reinvestment with broad operational capabilities and has a track record of driving efficiency and growth across foundational global industries.

company.name: BDO Global
company.description: BDO Global is a network of independent accounting and advisory firms operating in more than 160 countries. The organisation offers audit, tax, advisory, and business services to clients ranging from startups to large corporates and public sector bodies. Founded in 1963, BDO has grown to become one of the largest professional services networks in the world. Its member firms are locally rooted but aligned under shared values and international quality standards, enabling cross-border support for clients navigating global financial, operational, and regulatory challenges.

company.name: Oak Hill Advisors
company.description: Oak Hill Advisors is a US-based alternative investment firm focused on credit markets, including high-yield bonds, leveraged loans, structured credit, and distressed debt. Headquartered in New York, the firm manages capital on behalf of institutional investors across a range of strategies in both public and private credit. Oak Hill is known for its deep credit research and focus on complex capital structures, often investing in companies undergoing transitions or special situations. The firm became part of T. Rowe Price in 2021, expanding its reach and scale in private credit while maintaining investment independence.

company.name: Invesco
company.description: Invesco is a global independent investment management firm headquartered in Atlanta, managing over $1.4 trillion in assets across equity, fixed income, alternatives, and multi-asset strategies. With offices in more than 20 countries, the firm serves institutional clients, financial intermediaries, and retail investors through a diverse set of investment vehicles, including ETFs, mutual funds, and private market solutions. Invesco owns well-known brands such as Invesco QQQ, Perpetual (in the UK), and Invesco Real Estate, and offers ESG-integrated and thematic strategies tailored to evolving investor preferences. The firm is known for combining local investment expertise with a global distribution platform, and it places a strong focus on technology-enabled client experience, active stewardship, and product innovation. Invesco has a broad client base and continues to grow its presence in retirement, wealth, and institutional markets.

company.name: William Blair
company.description: William Blair is a global investment banking and asset management firm headquartered in Chicago, with offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. The firm offers advisory services in mergers and acquisitions, equity and debt capital markets, and private capital raising, particularly for mid-market and high-growth companies. William Blair also provides active investment management across equities, fixed income, and multi-asset strategies for institutions, intermediaries, and individuals. The firm is known for its research-driven approach, sector-focused teams, and client-first culture. In banking, it is especially active in healthcare, technology, and industrials, often working with private equity sponsors and founder-led businesses.

company.name: Dodge & Cox
company.description: Dodge & Cox is a long-established investment management firm based in San Francisco, known for its disciplined, value-driven approach to equity and fixed income investing. Founded in 1930, the firm offers a suite of mutual funds and separately managed accounts for institutions and individuals. Dodge & Cox maintains a low-cost structure, long-term horizon, and collaborative research process that focuses on identifying fundamentally strong companies trading at attractive valuations. The firm is employee-owned and maintains high client alignment and stability.

company.name: Affinius Capital
company.description: Affinius Capital is a prominent investment manager focused on commercial real estate equity and debt. Formed in 2022 by the merger of USAA Real Estate and Square Mile Capital, the firm is based in New York and San Antonio. It manages capital for institutional investors, high net worth individuals, and family offices across a broad range of investment strategies. Affinius Capital is known for its deep sector expertise, integrated platform, and comprehensive suite of solutions across various property types. The firm combines a strong understanding of market fundamentals with robust underwriting to deliver value and build long term relationships.

company.name: RBC Capital Markets
company.description: RBC Capital Markets is the investment banking arm of the Royal Bank of Canada, offering a full range of capital markets, advisory, and trading services to corporate, institutional, and government clients globally. Headquartered in Toronto with major offices in New York and London, the firm advises on M&A, IPOs, debt issuance, and risk management across sectors including energy, healthcare, infrastructure, and financial services. RBC Capital Markets is also a significant player in fixed income and equities trading, supported by strong research and global execution capabilities. It maintains a top-tier position in Canada and a growing presence in US and European markets.

company.name: AQ Technology Partners
company.description: AQ Technology Partners is a specialist advisory firm focused on M&A and strategic transactions in the software, data, and technology sectors. Headquartered in San Francisco, the firm supports high-growth and founder-led companies through sell-side and capital raise processes. AQ works closely with entrepreneurs and investors in sectors like SaaS, fintech, and data infrastructure, offering deep sector insight and deal execution expertise.

company.name: State Street
company.description: State Street Corporation is a US-based financial services firm providing custody, investment servicing, asset management, and data analytics to institutional investors worldwide. Headquartered in Boston, State Street is one of the world’s largest custodians, with over $40 trillion in assets under custody and administration. Its investment arm, State Street Global Advisors, is a major passive asset manager and the creator of the SPDR ETF family. The firm also offers technology and data services through State Street Alpha, supporting asset managers and owners with front-to-back investment lifecycle tools. State Street plays a central role in financial infrastructure, particularly for pensions, sovereign wealth funds, and asset managers.

company.name: Bracebridge Capital
company.description: Bracebridge Capital is a Boston-based hedge fund that manages assets for endowments, foundations, and other institutional clients. Founded in 1994 by Nancy Zimmerman, the firm is known for its conservative, risk-aware investment approach and its focus on absolute return strategies. Bracebridge invests across fixed income, sovereign debt, derivatives, and event-driven strategies, with a strong emphasis on liquidity and downside protection. It maintains a low profile in the industry but is considered one of the most consistent performers in the alternative asset management space.

company.name: Musket
company.description: Musket Corporation is a privately held trading and logistics company based in Houston, Texas, focused on petroleum products, natural gas liquids (NGLs), biofuels, and renewable fuels. It is part of the Love’s Family of Companies and serves refiners, retailers, and commercial consumers through a combination of wholesale supply, risk management, and logistics coordination. Musket leverages its access to storage, transport, and distribution infrastructure to manage price volatility and supply chain complexity for its clients. It is active in environmental fuel credits and sustainability-linked fuels and continues to expand its reach in renewable energy markets. The firm plays a niche yet influential role in North American energy trading.

company.name: Connor Group
company.description: Connor Group is a professional services firm focused on financial consulting for high-growth and pre-IPO companies. Based in California, the firm advises on technical accounting, IPO readiness, finance transformation, and transaction support. Its clients range from venture-backed startups to Fortune 500 companies, particularly in technology, life sciences, and consumer industries. Connor Group is known for helping companies navigate rapid growth and public market transitions with deep expertise in complex accounting standards and operational scaling.

company.name: Blue Owl Capital
company.description: Blue Owl Capital is a leading alternative asset manager, specializing in direct lending, GP capital solutions, and real estate. Formed in 2021 and based in New York, the firm provides capital solutions to private companies and institutional investors. Blue Owl is known for its permanent capital base, partnership approach, and expertise across various private market strategies. It focuses on delivering stable income and long term capital appreciation by investing in resilient businesses and providing strategic financing to general partners.

company.name: Two Sigma
company.description: Two Sigma is a US-based quantitative investment firm that applies data science, machine learning, and advanced computing to manage capital across a wide range of strategies. Headquartered in New York, it runs hedge funds and private investment strategies across equities, macro, and venture capital. Two Sigma employs large-scale data infrastructure and algorithmic models to identify patterns and pricing anomalies in global markets. The firm also invests in financial technology through Two Sigma Ventures and operates a scientific research culture that blends academic rigour with commercial application.

programmes.name: Insights Day & 2028 Investment Banking Internship Program

company.name: Scotiabank
company.description: Scotiabank (The Bank of Nova Scotia) is one of Canada’s Big Five banks and a major financial institution across the Americas. Headquartered in Toronto, it offers retail banking, commercial lending, wealth management, and capital markets services to individuals and institutions. Scotiabank has a strong international footprint, particularly in Latin America and the Caribbean, where it operates under its “International Banking” division. Its global banking and markets arm provides M&A advisory, fixed income, equities, and FX trading. Known for its emerging markets exposure and bilingual North American-LATAM coverage, Scotiabank is focused on digital transformation, inclusion, and sustainable finance.

company.name: BST
company.description: BST & Co. is a US-based accounting and advisory firm headquartered in Albany, New York, offering audit, tax, and consulting services to individuals, businesses, and nonprofit organisations. The firm serves clients across a variety of sectors including healthcare, manufacturing, construction, and professional services. In addition to traditional accounting, BST provides specialised services in areas such as valuation, forensic accounting, cybersecurity, HR consulting, and outsourced CFO support. The firm places a strong emphasis on personalised service and long-term client relationships, combining technical expertise with strategic insight to support business growth and financial well-being. Its regional presence and multi-disciplinary capabilities make it a key advisor to privately held businesses in the Northeastern United States.

company.name: Solomon Partners
company.description: Solomon Partners is a US-based investment bank headquartered in New York, known for its advisory work in M&A and restructuring across sectors such as retail, healthcare, technology, media, and industrials. Originally founded in 1989, the firm became an affiliate of Natixis in 2016, expanding its global reach and sector capabilities. Solomon Partners is recognised for its senior-led execution, deep industry expertise, and close client relationships, often advising on complex, high-stakes transactions in competitive sectors. The firm focuses exclusively on advisory, with no lending or trading activity, ensuring an independent approach to dealmaking.

company.name: SouthState Bank
company.description: SouthState Bank is a regional financial institution providing a range of banking, investment, and mortgage services to individuals and businesses. Founded in 1934 and headquartered in Winter Haven, Florida, the bank operates a significant network of branches across the southeastern United States. It focuses on relationship based community banking while leveraging modern technology to serve a diverse client base. SouthState Bank is recognized for its strategy of growth through strategic acquisitions and its commitment to supporting local economic development within its regional markets.

company.name: Pinion
company.description: Pinion is a US-based agricultural consulting and accounting firm offering integrated services to agribusinesses, family farms, and food system enterprises. The firm provides financial planning, tax strategy, estate planning, and business advisory tailored to the needs of producers, landowners, and agri-cooperatives. Pinion also supports clients in succession planning, sustainability reporting, and technology adoption. With offices across rural and agricultural regions of the US, Pinion combines technical accounting with deep industry knowledge, helping clients make informed decisions across volatile commodity and policy environments. Its work spans both traditional farming and increasingly complex agrifood ecosystems.

company.name: Alvarez & Marsal
company.description: Alvarez & Marsal is an international professional services firm that advises businesses on operational, financial, and strategic change. It was founded in 1983 and is widely known for its work in restructuring, having led major corporate recovery efforts globally. Over time, the firm expanded its scope to include transaction advisory, regulatory consulting, tax services, and more. It works with corporates, private equity firms, and public institutions, often in situations where stakes are high and change needs to happen quickly.

company.name: Chartwell Financial Advisory
company.description: Chartwell Financial Advisory is a boutique investment banking firm that provides corporate finance services to middle market companies. Based in Minneapolis and founded in 1995, the firm specializes in mergers and acquisitions, private placement of debt and equity, and business valuations. Chartwell is known for its expertise in advising employee stock ownership plans and helping family owned businesses navigate complex ownership transitions. It focuses on providing independent financial advice and strategic planning to support long term growth and liquidity objectives for its clients.

company.name: PGIM
company.description: PGIM is the global investment management business of Prudential Financial, managing more than $1.2 trillion in assets across public and private markets. Headquartered in Newark, New Jersey, PGIM operates through specialised affiliates including PGIM Fixed Income, PGIM Real Estate, and Jennison Associates, each with its own investment expertise. The firm serves institutional and retail clients worldwide, offering strategies in fixed income, equities, real estate, private credit, and alternatives. PGIM is known for its scale, long-term thinking, and research-led approach to managing portfolios in both traditional and less liquid markets.

company.name: Sweeney Conrad
company.description: Sweeney Conrad is a prominent accounting and consulting firm based in Bellevue, Washington. Founded in 1980, the company provides tax, audit, and business advisory services to privately held businesses and high net worth individuals. The firm is known for its focus on the Pacific Northwest market and its commitment to a personalized approach for clients in industries like real estate, construction, and professional services. It combines technical expertise with a strong emphasis on long term relationship building and community involvement.

company.name: Rabobank
company.description: Rabobank is a Dutch multinational cooperative bank headquartered in Utrecht, known for its strong roots in agriculture and food finance. Founded in 1972 through the merger of two farmer-founded credit unions, the bank has grown into a global financial institution operating in over 35 countries, with a strong retail presence in the Netherlands and a specialised focus on agribusiness internationally. Rabobank provides a broad range of services including retail and commercial banking, leasing, asset management, and trade finance. As a cooperative, it emphasises sustainability, member engagement, and long-term value creation, and remains a key player in financing food production and rural development across the globe.

company.name: Columbia Threadneedle Investments
company.description: Columbia Threadneedle Investments is a global asset management firm offering active investment strategies across equities, fixed income, alternatives, and multi-asset portfolios. Headquartered in Boston and London, the firm is part of Ameriprise Financial and manages capital for individual, institutional, and intermediary clients. Columbia Threadneedle combines fundamental research with a global investment platform, and has a strong emphasis on ESG integration and responsible investing. Its client base spans Europe, North America, and Asia.

company.name: Tidal Partners
company.description: Tidal Partners is a boutique investment bank focused exclusively on advising technology companies on strategic transactions. Founded by seasoned dealmakers from Goldman Sachs and other top firms, Tidal operates with a highly selective client base, advising on M&A and capital raises for growth-stage and large-cap tech businesses. The firm combines deep sector knowledge with a hands-on, relationship-driven model, and has quickly positioned itself as a trusted adviser in high-profile Silicon Valley dealmaking. Tidal is known for maintaining a low public profile while executing some of the most notable tech transactions in recent years.

company.name: NERA
company.description: NERA Economic Consulting is a global consultancy that provides expert economic analysis for legal, regulatory, and policy matters. Founded in 1961 and part of Marsh McLennan, the firm supports clients with litigation support, antitrust analysis, financial economics, and public policy evaluation. NERA’s economists often serve as expert witnesses in high-profile court cases and regulatory inquiries, applying quantitative methods to assess damages, competition effects, or market dynamics. It serves law firms, corporations, and governments, and is known for its deep academic expertise and rigorous analytical standards in complex, data-driven environments.

company.name: Santander
company.description: Banco Santander is a global banking group headquartered in Spain, with a strong presence in Europe, Latin America, and the US. It offers a broad range of retail, commercial, and investment banking services, serving individuals, SMEs, corporates, and institutions. Santander is one of the largest banks in the eurozone by market capitalisation and assets, with major operations in markets like Brazil, Spain, the UK, and Mexico. The bank is focused on digitalisation, efficiency, and inclusive banking, and is investing heavily in fintech, sustainability, and global transaction services. It operates both through local brands and its unified global platform.

company.name: The Carlyle Group
company.description: The Carlyle Group is a global investment firm managing a broad range of private capital strategies, including private equity, real estate, infrastructure, credit, and secondaries. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., the firm has more than $370 billion in assets under management and operates across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. Carlyle invests in sectors such as healthcare, technology, consumer, and aerospace, often partnering closely with management to drive growth and transformation. Known for its global reach and strong fundraising capabilities, Carlyle serves a wide range of institutional investors, sovereign wealth funds, and pensions.

company.name: U.S. Bank
company.description: U.S. Bank is the fifth largest banking institution in the United States, providing a comprehensive range of financial services including retail banking, commercial lending, wealth management, and payment processing. Headquartered in Minneapolis and established in 1863, the bank serves millions of customers through an extensive network of physical branches and digital platforms. It is recognized for its stable balance sheet, focus on consumer banking innovation, and long standing presence in the domestic market. The firm prioritizes technology integration and customer experience while maintaining a diversified business model that spans both retail and institutional client bases.

company.name: McKinsey & Company
company.description: McKinsey & Company is a global management consulting firm known for advising senior executives, governments, and institutions on strategy, operations, and organisational performance. Founded in 1926 and headquartered in New York, McKinsey operates in more than 65 countries and serves clients across every major industry. The firm is widely recognised for its rigorous problem-solving approach, strong alumni network, and influence in shaping global corporate and public policy. McKinsey also invests in proprietary research, digital tools, and analytics, and has expanded its offerings in implementation, design, and AI-driven transformation. Its influence has made it both highly respected and occasionally controversial, particularly in public-sector advisory. Nonetheless, McKinsey remains a preeminent name in strategic consulting.

company.name: CohnReznick
company.description: CohnReznick is one of the largest advisory, assurance, and tax firms in the United States, offering a comprehensive suite of services. The firm provides audit, tax, and consulting solutions to businesses of all sizes, from emerging companies to large enterprises. CohnReznick serves a diverse range of industries, including real estate, private equity, healthcare, technology, and not for profit. It is known for its specialized industry knowledge, client centric approach, and integrated services designed to help clients navigate complex financial and operational challenges. The firm focuses on delivering strategic insights and practical advice to drive sustainable growth.

company.name: Aldrich
company.description: Aldrich is a leading West Coast professional services firm, specializing in accounting, tax, wealth advisory, and business consulting. Founded in 1973 and headquartered in Oregon, the firm serves closely held businesses, non-profit organizations, and individual clients across industries such as healthcare, construction, and agribusiness. Aldrich is known for its regional expertise, relationship-driven approach, and ability to navigate complex financial and regulatory environments. It combines technical proficiency with strategic insight to help organizations optimize operations, preserve wealth, and achieve long-term growth.

company.name: Akuna Capital
company.description: Akuna Capital is a proprietary trading firm that focuses on derivatives market making and quantitative trading strategies. Launched in 2011 in Chicago, it leverages in-house technology and data-driven models to trade a range of financial instruments. The firm has expanded globally, with offices in Sydney, Shanghai, and additional locations in the US.

company.name: PNC
company.description: PNC Financial Services is a diversified financial services institution headquartered in the United States, providing a broad range of banking, asset management, and corporate finance services to individuals, small businesses, and large corporates. The firm operates through key segments including retail banking, corporate and institutional banking, and asset management, offering products such as lending, treasury management, capital markets advisory, and investment services. PNC serves clients across various industries, supporting activities such as day-to-day banking, expansion financing, and strategic transactions, and is known for its strong regional presence, disciplined risk management, and focus on long-term client relationships.

company.name: T. Rowe Price
company.description: T. Rowe Price is a global asset management firm based in Baltimore, known for active investment management across equities, fixed income, multi-asset, and alternatives. It manages capital for institutional and individual investors worldwide, with a long-term, research-driven approach. T. Rowe Price is recognised for its internal research, low turnover, and client alignment, and remains independent and publicly traded. The firm also provides retirement planning and advisory services, and has expanded its presence in ESG and global equities through new fund offerings and regional growth.

company.name: Regions Bank
company.description: Regions Bank is a Birmingham, Alabama–based regional bank offering a full suite of financial services—including personal and commercial banking, wealth management, mortgage lending, and capital markets—across the Southeast and Midwest. Founded in 1971 through the merger of several community banks, Regions combines local expertise with modern capabilities to serve both individual clients and businesses, supporting community development and economic growth.

company.name: PEAK6
company.description: PEAK6 is a financial services and investment firm that focuses on options trading, proprietary technology, and strategic investments. Founded in 1997 and based in Chicago, the firm utilizes advanced quantitative models and proprietary software to provide liquidity and manage risk across global capital markets. PEAK6 operates across several sectors, including financial technology, insurance, and sports management. The firm is known for its data driven approach to decision making and its history of fostering innovation by integrating technology into diverse business lines to create competitive advantages.

company.name: Jump Trading
company.description: Jump Trading is a proprietary trading firm and technology company based in Chicago, known for its expertise in algorithmic and high-frequency trading across global financial markets. Founded in 1999, the firm trades a broad range of asset classes including equities, fixed income, futures, options, and cryptocurrencies, operating on over 100 exchanges worldwide. Jump places a strong emphasis on quantitative research, advanced hardware and software development, and low-latency infrastructure, competing with firms such as DRW, Citadel Securities, and Jane Street. It is also involved in crypto through Jump Crypto, a dedicated division focused on trading, venture investments, and protocol development. The firm is privately held and secretive, known for its flat structure, highly selective hiring, and deep investment in proprietary technology and applied science.

company.name: AQR Capital Management
company.description: AQR Capital Management is a global investment management firm known for its quantitative, research-driven approach to asset management. Founded in 1998 and headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, AQR applies academic and data-intensive methods to invest across a range of asset classes including equities, fixed income, commodities, and alternative strategies. The firm serves institutional investors, financial advisors, and sovereign wealth funds worldwide. AQR is particularly recognized for its expertise in factor investing, risk premia strategies, and portfolio construction techniques rooted in financial economics. With a strong emphasis on transparency and systematic investing, AQR maintains close ties to academic research and regularly publishes white papers and thought leadership. The firm operates offices in London, Hong Kong, and Sydney, and is known for its rigorous intellectual culture, long-term perspective, and disciplined risk management.

company.name: Withum
company.description: Withum is a premier advisory and accounting firm providing audit, tax, and consulting services to businesses and individuals. Founded in 1974 and headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, the firm serves a diverse range of industries including technology, life sciences, and professional services. Withum is recognized for its collaborative culture and commitment to innovation as it helps clients navigate complex financial landscapes. The company emphasizes a client-centric approach by delivering personalized solutions through its network of offices and international reach.

company.name: Rockefeller Capital Management
company.description: Rockefeller Capital Management is a US-based financial advisory and investment firm serving ultra-high-net-worth individuals, family offices, and institutions. Originally part of the Rockefeller family office, the firm relaunched in 2018 as an independent entity offering private wealth management, asset management, strategic advisory, and family office services. It combines traditional financial planning with institutional-grade investment access, focusing on long-term stewardship and multi-generational wealth. Rockefeller Capital Management also emphasises sustainability, philanthropy, and impact investing as part of its holistic client offering, operating with a boutique model supported by national scale.

company.name: D.E. Shaw
company.description: The D.E. Shaw Group is a global investment and technology development firm known for its quantitative and discretionary investment strategies. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in New York, it manages capital across hedge fund, private credit, and venture strategies for institutional investors. D.E. Shaw combines advanced mathematical modelling, data science, and proprietary technology in its investment approach, and attracts talent from both financial and scientific backgrounds. The firm is one of the most prominent quantitative hedge funds in the industry.

company.name: Lead Edge Capital
company.description: Lead Edge Capital is a US-based growth equity firm that invests in technology-enabled businesses globally, with a focus on consumer internet, enterprise software, and digital infrastructure. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in New York, the firm has backed companies such as Alibaba, Spotify, Uber, Toast, and BlaBlaCar. Lead Edge is known for its network-driven investment model, leveraging a large group of operators, executives, and investors to source deals and support portfolio companies. The firm typically invests at the growth stage but maintains a flexible approach to deal structure and size. With a reputation for founder-friendly capital and active post-investment support, Lead Edge plays an influential role in helping high-growth businesses scale operations and expand into global markets.

company.name: Citizens Financial Group
company.description: Citizens Financial Group is one of the oldest and largest financial institutions in the United States, offering a full range of retail and commercial banking services. Founded in 1828 and based in Providence, Rhode Island, the company serves individuals, small businesses, mid-market companies, and large corporations. Citizens is known for its strong presence across the New England, Mid-Atlantic, and Midwest regions, providing deposit products, lending solutions, and wealth management services. It focuses on building deep customer relationships and delivering personalized financial advice through its extensive branch network and digital channels.

company.name: Vista Equity Partners
company.description: Vista Equity Partners is a US-based private equity firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Vista manages a large portfolio of companies through its flagship private equity, credit, and permanent capital strategies. The firm is known for its operational playbook and active approach to scaling B2B software businesses. Vista partners with management teams to accelerate growth, improve efficiency, and drive product innovation, and is considered one of the leading tech-focused investment firms globally.

company.name: Scotiabank
company.description: Scotiabank (The Bank of Nova Scotia) is one of Canada’s Big Five banks and a major financial institution across the Americas. Headquartered in Toronto, it offers retail banking, commercial lending, wealth management, and capital markets services to individuals and institutions. Scotiabank has a strong international footprint, particularly in Latin America and the Caribbean, where it operates under its “International Banking” division. Its global banking and markets arm provides M&A advisory, fixed income, equities, and FX trading. Known for its emerging markets exposure and bilingual North American-LATAM coverage, Scotiabank is focused on digital transformation, inclusion, and sustainable finance.

company.name: AllianceBernstein
company.description: AllianceBernstein (AB) is a global investment management and research firm offering a broad range of actively managed investment strategies across equities, fixed income, multi-asset, and alternative asset classes. Headquartered in Nashville with a global presence in key financial centers including New York, London, Hong Kong, and Tokyo, AB serves institutional, retail, and high-net-worth clients in over 25 countries. The firm is known for its deep fundamental research, forward-looking macroeconomic analysis, and integrated ESG framework. AllianceBernstein combines active portfolio management with data science and proprietary research to deliver long-term, risk-adjusted returns. With a strong emphasis on innovation, transparency, and client partnership, AB continues to expand its capabilities across private alternatives, responsible investing, and next-generation financial technologies.

company.name: AlixPartners
company.description: AlixPartners is a global consulting firm known for its work in corporate turnarounds, restructuring, and performance improvement. Founded in 1981 in the United States, it initially focused on helping distressed companies navigate financial crises. Today, the firm advises businesses across industries on urgent, high-stakes challenges, including operational transformation, digital strategy, and litigation support.

company.name: General Atlantic
company.description: General Atlantic is a leading global growth equity firm that partners with high-growth companies across technology, consumer, healthcare, and financial services. Founded in 1980 and headquartered in New York, the firm manages over $70 billion in assets and operates with a long-term, research-driven investment approach. General Atlantic typically invests in later-stage growth companies with strong competitive positioning, helping them scale through strategic guidance, international expansion, and operational support. The firm is known for backing category leaders such as ByteDance, Duolingo, Slack, and Klarna, and it often works closely with founders and CEOs as a hands-on minority investor. With a global presence spanning six continents, General Atlantic combines local insight with global connectivity and deep sector expertise to support innovation and sustainable growth.

company.name: Equinor
company.description: Equinor is one of Europe’s leading energy companies, specialising in oil and natural gas production, offshore wind, and low-carbon solutions. Founded in 1972 and based in Stavanger, Norway, the company operates internationally while serving as a critical energy supplier to European markets. Equinor is known for its offshore engineering expertise, massive operational scale, and proactive approach to the global energy transition. It combines decades of maritime resource development with expanding investments in renewables and has a track record of executing complex projects in harsh environments.

company.name: Guggenheim Partners
company.description: Guggenheim Partners is a diversified global financial services firm offering investment management, investment banking, and insurance services, with over $300 billion in assets under management. Headquartered in New York and Chicago, Guggenheim serves institutional clients including pension funds, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, and governments. It is particularly known for its strength in fixed income and structured credit, and for developing innovative solutions in areas like infrastructure financing and private placements. Its investment banking division, Guggenheim Securities, provides M&A and capital markets advisory with a strong presence in healthcare, tech, and media. The firm combines a long-term, research-led investment philosophy with a flexible capital approach, and continues to expand its reach into alternative investments and sustainable finance.

company.name: K1 Investment Management
company.description: K1 Investment Management is a private equity firm based in Los Angeles, focused exclusively on enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses. The firm targets growth-stage companies with recurring revenue and scalable platforms, providing capital and operational support to accelerate go-to-market expansion, product development, and strategic M&A. K1 is known for its high-volume deal flow and hands-on approach to portfolio management, including centralised support through its internal consulting team. It invests across North America and Europe, often working with founder-led businesses transitioning into institutional ownership. K1 has built a reputation for speed of execution, vertical specialisation, and strong track records in value creation across the B2B SaaS landscape.

company.name: BNP Paribas
company.description: BNP Paribas is one of Europe’s largest banking groups, providing retail, corporate, and investment banking services across more than 70 countries. Headquartered in Paris, it was formed through the merger of Banque Nationale de Paris and Paribas in 2000. The group operates with a strong presence in continental Europe while maintaining global capabilities in capital markets, financing, asset management, and insurance. BNP Paribas is also active in ESG financing and sustainable investment, aligning its services with global climate and development goals.

company.name: CMD Global Partners
company.description: CMD Global Partners is a boutique investment bank based in New York, specialising in capital markets advisory, debt restructuring, and liability management. The firm works with corporate issuers, private equity sponsors, and sovereigns on complex financial transactions, particularly in distressed or event-driven situations. CMD offers strategic advice on raising capital, optimising balance sheets, and navigating credit market dynamics. Its team brings deep expertise in structuring and negotiating bespoke capital solutions across both developed and emerging markets.

company.name: Capstone
company.description: Capstone Investment Advisors is a global alternative investment management firm, specialising in multi-strategy and volatility-driven trading solutions. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in New York, the firm manages capital on behalf of major institutional investors, including pension plans, endowments, and sovereign wealth funds. Capstone is known for its expertise in derivatives, risk management, and its ability to navigate complex market environments across global asset classes. It combines proprietary quantitative analytics with fundamental insights and has a track record of delivering asymmetric returns and portfolio diversification.

company.name: Access Holdings
company.description: Access Holdings is a US-based investment firm that partners with companies in high-growth, essential service industries. Founded in 2013 and based in Baltimore, the firm focuses on long-term value creation, working closely with management teams to scale operations and build lasting platforms. Its investments include businesses in healthcare, business services, and consumer sectors.

company.name: AlphaSights
company.description: AlphaSights is a global professional services firm that connects business leaders and investment professionals with industry experts to support decision-making through primary research. Headquartered in London, with offices in New York, Dubai, Hong Kong, and other major cities, the firm facilitates one-on-one consultations, expert interviews, and custom knowledge sourcing across virtually every industry. AlphaSights works with private equity firms, strategy consultancies, asset managers, and corporate clients, helping them access timely, specialised insights during due diligence, market entry, or strategic planning. It operates under strict compliance frameworks and is known for its fast-paced culture, client focus, and rapidly growing global footprint.

company.name: Ducera Partners
company.description: Ducera Partners is a boutique investment bank based in New York, focused on complex advisory assignments in restructuring, M&A, recapitalisation, and special situations. Founded in 2015 by senior dealmakers from top Wall Street firms, Ducera operates across sectors and capital structures, serving both companies and creditor groups. The firm is frequently retained for large Chapter 11 processes, liability management, and capital structure optimisation. Its approach is highly analytical, conflict-free, and senior-led.
