company.name: Ardea Partners
company.description: Ardea Partners is a private advisory firm that provides strategic financial advice to corporations, investors, and family offices. Founded in 2016 by former Goldman Sachs partners, the firm is based in New York and London, and operates with a model that avoids conflicts of interest by not managing capital or engaging in lending. Ardea advises on mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and capital structure planning, often working with clients over long time horizons. It is known for discretion, senior-level involvement, and complex cross-border work.

company.name: Capital Southwest
company.description: Capital Southwest is a publicly traded business development company (BDC) that provides financing solutions to middle market companies across the United States. Founded in 1961 and based in Dallas, Texas, the firm primarily invests in unitranche, first lien, and second lien debt, often alongside modest equity co-investments. Capital Southwest aims to generate both current income and capital appreciation for its shareholders through its diversified portfolio. It is known for its focus on growth oriented businesses and its disciplined approach to credit underwriting.

company.name: Greystar
company.description: Greystar is a global real estate investment, development, and property management firm focused on rental housing, with operations spanning the US, Europe, Latin America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, it manages hundreds of thousands of units across multifamily, student, and senior living sectors, and is one of the only firms globally to combine investment, development, and operations at scale. The company partners with institutional investors on build-to-rent strategies and urban regeneration projects, and has played a key role in the growth of the student accommodation sector in the UK and Europe. Greystar is also investing in sustainable design and smart building technologies, expanding its influence beyond traditional property models into long-term housing solutions aligned with demographic and urbanisation trends.

company.name: Maxwell Locke & Ritter
company.description: Maxwell Locke & Ritter is an independent accounting and advisory firm based in Austin, Texas, offering services in audit, tax, outsourced accounting, and transaction advisory. The firm specialises in serving privately held businesses, fast-growing startups, and high-net-worth individuals, particularly in sectors like technology, healthcare, real estate, and professional services. Known for its consultative approach, the firm provides tailored support for clients undergoing capital raises, acquisitions, or private equity transactions. Maxwell Locke & Ritter places strong emphasis on culture, employee wellbeing, and long-term client relationships, and is regularly recognised as one of the best places to work in the region.

company.name: Charles River Associates
company.description: Charles River Associates (CRA) is a global consulting firm founded in 1965, headquartered in Boston. It specialises in economic, financial, and strategic consulting for law firms, corporations, accounting firms, and governments. The firm is known for its rigorous analytics, its work in litigation & regulatory proceedings, competition economics, and business strategy. Its senior-led teams often include academics and industry experts, and it works across practice areas like antitrust, life sciences, energy, finance, and policy.

company.name: ExxonMobil
company.description: ExxonMobil is one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy providers and chemical manufacturers, specialising in the exploration, production, and refining of crude oil and natural gas. Formed in 1999 through the merger of Exxon and Mobil and based in Spring, Texas, the corporation operates facilities and markets products across the globe. ExxonMobil is known for its vast scale, technological expertise, and extensive integrated supply chain that spans upstream extraction to downstream retail. It combines massive operational capabilities with ongoing investments in resource development to meet growing global energy demand.

company.name: Talos
company.description: Talos is a fintech platform that provides trading infrastructure for digital assets, enabling institutional investors to access crypto markets through a unified, secure interface. The platform offers order routing, execution, settlement, and portfolio management tools, and connects clients to exchanges, custodians, and liquidity providers. Talos serves hedge funds, banks, and asset managers looking to expand into digital assets while maintaining institutional-grade risk controls. The company is headquartered in New York and has become a core piece of market infrastructure in the growing institutional crypto ecosystem.

company.name: RWE
company.description: RWE is one of the world’s leading renewable energy companies, specialising in offshore and onshore wind, solar power, and battery storage. Founded in 1898 and based in Essen, Germany, the company supplies electricity and innovative energy solutions to businesses and communities across Europe, the Americas, and Asia-Pacific. RWE is known for its large-scale green energy projects and its significant transformation away from conventional power generation. It combines extensive utility expertise with heavy capital investment and has a track record of expanding clean energy infrastructure globally.

company.name: Greystone
company.description: Greystone is a leading commercial real estate finance and investment company, specialising in multifamily and healthcare lending, loan servicing, and advisory services. Founded in 1988 and based in New York, the firm provides creative financing solutions through FHA, Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and proprietary bridge platforms. Greystone is known for its deep expertise in government-backed lending programs, entrepreneurial culture, and strong execution capabilities. It combines extensive industry knowledge with a client-focused approach and has a track record of delivering reliable capital solutions to property owners and developers nationwide.

company.name: Brevan Howard
company.description: Brevan Howard is a global alternative investment management firm known for its expertise in macro trading and discretionary strategies. Founded in 2002 and headquartered in Jersey, the firm manages capital on behalf of institutional investors across hedge funds, liquid alternatives, and digital asset strategies. Brevan Howard has offices in major financial centres including London, Geneva, New York, and Abu Dhabi. Its trading teams operate with significant autonomy, using macroeconomic and market research to make directional and relative value bets across asset classes.

company.name: Lincoln International
company.description: Lincoln International is a global mid-market investment bank headquartered in Chicago, providing M&A advisory, debt advisory, and valuation services to private equity firms, public companies, and privately held businesses. The firm has a strong presence in both sell-side and buy-side mandates across industrials, business services, healthcare, consumer, and tech sectors. With offices across the Americas, Europe, and Asia, Lincoln operates a globally integrated model, ensuring seamless cross-border execution. It is known for its focus on founder-led and sponsor-backed companies, and often supports clients through complex sale processes, recapitalisations, and strategic growth transactions. The firm combines strong sector knowledge with execution capability and has built a reputation for consistent results in the global middle market.

company.name: FT Partners
company.description: Financial Technology Partners (FT Partners) is a boutique investment bank focused exclusively on the fintech sector, providing M&A advisory, private capital raising, and IPO preparation to some of the most prominent and high-growth financial technology companies globally. Headquartered in San Francisco, with offices in New York and London, FT Partners is known for its deep domain expertise in payments, lending, insurtech, wealthtech, and banking infrastructure. The firm is founder-led, fiercely independent, and has advised on many landmark fintech deals across North America, Europe, and emerging markets. FT Partners stands out for its end-to-end support of clients through long-term relationships, highly detailed pitch materials, and a research-driven approach. It consistently ranks among the top fintech dealmakers globally and is seen as a go-to adviser for both scaleups and institutional investors navigating the fast-evolving digital finance landscape.

company.name: Proxima
company.description: Proxima Group is a global consulting firm specialising in procurement, supply chain, and commercial strategy, working with corporates, private equity-backed businesses, and public sector organisations to drive cost optimisation and operational efficiency. Headquartered in the UK, the firm leverages data-driven insights and deep industry expertise to deliver services such as strategic sourcing, supplier management, contract negotiation, and supply chain transformation. Proxima is particularly known for supporting private equity value creation through rapid cost reduction and post-acquisition initiatives, and for its hands-on, implementation-focused approach, embedding closely with clients to deliver measurable, sustainable results.

company.name: Jefferies
company.description: Jefferies is a global investment banking and capital markets firm headquartered in New York, offering services in M&A advisory, equity and debt underwriting, research, and trading. The firm is known for its focus on the mid to upper mid-market, serving corporate clients, financial sponsors, and institutional investors across a wide range of industries. Jefferies operates with a full-service model that includes strong sector coverage, global distribution, and a growing footprint in Europe and Asia. It is particularly active in healthcare, industrials, TMT, and consumer, and is regarded as one of the top independent investment banks outside the bulge bracket. Jefferies has also expanded into asset and wealth management, and its flexible, entrepreneurial culture allows it to move quickly in competitive deal environments. With a reputation for high-touch client service and deal execution, it remains a go-to firm for high-growth companies and active sponsors.

company.name: Jegi Leonis
company.description: JEGI Leonis is an independent investment banking and financial advisory firm specialising in mergers and acquisitions, capital raises, and strategic advisory services. Based in the United States, the firm advises high-growth companies, founders, and private equity investors primarily within the technology, media, and tech-enabled services sectors. JEGI Leonis is known for its sector expertise, senior-level transaction execution, and strong relationships across the middle-market ecosystem. It combines deep industry insights with bespoke financial advisory and has a track record of delivering successful outcomes for growth-oriented enterprises.

company.name: Weiss Asset Management
company.description: Weiss Asset Management is a Boston-based hedge fund and investment firm known for its global, multi-strategy approach. Founded in the early 1990s, the firm uses a mix of quantitative analysis, fundamental research, and arbitrage strategies to uncover opportunities across global equity and credit markets. Weiss manages capital for institutional investors including pensions, endowments, and foundations, and places strong emphasis on intellectual rigour, data-driven decision-making, and risk control. The firm maintains a low public profile but is widely respected for its research capabilities and contrarian investment style.

company.name: Houlihan Lokey
company.description: Houlihan Lokey is a global investment bank headquartered in Los Angeles, specialising in M&A advisory, capital markets, financial restructuring, and valuation services. The firm is widely recognised for its leading role in middle-market transactions and has consistently ranked as the top global M&A advisor by volume. In restructuring, Houlihan Lokey is a dominant player, often advising both creditors and debtors on high-profile bankruptcies and distressed situations. It also has one of the largest dedicated financial valuation teams globally, supporting litigation, tax, and financial reporting mandates. With offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, the firm serves public and private companies, financial sponsors, and government entities. Houlihan Lokey’s sector coverage spans consumer, healthcare, tech, energy, and industrials, and it is particularly known for its rigorous analytics, high-touch advisory model, and long-term client relationships.

company.name: IMC Trading
company.description: IMC Trading is a global market maker and proprietary trading firm based in Amsterdam, with major offices in Chicago, Sydney, and other financial centres. Founded in 1989, the firm uses sophisticated algorithms, low-latency infrastructure, and real-time data to provide liquidity across equities, ETFs, derivatives, and fixed income products on over 100 exchanges worldwide. IMC plays a critical role in financial markets by narrowing bid-ask spreads and ensuring efficient price discovery, competing with firms like Jane Street, Optiver, and Citadel Securities. It operates on a flat organisational structure and places strong emphasis on collaboration between traders, engineers, and quantitative researchers. Known for its rigorous recruitment and data-driven culture, IMC invests heavily in proprietary technology and trading systems, and actively participates in market structure discussions to help shape the future of global trading.

company.name: Yale Investments
company.description: The Yale Investments Office is the institutional asset management organisation responsible for allocating Yale University’s endowment. Based in New Haven, Connecticut, the office manages capital dedicated to supporting the university’s academic programs, research, and financial aid. It is renowned for developing the Yale Model, which prioritises heavy allocations to alternative assets such as private equity, venture capital, and real estate. The office maintains a strong track record of partnering with top-tier external fund managers to generate superior, long-term risk-adjusted returns.

company.name: AArete
company.description: AArete is a global management and technology consulting firm, specialising in data-driven operational performance, digital transformation, and strategic cost reduction. Founded in 2008 and based in Chicago, the firm advises clients across industries such as healthcare, financial services, and higher education. AArete is known for its proprietary analytics tools, industry expertise, and ability to execute complex strategic initiatives. It combines advanced data insights with actionable consulting and has a track record of driving sustainable profitability and operational efficiency for organizations worldwide.

company.name: Federated Insurance
company.description: Federated Insurance is a commercial insurance provider that specializes in serving specific industries such as manufacturing, equipment dealers, and contractors. Founded in 1904 and based in Owatonna, Minnesota, the company provides property and casualty coverage, workers compensation, and risk management services. It operates primarily in the United States and emphasizes a consultative approach to helping businesses identify and mitigate potential hazards. The company is structured as a mutual organization, which focuses on long term stability and support for its policyholders rather than outside shareholders.

company.name: Strategic Investment Group
company.description: Strategic Investment Group is an investment management firm that provides outsourced chief investment officer services for endowments, foundations, and other institutional clients. Founded in 1987 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the company focuses on designing customized asset allocation strategies and managing portfolios across diverse asset classes. The firm is known for its fiduciary approach and commitment to long-term wealth preservation. It integrates rigorous research with active risk management to help clients meet their specific financial objectives and mission-based requirements.

company.name: Cascadia Capital
company.description: Cascadia Capital is a US-based investment bank focused on advising middle-market companies on mergers and acquisitions, capital raising, and strategic alternatives. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Seattle, the firm serves clients across sectors including consumer, healthcare, technology, and sustainability. Cascadia works with family-owned businesses, private equity firms, and high-growth companies, with a strong emphasis on relationships and industry knowledge. It is particularly active in advising founder-led businesses during periods of transition.

company.name: Susser Bank
company.description: Susser Bank is a community-focused financial institution that provides a range of personal and commercial banking services. Headquartered in Texas, the bank offers traditional deposit accounts, lending solutions, and treasury management tools designed to support individuals and small businesses. It is known for its localized approach to customer service and its emphasis on building long-term relationships within the communities it serves. The bank prioritizes stability and accessibility while adapting its financial products to meet the evolving needs of its regional client base.

company.name: Temasek
company.description: Temasek is a Singapore-based state-owned investment company managing a diversified global portfolio across sectors including financial services, technology, life sciences, and infrastructure. With a long-term, active ownership model, Temasek invests in both listed and unlisted companies, often taking significant strategic stakes. The firm has a strong focus on innovation, sustainable development, and transformation of national and regional economies. Temasek publishes detailed annual reviews and maintains a AAA credit rating, positioning itself as a transparent, forward-looking sovereign investor with a strong presence across Asia and beyond.

company.name: PSG Equity
company.description: PSG Equity is a US-based growth equity firm that partners with lower middle-market software and technology-enabled services companies. Spun out of Providence Equity Partners, PSG focuses on founder-led businesses with strong recurring revenue and potential for scalable growth. The firm typically invests in companies at inflection points — helping them expand through product development, geographic reach, or M&A. With offices in Boston, Kansas City, London, and Paris, PSG combines operational support with strategic capital to build market leaders, often through repeatable growth playbooks tailored to niche verticals.

company.name: Carr, Riggs & Ingram
company.description: Carr, Riggs & Ingram is a prominent accounting and advisory firm offering services in audit, tax, consulting, and wealth management. Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Enterprise, Alabama, the firm has grown into one of the largest certified public accounting practices in the United States through a focus on regional expansion. It serves a diverse range of clients across industries such as healthcare, construction, government, and manufacturing. The firm is recognized for combining the technical expertise of a large national practice with the personalized service and accessibility of a local office.

company.name: Chinook Capital Advisors
company.description: Chinook Capital Advisors is a mergers and acquisitions advisory firm, specializing in sell side and buy side transactions for middle market companies. Founded in 2004 and based in Seattle, Washington, the firm provides strategic guidance to business owners seeking to maximize value through a sale, acquisition, or capital raise. Chinook Capital Advisors is known for its deep industry expertise, personalized approach, and commitment to achieving optimal outcomes for its clients. It combines rigorous financial analysis with extensive market knowledge and has a track record of successfully navigating complex deal processes across various sectors.

company.name: Campbell Lutyens
company.description: Campbell Lutyens is an independent advisory firm specialising in private capital raising and secondary market transactions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in London, the firm helps private equity, infrastructure, and private credit managers raise capital from institutional investors. It also advises on the sale and restructuring of portfolios through GP-led and LP-led secondaries. Campbell Lutyens operates globally and is known for its discretion, access to limited partners, and deep placement experience.

company.name: Truist
company.description: Truist Financial Corporation is a US-based bank formed from the 2019 merger of BB&T and SunTrust, creating one of the largest financial institutions in the country. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Truist offers a wide range of retail, commercial, and wealth management services across the southeastern and mid-Atlantic US. It also operates a corporate and investment banking division, serving middle-market and institutional clients. Truist focuses on combining digital innovation with a community banking model, and has continued to invest in technology, inclusion initiatives, and financial wellness platforms.

company.name: BlackRock
company.description: BlackRock is the world’s largest asset manager, overseeing trillions in assets across index funds, ETFs, active strategies, and alternatives. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in New York, the firm serves institutional, corporate, and retail investors worldwide. Its product suite includes iShares, the world’s most widely used ETF platform, and Aladdin, its proprietary risk and portfolio management system. BlackRock plays a major role in global capital markets, with influence over long-term investment trends, ESG integration, and financial technology innovation.

company.name: Oliver Wyman
company.description: Oliver Wyman is a global management consultancy known for its work in strategy, risk management, and transformation across a wide range of industries. Headquartered in New York and part of Marsh McLennan, the firm operates in over 30 countries and serves clients in financial services, healthcare, automotive, retail, energy, and the public sector. Oliver Wyman combines analytical rigour with industry-specific expertise and has a strong presence in areas such as financial regulation, climate risk, operational resilience, and digital transformation. It is also highly active in advising central banks, fintechs, insurers, and institutional investors on market structure, competition, and strategic positioning. The firm is noted for its fast-paced environment and data-driven approach to complex business problems.

company.name: Lincoln International
company.description: Lincoln International is a global mid-market investment bank headquartered in Chicago, providing M&A advisory, debt advisory, and valuation services to private equity firms, public companies, and privately held businesses. The firm has a strong presence in both sell-side and buy-side mandates across industrials, business services, healthcare, consumer, and tech sectors. With offices across the Americas, Europe, and Asia, Lincoln operates a globally integrated model, ensuring seamless cross-border execution. It is known for its focus on founder-led and sponsor-backed companies, and often supports clients through complex sale processes, recapitalisations, and strategic growth transactions. The firm combines strong sector knowledge with execution capability and has built a reputation for consistent results in the global middle market.

company.name: BDO Global
company.description: BDO Global is a network of independent accounting and advisory firms operating in more than 160 countries. The organisation offers audit, tax, advisory, and business services to clients ranging from startups to large corporates and public sector bodies. Founded in 1963, BDO has grown to become one of the largest professional services networks in the world. Its member firms are locally rooted but aligned under shared values and international quality standards, enabling cross-border support for clients navigating global financial, operational, and regulatory challenges.

company.name: Brio Real Estate
company.description: Brio Real Estate is a property investment company focused on acquiring and managing commercial properties. The company invests in a diverse range of asset types, including office buildings, retail centers, and industrial facilities. Brio Real Estate seeks to generate income and capital appreciation for its investors through strategic property improvements and proactive management. The firm emphasizes a disciplined approach to investment and aims to identify undervalued properties with strong growth potential.

company.name: PSP Investments
company.description: Public Sector Pension Investment Board (PSP Investments) is one of Canada’s largest pension investment managers, overseeing over C$200 billion in assets for federal public service employees, the Canadian Forces, and the Royal Canadian Mounted Police. Headquartered in Montreal, with global offices in London, New York, and Hong Kong, PSP invests across public equities, private equity, infrastructure, credit, natural resources, and real estate. The organisation takes a long-term, active approach, often pursuing direct and co-investment opportunities. PSP is known for its global diversification, in-house expertise, and focus on responsible investing and climate-related financial risk.

company.name: Gunvor
company.description: Gunvor is one of the world’s largest independent commodities trading houses, with a focus on energy and energy transition markets. Headquartered in Geneva, with trading hubs in Singapore, London, and Houston, Gunvor trades crude oil, refined products, natural gas, and power, as well as metals and renewables. The company integrates logistics, storage, and shipping capabilities with sophisticated market analytics to optimize global supply chains. In recent years, Gunvor has significantly expanded its investments in low-carbon energy and sustainability initiatives.

company.name: Citadel
company.description: Citadel is a global financial institution operating one of the world’s largest and most successful hedge funds, alongside a leading market-making business through Citadel Securities. Founded in 1990 by Kenneth Griffin and headquartered in Miami, the firm manages capital across equities, credit, commodities, and global macro strategies. Citadel is known for its research-intensive, data-driven approach and emphasis on risk management. It attracts top talent in quantitative research, software engineering, and investment analysis across its global offices.

company.name: OC&C
company.description: OC&C is a global strategy consulting firm that works with senior executives on growth, pricing, organisation, and commercial due diligence. Founded in London, it has expanded internationally with offices across Europe, the US, and Asia. The firm focuses on sectors where it has deep expertise, including consumer goods, retail, media, B2B services, and private equity. OC&C is known for its analytical depth, straightforward style, and long-term client relationships. Its private equity practice is particularly active, supporting investors with pre-deal diligence and post-deal value creation. While smaller than the MBB firms, OC&C maintains a focused and high-impact consulting model, valued for its clarity, sector depth, and actionable insight.

company.name: Lord Abbett
company.description: Lord Abbett is an independent, privately held investment management firm that provides a wide range of equity, fixed income, and multi-asset strategies. Founded in 1929 and based in Jersey City, the company manages assets for institutional clients, financial intermediaries, and individual investors. The firm is known for its research-driven investment process and its focus on delivering long-term performance through active management. Lord Abbett maintains a commitment to building durable client relationships and employs a collaborative approach to navigate complex global market environments.

company.name: Nationwide Mutual Insurance Company
company.description: Nationwide Mutual Insurance Company is a large diversified insurance and financial services organization based in Columbus, Ohio. Founded in 1925, the company operates as a mutual insurer, meaning it is owned by its policyholders rather than outside shareholders. It provides a wide range of products including property and casualty insurance, life insurance, retirement savings, and banking services. Nationwide is recognized for its extensive national reach and its commitment to community support, offering tailored coverage solutions for individuals, businesses, and institutional clients across the United States.

company.name: GIC
company.description: GIC is Singapore’s sovereign wealth fund, responsible for managing the city-state’s foreign reserves with a long-term, global investment mandate. Established in 1981, GIC invests across asset classes including public equities, fixed income, private equity, real estate, infrastructure, and venture capital. With a presence in key financial hubs including New York, London, San Francisco, Beijing, and São Paulo, GIC takes a highly diversified and research-driven approach, focusing on sustainable returns over decades. The firm is known for its disciplined portfolio construction, rigorous risk management, and strong in-house macroeconomic research. GIC is also a leading investor in technology and emerging markets, and has significantly increased its focus on sustainability, climate risk, and corporate governance as part of its investment strategy. It operates independently from the Singapore government but is ultimately accountable to the Ministry of Finance.

company.name: Baker Tilly
company.description: Baker Tilly is a global network of accounting and business advisory firms, offering audit, tax, and consulting services to clients across industries. The brand traces its roots back to 1931 and has grown into one of the world’s largest accountancy networks. Each member firm is independently owned but shares common standards and practices across more than 140 territories. Baker Tilly works with small businesses, multinational corporations, and public sector organisations, helping them manage financial, operational, and regulatory challenges in an evolving global environment.

company.name: RDV Corporation
company.description: RDV Corporation is a private investment and management firm based in Grand Rapids, Michigan. Founded to serve as the family office for the DeVos family, the company oversees a diverse portfolio of assets including private equity, real estate, and financial investments. It functions as the central hub for the strategic oversight of the family’s business interests and philanthropic efforts. RDV Corporation focuses on long term value creation and asset management while supporting various commercial ventures and community development initiatives.

company.name: PMCF Investment Banking
company.description: PMCF Investment Banking is a middle market investment bank providing merger and acquisition advisory, capital raising, and strategic advisory services. Founded in 1987 and headquartered in Southfield, Michigan, the firm serves private equity groups, public companies, and private companies. PMCF is known for its industry expertise, transaction execution experience, and focus on building long-term client relationships. It operates across a range of industries, including industrials, business services, and healthcare.

company.name: Uline
company.description: Uline is a leading North American distributor of shipping, industrial, and packaging materials. Founded in 1980 and based in Pleasant Prairie, Wisconsin, the company serves businesses across the continent through an extensive catalog and a high volume of online orders. Uline is known for its massive distribution centers, commitment to same day shipping, and focus on customer service. It operates as a privately held family business that provides a wide range of essentials including boxes, warehouse equipment, and janitorial supplies.

company.name: Harrison Street
company.description: Harrison Street is a real assets investment manager based in Chicago, specialising in alternative real estate sectors driven by demographic and technological shifts. These include student housing, senior living, medical office, life sciences, storage, and data centres. The firm manages over $50 billion across core, value-add, and opportunistic strategies, with investments in North America and Europe. Harrison Street partners with operators to manage assets efficiently and is committed to sustainability and social impact through its ESG framework. It is one of the most prominent players in non-traditional property investing and continues to grow through new platform strategies and global partnerships.

company.name: HarbourVest
company.description: HarbourVest is a global private markets investment firm headquartered in Boston, managing more than $100 billion across primary fund investments, secondaries, and direct co-investments. The firm offers clients diversified access to private equity, private credit, infrastructure, and venture capital, supporting both commingled funds and custom mandates. HarbourVest is known for its global reach, data-driven approach, and strong manager relationships, which allow it to source and execute deals across the private markets spectrum. It also invests directly alongside GPs through co-investment programmes and supports clients with detailed reporting and ESG integration. With decades of experience and a wide institutional client base, HarbourVest is a core allocator in the alternatives landscape.

company.name: Frazier & Deeter
company.description: Frazier & Deeter is a US-based accounting and advisory firm providing audit, tax, and consulting services to clients ranging from startups to public companies. Headquartered in Atlanta, the firm has expanded across major cities including New York, Nashville, and London. Frazier & Deeter serves clients across financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, technology, and real estate sectors. It is particularly well regarded for its agile, client-centric model and its work with middle-market companies. The firm offers services in cybersecurity, process improvement, transaction advisory, and international tax planning. It is also known for strong firm culture, frequently ranking among the best places to work in the accounting industry.

company.name: PJT Partners
company.description: PJT Partners is a global advisory-focused investment bank, formed as a spin-off from Blackstone in 2015. Headquartered in New York, the firm provides strategic advisory services in M&A, restructuring, and capital markets to corporates, governments, and institutional investors. It is particularly known for its strong presence in complex financial restructurings and special situations, having advised on many of the largest corporate bankruptcies and recapitalisations globally. PJT also operates a capital raising platform, Park Hill, which advises alternative asset managers on fundraising and secondary transactions. With a senior-led, conflict-free model, PJT competes with larger banks by offering high-touch, independent advice in critical, high-stakes mandates.

company.name: BNP Paribas
company.description: BNP Paribas is one of Europe’s largest banking groups, providing retail, corporate, and investment banking services across more than 70 countries. Headquartered in Paris, it was formed through the merger of Banque Nationale de Paris and Paribas in 2000. The group operates with a strong presence in continental Europe while maintaining global capabilities in capital markets, financing, asset management, and insurance. BNP Paribas is also active in ESG financing and sustainable investment, aligning its services with global climate and development goals.

company.name: Paralign Capital Partners
company.description: Paralign Capital Partners is a private investment firm focused on acquiring and growing lower middle market companies. Based in the United States, the firm targets established businesses with sustainable competitive advantages and proven management teams. It partners with owners to provide operational expertise, strategic guidance, and capital to accelerate long term growth. The firm emphasizes a collaborative approach to value creation, prioritizing the preservation of company culture while implementing initiatives to enhance profitability and market position.

company.name: Blackstone
company.description: Blackstone is one of the world’s leading investment firms, specialising in private equity, real estate, credit, and infrastructure. Founded in 1985 and based in New York, the firm manages capital on behalf of pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, and individual investors. Blackstone is known for its scale, global reach, and ability to take large, complex positions across industries. It combines deep operational support with financial engineering and has a track record of building value in both private and public market investments.

company.name: Kline Hill Partners
company.description: Kline Hill Partners is a private equity firm that focuses on the secondary market for alternative assets. Based in Greenwich, Connecticut, the firm specializes in acquiring portfolios of limited partnership interests in private equity funds from institutional and private investors. It is known for its expertise in smaller, complex transactions and its ability to provide liquidity solutions to diverse market participants. By targeting niche areas of the secondary market, the firm aims to generate risk adjusted returns while offering a streamlined process for buyers and sellers of fund interests.

company.name: OMERS
company.description: OMERS is one of Canada’s largest defined benefit pension plans, responsible for investing the retirement savings of municipal employees across Ontario. Founded in 1962 and headquartered in Toronto, the organization manages a diverse global portfolio spanning private equity, infrastructure, real estate, and capital markets. It operates with a mandate to provide secure and sustainable retirement benefits to its members while maintaining long term financial health. OMERS is recognized for its significant direct investment capabilities and its focus on acquiring and growing high quality assets across international markets.

company.name: Bain & Company
company.description: Bain & Company is a global management consulting firm that advises clients on strategy, operations, technology, and organisational change. Founded in 1973 in Boston, Bain works with businesses, private equity firms, and non-profits to solve high-impact problems and deliver measurable results. The firm is known for its deep client relationships, collaborative style, and experience in scaling growth strategies across sectors such as consumer goods, healthcare, finance, and tech. It operates across more than 60 offices worldwide and regularly ranks among the most desirable employers in consulting.

company.name: Koch
company.description: Koch Industries is one of the world’s largest privately held conglomerates, with operations spanning manufacturing, refining, chemicals, electronics, and enterprise software. Founded in 1940 and based in Wichita, Kansas, the company oversees a diverse portfolio of major businesses including Georgia-Pacific, Molex, and Infor. Koch is known for its immense scale, long-term investment horizon, and its proprietary management philosophy. It combines continuous capital reinvestment with broad operational capabilities and has a track record of driving efficiency and growth across foundational global industries.

company.name: Goldman Sachs
company.description: Goldman Sachs is one of the world’s most prestigious investment banks and financial institutions, offering a wide range of services in investment banking, asset management, global markets, consumer banking, and wealth management. Founded in 1869 and headquartered in New York, the firm serves corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals globally. Goldman is widely regarded for its M&A advisory, equity and debt underwriting, and institutional trading, and has been involved in many of the largest and most complex financial transactions in history. It also operates Marcus, its consumer banking platform, and has expanded into transaction banking and alternative investments. Known for its elite talent, risk culture, and thought leadership, Goldman Sachs is also increasingly focused on sustainability, digital finance, and private capital markets. It plays a key role in shaping financial innovation and global capital flows.

company.name: GSA Capital
company.description: GSA Capital is a London-based quantitative trading firm that runs systematic strategies across global equity, futures, and FX markets. Originally formed in 2005 as a spinout from Deutsche Bank, the firm has since established itself as a low-profile but consistently high-performing player in the quant space. GSA focuses on exploiting short- to medium-term statistical patterns in large datasets, applying rigorous academic research, machine learning, and proprietary execution systems to gain a trading edge. The firm has also explored longer-horizon signals and fundamental data, expanding its portfolio of strategies while maintaining its data-first philosophy. With a culture built around research integrity and risk discipline, GSA hires selectively and fosters a collaborative environment geared towards solving complex market problems with mathematics and technology.

company.name: Zachary Scott
company.description: Zachary Scott is a Seattle based investment banking firm that provides merger and acquisition advisory services to middle market companies. Founded in 1991, the firm assists business owners and management teams with divestitures, acquisitions, and strategic capital raises. It specializes in industries such as consumer products, business services, and industrial manufacturing. Zachary Scott is known for its partner led approach and its focus on helping clients navigate complex ownership transitions through tailored financial strategies.

company.name: Morgan Properties
company.description: Morgan Properties is one of the largest private real estate investment and management companies in the United States, specialising in multifamily residential communities. Founded in 1985 and based in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, the firm owns and operates tens of thousands of apartment homes across numerous states. Morgan Properties is known for its aggressive acquisition strategy, strong regional scale, and focus on revitalising suburban workforce housing. It combines hands-on property management with value-add capital improvements and has a track record of generating long-term value across diverse real estate markets.

company.name: ArkMalibu
company.description: ArkMalibu is a boutique investment banking firm that specializes in providing merger and acquisition advisory services to middle market companies. Based in Cincinnati and founded in 1998, the firm focuses on sell side transactions and strategic financial advice for family owned and entrepreneur led businesses. ArkMalibu is known for its customized approach to deal execution and its commitment to prioritizing the unique objectives of business owners throughout the exit process. It leverages deep industry knowledge and an extensive network of global buyers to facilitate complex transactions while maintaining a personalized client experience.

company.name: Virtu Financial
company.description: Virtu Financial is a US-based financial services firm specialising in market making, trading technology, and execution services. Headquartered in New York, Virtu operates globally across equities, fixed income, FX, and commodities, using proprietary algorithms and low-latency infrastructure. The firm provides liquidity to global markets and also offers analytics, execution tools, and workflow solutions to institutional clients. Known for its role in electronic trading and its high-speed market presence, Virtu plays a key part in maintaining efficiency and depth in modern financial markets.

company.name: Silversmith Capital Partners
company.description: Silversmith Capital Partners is a US-based growth equity firm that invests in profitable, founder-led software and healthcare companies. Headquartered in Boston, the firm focuses on backing businesses with strong recurring revenue and clear paths to scale, typically at the Series B to pre-IPO stage. Silversmith provides strategic and operational support while allowing founders to retain control and preserve long-term focus. Its portfolio includes vertical SaaS, healthcare IT, and internet-enabled services, and the firm is known for its long-term alignment, high-conviction investing, and founder-first approach.

company.name: Susquehanna International Group
company.description: Susquehanna International Group is a global quantitative trading and technology firm based in the US, known for market making, proprietary trading, and quantitative research. The firm trades across asset classes including equities, options, ETFs, and fixed income, using mathematical models and high-frequency trading infrastructure. SIG is also a significant investor in venture capital through Susquehanna Growth Equity. With offices in the US, Europe, and Asia, the firm is noted for its strong internal training programs, flat structure, and heavy emphasis on probability, decision-making, and applied game theory.

company.name: Summit Partners
company.description: Summit Partners is a US-based growth equity and credit investment firm focused on profitable, fast-growing companies in technology, healthcare, consumer, and business services. Founded in 1984 and headquartered in Boston, the firm backs founder-led businesses and supports scaling through capital, operational insight, and global expansion. Summit is known for flexible investment structures and long-term partnerships, often targeting businesses at the expansion stage with strong recurring revenue models. It manages over $35 billion in assets and maintains offices in North America and Europe.

company.name: ZS
company.description: ZS is a global professional services firm that provides consulting, technology, and analytics solutions primarily for life sciences and healthcare clients. Headquartered in Evanston, Illinois, the firm works with pharmaceutical companies, biotech firms, medtech manufacturers, and healthcare providers to solve complex business challenges in areas such as market access, patient engagement, clinical development, and commercial strategy. ZS integrates consulting with data science, AI, and custom software development, supporting clients through every stage of the product lifecycle. With over 35 offices worldwide, ZS is known for its analytical depth, collaborative culture, and continued expansion into digital health and value-based care.

company.name: Jane Street
company.description: Jane Street is a global proprietary trading firm and liquidity provider known for its expertise in quantitative trading, technology development, and financial engineering. Headquartered in New York with offices in London, Hong Kong, and Amsterdam, the firm trades a wide array of asset classes—including equities, ETFs, options, fixed income, and crypto—across both traditional and electronic markets. Jane Street combines rigorous mathematical research with cutting-edge software development, operating in a highly collaborative, flat organisational structure. It is a major player in ETF market making and provides liquidity to markets around the clock, contributing to efficiency and price discovery. The firm is known for its analytical culture, competitive hiring process, and deep investment in proprietary systems and infrastructure. Jane Street remains privately held and low-profile, but plays an outsized role in global financial markets, particularly in electronic and algorithmic trading.

company.name: Bank of America
company.description: Bank of America is one of the largest financial institutions in the world, offering banking, investment, and wealth management services to individuals, businesses, and governments. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, the bank operates across more than 35 countries and serves tens of millions of clients globally. It has a significant presence in consumer banking, corporate and investment banking, and asset management through its Merrill and Private Bank brands. Bank of America plays a central role in US capital markets and is consistently ranked among the world’s systemically important financial institutions.

company.name: Xantium
company.description: Xantium is a global multi-strategy investment team that combines quantitative research, software engineering, and trading expertise to generate consistent, repeatable returns. Operating as part of the Tudor Group, Xantium leverages sophisticated data, technology, and agile processes across its London and New York hubs (with additional presence in Stamford, Paris, Singapore, and Sydney) to navigate complex markets efficiently.

company.name: M31 Capital
company.description: M31 Capital is a global investment firm focused on advanced technologies including AI, fintech, data centers, and blockchain. With over 15 years of experience, the firm supports visionary founders through early-stage ventures via M31 Ventures, incubation and infrastructure via M31 Labs, and talent development through M31 Academy. It has backed multiple unicorns and provides not only capital but also advisory, research, and incubation resources. M31 Capital combines deep thematic research with a collaborative culture to drive breakthrough innovation.

company.name: Graham Partners
company.description: Graham Partners is a private investment firm focused on industrial technology and advanced manufacturing businesses, primarily in the lower middle market. Based in suburban Philadelphia, the firm invests in companies that leverage innovation in materials science, automation, and sustainability to serve end markets such as healthcare, food & beverage, packaging, and infrastructure. Graham Partners typically targets control investments and works closely with portfolio companies on operational improvements, commercial expansion, and technology enablement. The firm maintains strong relationships with engineering and manufacturing talent, often supporting founder-led businesses through generational transitions or strategic repositioning. Graham Partners has a long-term investment philosophy, emphasising value creation through ESG alignment, lean operations, and product innovation.

company.name: FMI Capital Advisors
company.description: FMI Capital Advisors is a specialized investment banking firm focused exclusively on the engineering, construction, and infrastructure sectors. Based in Raleigh, North Carolina, the company provides merger and acquisition advisory, capital formation, and ownership transition services to businesses operating within the built environment. It acts as a subsidiary of FMI Corporation and leverages deep industry knowledge to connect strategic buyers and financial investors with firms across the construction value chain. The company is recognized for its technical expertise and its ability to guide middle market clients through complex ownership changes and strategic growth initiatives.

company.name: Brown Gibbons Lang & Company
company.description: Brown Gibbons Lang & Company (BGL) is a US-based investment bank specialising in middle-market M&A advisory and capital markets services. Headquartered in Cleveland, with offices across the US, the firm advises both private and public companies on transactions across healthcare, industrials, consumer, and services sectors. BGL offers sell-side and buy-side advisory, debt placement, and financial restructuring. It is known for its sector focus, research-driven process, and access to both domestic and international buyer networks.

company.name: CBIZ
company.description: CBIZ is a leading national provider of financial, tax, and advisory services, along with benefits and HR solutions. Founded in 1996 and headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, the firm serves a diverse client base that includes small and mid-sized businesses, as well as individuals. CBIZ is recognized for its integrated approach, combining local market expertise with extensive national resources to deliver comprehensive solutions. It aims to help clients manage their finances, grow their businesses, and maximize their human capital effectively.

company.name: M. Klein & Company
company.description: M. Klein & Company is a boutique strategic advisory and investment firm founded by Michael Klein, a former Citigroup executive, known for advising on high-profile M&A transactions and special purpose acquisition companies (SPACs). Based in New York, the firm offers bespoke advice to corporates, sovereign entities, and high-net-worth individuals, with a strong focus on deal structuring, capital markets access, and cross-border advisory. M. Klein & Company gained prominence during the SPAC boom, advising and sponsoring a number of multi-billion-dollar transactions involving high-growth companies and complex valuation scenarios. The firm operates with a lean team and relationship-driven approach, often playing a behind-the-scenes role in transformative corporate deals.

company.name: Apogem Capital
company.description: Apogem Capital is a leading alternatives investment firm specializing in private equity, private credit, and real assets. Formed in 2022 through the integration of several established platforms and based in Chicago, the firm manages capital on behalf of institutional investors, including pension funds, endowments, and foundations. Apogem is known for its comprehensive platform, deep expertise in the middle market, and extensive network across the alternatives landscape. It combines differentiated access to both fund and direct investments with a focus on delivering robust returns for its clients.

company.name: Arrowstreet Capital
company.description: Arrowstreet Capital is a quantitative investment management firm that focuses on providing equity and asset allocation strategies to institutional investors. Founded in 1999 and based in Boston, the firm utilizes systematic research and proprietary technology to identify investment opportunities across global markets. Arrowstreet Capital is known for its data driven approach, which integrates fundamental insights with advanced mathematical modeling to manage risk and generate alpha. The firm serves a diverse range of clients including public and private pension funds, endowments, and sovereign wealth funds.

company.name: Piper Sandler
company.description: Piper Sandler is a US-based investment bank focused on the middle market, providing M&A advisory, equity and debt capital markets services, and institutional brokerage. Headquartered in Minneapolis, the firm works with clients across healthcare, consumer, energy, financial services, and technology sectors. Piper Sandler is particularly active in advising growth companies and private equity sponsors on strategic transactions and public offerings. It is known for its industry expertise, research capabilities, and strong client relationships, and continues to expand through acquisitions and sector-focused growth. The firm operates internationally, with a growing presence in Europe and Asia.

company.name: Bennett Thrasher
company.description: Bennett Thrasher is a leading accounting and consulting firm, specializing in audit, tax, and advisory services. Founded in 1980 and based in Atlanta, Georgia, the firm serves a diverse client base including private and public companies, individuals, and non-profit organizations. Bennett Thrasher is known for its client-centric approach, comprehensive service offerings, and deep industry expertise. It combines specialized knowledge with a collaborative culture to deliver strategic solutions and build lasting value for its clients.

company.name: Texas Capital Bank
company.description: Texas Capital Bank is a commercial bank headquartered in Dallas, serving middle-market businesses, private clients, and institutional investors across Texas and other US regions. The bank offers lending, treasury, capital markets, and private wealth services, with particular strength in real estate, energy, and professional services sectors. It has also expanded its investment banking and digital banking capabilities, aiming to provide a more integrated financial offering. Texas Capital Bank is known for its regional expertise, client-focused model, and efforts to modernise through fintech partnerships and digital infrastructure.

company.name: Audax Group
company.description: Audax Group is a US-based private equity and private debt investment firm focused on building and scaling middle-market companies. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Boston, Audax is known for its buy-and-build strategy, partnering with management teams to support growth through targeted acquisitions. The firm invests across a range of sectors including healthcare, business services, industrials, and consumer. It operates with a disciplined approach to value creation, backed by a dedicated in-house operations team and deep transaction experience.

company.name: Capstone Partners
company.description: Capstone Partners is an independent investment banking firm providing mergers and acquisitions advisory, capital raising, and financial advisory services. Founded in 2002 and headquartered in Boston, the firm serves middle market companies, private equity firms, and entrepreneurs across a variety of industries. Capstone is known for its client-centric approach, deep sector expertise, and comprehensive advisory solutions. It leverages a broad network and global partnerships to deliver strategic guidance and optimal outcomes for its clients throughout their business lifecycle.

company.name: Point72
company.description: Point72 is a global asset management firm founded by Steven A. Cohen in 2014, following the transition from SAC Capital. Headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, the firm manages capital across multiple strategies including long/short equity, macro, systematic, and private investments. Its discretionary investing teams operate with autonomy within a multi-manager platform, while its Cubist division focuses on quantitative and algorithmic trading. Point72 also runs a venture capital arm, Point72 Ventures, investing in fintech, healthcare, and enterprise technology. With offices in major financial centres including New York, London, Tokyo, and Singapore, the firm is known for its strong emphasis on data, technology, and talent development, particularly through its structured analyst training programs like the Point72 Academy.

company.name: Hennepin Partners
company.description: Hennepin Partners is a boutique investment bank based in Minneapolis, advising middle-market companies on M&A, recapitalisations, and liquidity events. The firm focuses on founder-led and sponsor-backed businesses across sectors including industrials, consumer, and business services. Known for its senior-led execution and tailored advisory, Hennepin Partners supports clients through complex sale processes and strategic transactions, often for the first time in a company’s lifecycle. Its relationship-driven approach and attention to detail make it a preferred partner for owners seeking hands-on, high-quality advice in the US mid-market.

company.name: KPMG
company.description: KPMG is one of the Big Four professional services firms, offering audit, tax, and advisory services to clients ranging from large corporates to government bodies and startups. Headquartered in the Netherlands and operating in over 140 countries, KPMG has a global workforce of more than 230,000 professionals. The firm supports clients with financial audits, deal advisory, regulatory compliance, digital transformation, cybersecurity, and ESG reporting, among other services. KPMG is known for its strong presence in regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, and public sector, and continues to invest in data analytics, AI, and technology-enabled solutions. While maintaining independence in its member firm structure, KPMG is unified in its brand and quality standards globally, and remains a leading voice on corporate governance, risk, and sustainable business.

company.name: Macquarie Group
company.description: Macquarie Group is a global financial services firm headquartered in Sydney, Australia, offering services across asset management, banking, commodities, and capital markets. Known for its entrepreneurial culture and decentralised structure, Macquarie operates through specialised groups that manage infrastructure, green energy, real estate, and credit investments worldwide. It is one of the world’s largest infrastructure asset managers and a major player in commodity trading and energy finance. The firm’s global advisory and capital markets division supports clients with M&A, equity, and debt financing, often with a focus on complex or cross-border transactions. Macquarie has expanded significantly in Europe and North America and is recognised for combining risk discipline with innovation across sectors including renewables, tech, and transportation.

company.name: Evergreen Services Group
company.description: Evergreen Services Group is a private equity-backed holding company that acquires and supports managed IT services providers (MSPs) across North America. Backed by Alpine Investors, Evergreen’s model is to invest in profitable, founder-led MSPs and provide them with operational support, growth capital, and strategic resources—while allowing them to retain their local leadership and brand. Since its launch in 2017, Evergreen has acquired dozens of MSPs and built a decentralised network of IT service firms serving small and medium-sized businesses. The company provides shared services across finance, talent, marketing, and technology, helping portfolio companies scale while maintaining entrepreneurial culture. Evergreen is an emerging force in the highly fragmented managed services industry and continues to expand its platform through roll-ups and organic growth.

company.name: Northborne Partners
company.description: Northborne Partners is a US-based boutique investment bank headquartered in Minneapolis, specialising in M&A advisory services for founder- and family-owned businesses. The firm focuses on the lower middle market, working across a range of industries including industrials, consumer, business services, and healthcare. Northborne provides both sell-side and buy-side advisory, with a focus on privately held businesses seeking strategic growth, succession planning, or liquidity events. It is known for its relationship-driven approach, tailored execution, and deep experience in navigating complex, privately negotiated transactions.

The firm plays a central role in capital allocation across public and private markets and continues to invest heavily in technology, digital banking, and sustainability initiatives. With a strong presence in London and across EMEA, it is a key player in European finance as well as global capital markets.

company.name: PSRS/PEERS
company.description: PSRS/PEERS is a public pension system that manages retirement benefits for teachers and education employees in Missouri. It operates as a defined benefit plan, collecting contributions from both employees and school districts to fund future pension obligations. The organization is governed by a board of trustees and focuses on long-term investment strategies to ensure the sustainability of the fund and the reliable delivery of benefits to its participants.

company.name: GCM Grosvenor
company.description: GCM Grosvenor is a global alternative asset management firm with over $70 billion in assets under management across private equity, infrastructure, real estate, credit, and absolute return strategies. GCM Grosvenor is known for its manager selection expertise, multi-manager strategies, and long-standing commitment to ESG and diverse manager sourcing.

company.name: Northwestern Mutual
company.description: Northwestern Mutual is a prominent American financial services company that provides life insurance, investment products, and retirement planning services. Founded in 1857 and based in Milwaukee, the firm operates as a mutual company, meaning it is owned by its policyholders rather than shareholders. It is widely recognized for its strong financial ratings and long-standing focus on long-term security. The company utilizes a network of financial representatives to offer personalized guidance and comprehensive insurance solutions to individuals and businesses across the United States.

company.name: University Partners
company.description: University Partners is a real estate investment and management firm focused on the development and operation of student housing communities. Based in the United States, the company specializes in acquiring, renovating, and managing properties located near major public and private universities. It works closely with academic institutions and institutional investors to provide high quality living environments for students. The firm is known for its data driven approach to asset management and its expertise in navigating the specialized needs of the collegiate housing sector.

company.name: Rothschild & Co.
company.description: Rothschild & Co. is a multinational financial advisory group with deep roots in European banking, offering services in M&A, wealth management, and asset management. Headquartered in Paris and London, the firm is especially renowned for its independent M&A advisory, supporting corporates, governments, and institutions on high-profile, often cross-border, transactions. It also advises families and entrepreneurs through its private wealth arm and manages funds for institutional clients. Known for discretion, relationship depth, and long-term perspective, Rothschild & Co. operates with a global footprint while preserving a culture of stability and trust rooted in its family heritage.

company.name: Loop Capital
company.description: Loop Capital is a US-based investment bank, brokerage, and advisory firm headquartered in Chicago, offering services in public finance, corporate finance, research, and asset management. Founded in 1997, the firm is one of the largest minority-owned investment banks in the US and is known for its work with municipalities, Fortune 500 companies, and institutional investors. Loop Capital is active in equity and debt underwriting, M&A advisory, and infrastructure financing, and has expanded its capabilities in ESG and impact-focused investment strategies. The firm also provides insights through its research division and partners with government agencies on economic development initiatives. It is recognised for its commitment to diversity, inclusive finance, and strengthening access to capital across underrepresented communities.

company.name: AEW Capital Management
company.description: AEW Capital Management is a global real estate investment firm managing assets on behalf of institutional investors, including pension funds, insurers, and sovereign wealth funds. Founded in 1981 in Boston, the firm invests across office, residential, industrial, and retail sectors through a mix of direct investments, joint ventures, and listed vehicles. AEW operates in North America, Europe, and Asia, and is known for integrating research, market analytics, and local expertise into its investment process. Its platform spans both core and opportunistic strategies, managing capital across economic cycles.

company.name: Bates White
company.description: Bates White is a prominent economic consulting firm that provides expert analysis and testimony to law firms, corporations, and government agencies. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Washington, DC, the firm specializes in areas such as antitrust litigation, finance, health care, and environmental regulation. Bates White is known for its rigorous analytical approach and its ability to distill complex economic data into clear insights for high-stakes legal proceedings. The firm maintains a strong reputation for academic excellence and technical expertise, often collaborating with leading university professors to support clients in navigating challenging regulatory and litigation environments.

company.name: Barings
company.description: Barings is a global investment management firm headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, managing investments across public and private markets. A subsidiary of MassMutual, the firm oversees strategies in credit, real estate, private equity, and multi-asset portfolios. Barings serves institutional clients such as pensions, endowments, and insurers, with a strong focus on credit and alternative investments. It operates across the Americas, Europe, and Asia, with a commitment to fundamental research and long-term asset stewardship.

company.name: Stifel
company.description: Stifel Financial Corp. is a US-based financial services firm offering investment banking, brokerage, and wealth management to individuals and institutions. Headquartered in St. Louis, the firm has a growing global footprint and a strong reputation in middle-market advisory, equity research, and capital markets execution. Stifel’s investment banking division is particularly active in healthcare, technology, and industrials, while its private client group manages significant assets for individuals and family offices. The firm has grown through acquisitions and is known for its integrated approach across research, advisory, and execution.

company.name: CBRE
company.description: CBRE is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, specialising in property management, leasing, capital markets, and valuation. Founded in 1906 and headquartered in Dallas, the company serves real estate investors and occupiers across the globe. CBRE is known for its massive scale, comprehensive service offerings, and deep data-driven market insights. It combines local market expertise with a vast international platform and has a track record of executing complex property transactions and managing extensive real estate portfolios.

company.name: Piper Sandler
company.description: Piper Sandler is a US-based investment bank focused on the middle market, providing M&A advisory, equity and debt capital markets services, and institutional brokerage. Headquartered in Minneapolis, the firm works with clients across healthcare, consumer, energy, financial services, and technology sectors. Piper Sandler is particularly active in advising growth companies and private equity sponsors on strategic transactions and public offerings. It is known for its industry expertise, research capabilities, and strong client relationships, and continues to expand through acquisitions and sector-focused growth. The firm operates internationally, with a growing presence in Europe and Asia.

company.name: Audax Group
company.description: Audax Group is a US-based private equity and private debt investment firm focused on building and scaling middle-market companies. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Boston, Audax is known for its buy-and-build strategy, partnering with management teams to support growth through targeted acquisitions. The firm invests across a range of sectors including healthcare, business services, industrials, and consumer. It operates with a disciplined approach to value creation, backed by a dedicated in-house operations team and deep transaction experience.

company.name: Mercuria
company.description: Mercuria is a global energy and commodities trading company. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the company trades crude oil, refined products, natural gas, power, and various other commodities. Mercuria has grown rapidly through strategic acquisitions and organic expansion, establishing a presence in key markets worldwide. It focuses on providing integrated solutions across the commodity value chain, from production and storage to transportation and delivery, serving producers, consumers, and investors.

company.name: BNY Mellon
company.description: BNY Mellon (The Bank of New York Mellon) is a US-based global financial institution specialising in investment servicing and management. Headquartered in New York, the bank was formed in 2007 through the merger of The Bank of New York and Mellon Financial Corporation. It is one of the largest custodians in the world, providing asset servicing, fund administration, and data solutions to institutional clients. BNY Mellon also manages investments across equities, fixed income, and alternatives through its investment arm, offering services in more than 35 countries.
