company.name: Ethical Capital Partners
company.description: Ethical Capital Partners is a private equity firm focused on investing in companies that demonstrate a commitment to ethical and sustainable business practices. The firm seeks to partner with management teams to improve operational efficiency, drive revenue growth, and enhance long-term value. Ethical Capital Partners differentiates itself by integrating environmental, social, and governance considerations into its investment process. The firm targets investments across various sectors, emphasising businesses with strong potential for positive social and environmental impact.

company.name: Balyasny Asset Management
company.description: Balyasny Asset Management (BAM) is a global multi-strategy investment firm headquartered in Chicago, with additional offices in New York, London, Hong Kong, and other financial hubs. Founded in 2001, the firm manages capital across a range of public market strategies including equities, macro, credit, and quant. BAM operates through a platform model, working with a network of individual portfolio managers who run their own books under the firm's infrastructure and risk oversight. It’s known for its focus on technology, data-driven insights, and recruiting top talent across investment and research teams.

company.name: Harris Associates
company.description: Harris Associates is a Chicago-based investment manager known for its deep value equity investing, particularly through its management of the Oakmark Funds. Founded in 1976, the firm uses a fundamental, bottom-up research process to invest in companies trading below their intrinsic value, with a long-term, concentrated portfolio approach. Harris Associates manages money for both institutional and retail investors and is widely respected for its transparency, long investment horizon, and rigorous valuation discipline. Its analysts and portfolio managers often maintain significant personal stakes in the funds they manage, reinforcing alignment with investors.

company.name: Readystate
company.description: Readystate Asset Management is a unified, multi-strategy investment firm that invests across the full spectrum of financial assets. The firm applies research from a broad range of disciplines, building its investment process on a deep understanding of the relationship among credit, equity, and volatility. Readystate focuses on the full distribution of underlying asset values and the related evolution of firm liabilities. Its integrated approach to people, culture, and investment process drives its competitive advantage, supported by a multi-disciplinary team with extensive industry experience and a successful track record across asset classes and economic cycles.

company.name: VantEdge Partners
company.description: VantEdge Partners is a US-based family office and private investment firm focused on long-term, strategic investments across consumer, franchising, real estate, and technology sectors. Based in Kansas City, the firm operates with a permanent capital model, allowing it to support businesses over extended timeframes without the typical exit pressure of traditional private equity. VantEdge partners with founders and management teams, providing both capital and operational guidance. Its flexible structure enables it to back businesses through a variety of ownership stages and structures.

company.name: Apple
company.description: Apple is a global technology company known for designing and manufacturing consumer electronics, software, and digital services. Founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, California, Apple produces widely used products like the iPhone, Mac, iPad, and Apple Watch, along with operating systems and services such as iOS, iCloud, and Apple Music. The company has a vertically integrated business model and is one of the most valuable and recognisable brands in the world.

company.name: Oaktree Capital Management
company.description: Oaktree Capital Management is a leading global investment firm specialising in alternative credit, with additional strategies across private equity, real assets, and structured finance. Headquartered in Los Angeles, the firm is known for its deep value investing philosophy and disciplined approach to risk, often targeting distressed debt, special situations, and opportunistic credit investments. Oaktree serves institutional clients including pension funds, endowments, and sovereign wealth funds, managing over $180 billion in assets. The firm has a strong track record in navigating market cycles and identifying value in dislocated or underfollowed markets. Now part of Brookfield Asset Management, Oaktree continues to operate with investment autonomy, expanding its influence across public and private markets globally.

company.name: Lumsden McCormick CPA
company.description: Lumsden McCormick CPA is a leading accounting and advisory firm, specializing in assurance, tax, and business consulting services. Founded in 1931 and based in Buffalo, New York, the firm serves businesses, non-profit organizations, government entities, and individuals. It provides comprehensive financial solutions to a diverse client base across various industries. Lumsden McCormick is known for its deep expertise, client-centric approach, and commitment to community engagement. It combines personalized service with advanced technical knowledge, helping clients navigate complex financial landscapes and achieve their strategic objectives.

company.name: CIBC
company.description: The Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) is one of Canada’s “Big Five” banks, providing retail, commercial, and investment banking services. Headquartered in Toronto and founded in 1867, CIBC serves millions of clients across Canada, the US, and select international markets. The bank offers a full suite of financial services including lending, wealth management, capital markets, and payments. It is also known for its digital banking innovation and cross-border services for North American clients.

company.name: Stone Point Capital
company.description: Stone Point Capital is a US-based private equity firm specialising in financial services investments, including insurance, asset management, fintech, and specialty lending. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, the firm manages capital through its Trident funds and works closely with management teams to grow and transform portfolio companies. Stone Point often pursues platform builds and strategic partnerships, and its network includes longstanding relationships across the financial services ecosystem. The firm’s focused mandate and operational knowledge have made it a key player in sector-specific private equity.

company.name: LLR Partners
company.description: LLR Partners is a Philadelphia-based private equity firm founded in 1999 that focuses on investing in software and tech-enabled companies across the knowledge economy. The firm has raised over $7.5 billion across seven funds and partnered with more than 130 companies to drive growth through flexible capital, strategic guidance, and hands-on value creation.

company.name: Mesirow
company.description: Mesirow is a Chicago-based financial services firm offering investment management, capital markets, and advisory services to institutional, corporate, and individual clients. Founded in 1937, Mesirow is known for its employee-owned structure, client-first philosophy, and commitment to customized solutions. Its offerings include fixed income, currency risk management, investment banking, and retirement advisory. Mesirow combines deep market expertise with a collaborative approach to help clients navigate complex financial landscapes.

company.name: Evercore
company.description: Evercore is a premier global independent investment banking advisory firm, known for advising on complex M&A, capital markets, restructuring, and strategic transactions. Headquartered in New York and founded in 1995, Evercore operates across major financial centres in the Americas, Europe, and Asia. The firm is consistently ranked among the top M&A advisers globally, having advised on some of the largest and most transformative deals in recent decades. Evercore focuses exclusively on advisory—without lending or trading conflicts—positioning itself as a trusted, conflict-free partner to boards, CEOs, and private equity sponsors. The firm also provides institutional equity research and sells insights through its equities division. Known for its talent density, discretion, and analytical rigour, Evercore competes with top-tier Wall Street banks while maintaining an independent, client-focused culture.

company.name: TransMarket Group
company.description: TransMarket Group is a global proprietary trading firm that specializes in quantitative strategies across various asset classes including futures, equities, and options. Founded in 1980 and headquartered in Chicago, the firm utilizes sophisticated mathematical models and high-speed technology to provide liquidity to electronic markets worldwide. It focuses on identifying and capturing price inefficiencies through rigorous data analysis and automated execution. TransMarket Group maintains a reputation for its collaborative culture and its commitment to developing advanced trading infrastructure in an increasingly digitized financial landscape.

company.name: Calibre CPA Group
company.description: Calibre CPA Group is a full service accounting and advisory firm that specializes in serving tax exempt organizations, labor unions, and employee benefit plans. Founded in 1988 and based in Bethesda, Maryland, the firm provides auditing, accounting, and tax compliance services to a wide range of nonprofit entities. Calibre CPA Group is known for its deep expertise in regulatory requirements and its commitment to the specific financial needs of mission driven organizations. The firm emphasizes long term client relationships and provides tailored guidance to help its partners navigate complex financial reporting and compliance landscapes.

company.name: Eastdil Secured
company.description: Eastdil Secured is a leading real estate investment banking firm advising on complex, high-value transactions including investment sales, recapitalisations, debt placements, and joint ventures. Headquartered in New York, it serves institutional investors, REITs, developers, and sovereign wealth funds. The firm is known for its deep market intelligence, longstanding client relationships, and advisory-driven approach in sectors like office, hospitality, logistics, and multifamily. Eastdil bridges commercial real estate expertise with capital markets execution.

company.name: Stephens
company.description: Stephens is a US-based independent financial services firm providing investment banking, research, wealth management, and insurance brokerage. Headquartered in Little Rock, Arkansas, Stephens has a strong presence in the middle market and works with both private and public companies on M&A, equity and debt offerings, and strategic advisory. The firm is known for its family ownership, long-term client focus, and deep sector expertise in areas such as industrials, consumer, and financial services. It maintains a strong commitment to relationship-driven advisory and independent research.

company.name: Moody's
company.description: Moody’s Corporation is a global risk assessment and financial services firm, best known for its credit rating agency, Moody’s Investors Service, and its data and analytics arm, Moody’s Analytics. Headquartered in New York, the company provides credit ratings for corporates, governments, structured finance products, and financial institutions, playing a critical role in global capital markets. Moody’s Analytics offers software, risk modelling, and research to banks, insurers, and asset managers, supporting decision-making in credit, ESG, and regulatory compliance. The firm is recognised for its influence in bond markets and its growing presence in fintech and sustainability-linked data services.

company.name: Quantbot Technologies
company.description: Quantbot Technologies is a quantitative investment firm founded in 2008 that develops fully automated trading strategies using statistical arbitrage, data science, and machine learning. The company operates globally with offices in New York, London, and Hong Kong and focuses on building scalable systems for strategy development, rigorous risk management, and leveraging cloud and large-scale data infrastructure to stay at the cutting edge of quantitative finance.

company.name: Aberdeen Group
company.description: Aberdeen Group is a global investment company headquartered in the UK, offering asset management and financial planning services to a broad client base. The firm, previously known as Standard Life Aberdeen, rebranded in 2021 as part of a shift towards a more digital and modern identity. Aberdeen Group manages a wide range of investment strategies across asset classes, working with both institutional and individual investors.

company.name: Phillips Edison & Company
company.description: Phillips Edison & Company is a real estate investment trust that focuses on the ownership, operation, and management of grocery anchored shopping centers across the United States. Founded in 1991 and headquartered in Cincinnati, the company manages a vast portfolio designed to provide essential goods and services to local communities. The firm leverages deep expertise in retail real estate to drive occupancy and rental growth through proactive property management and strategic redevelopment. Its business model emphasizes a focus on necessity based retail tenants, which helps maintain stable cash flows and long term value for its shareholders.

company.name: DV Trading
company.description: DV Trading is a multi-asset proprietary trading firm headquartered in Chicago, with additional offices in Toronto, London, and Singapore. The firm trades in global futures, options, fixed income, FX, and equities using a mix of quantitative models and discretionary execution. It supports its traders with in-house risk systems, technology infrastructure, and proprietary research tools. DV Trading is known for its agility, flat structure, and strong track record in volatile and fragmented markets, including energy and interest rate derivatives.

company.name: MMB+CO
company.description: MMB+CO is a certified public accounting and consulting firm, offering services in audit, tax, and advisory. Founded in St. Louis, Missouri, the firm serves a diverse client base including businesses, individuals, and nonprofit organizations. MMB+CO is known for its client-centric approach and commitment to providing practical, tailored solutions. It focuses on building strong relationships and delivering comprehensive financial and strategic guidance to help clients achieve their goals.

company.name: Ccaventus
company.description: Caventus, formerly known as Arena Investors, is an institutional alternative asset management firm specialising in private credit, asset-backed lending, structured finance, and opportunistic real estate. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in New York, the firm provides creative financing solutions across global markets on behalf of institutions and high-net-worth investors. It is known for its focus on underserved, asset-intensive niches and its capacity to structure bespoke transactions for complex situations. The firm combines fundamental underwriting with disciplined risk management to originate tailored investments and deliver consistent, risk-adjusted returns.

company.name: MarshBerry
company.description: MarshBerry is a specialized consulting and advisory firm focused on the insurance distribution and wealth management industries. Founded in 1981 and headquartered in Ohio, the company provides merger and acquisition advisory services, organic growth consulting, and capital market solutions. MarshBerry serves insurance agencies, brokerages, and private equity firms by offering data-driven insights and financial benchmarking to improve operational performance. The firm is recognized for its industry expertise and its role in facilitating strategic partnerships that drive professional development and profitability within the insurance sector.

company.name: Global Atlantic
company.description: Global Atlantic Financial Group is a US-based retirement and life insurance company that provides annuities, life insurance, and reinsurance solutions to individuals and institutions. Originally part of Goldman Sachs, it became independent in 2013 and was acquired by KKR in 2021, enhancing its access to capital and long-term investment capabilities. Global Atlantic manages over $100 billion in assets and is known for its innovation in fixed annuities, indexed products, and pension risk transfer (PRT) solutions. It works with institutions such as corporate pension plans, insurance companies, and reinsurers to manage long-duration liabilities. The company also offers retirement income products through a broad distribution network, including independent financial advisers and broker-dealers. Global Atlantic combines actuarial expertise with investment acumen to support retirement security and institutional balance sheet optimisation.

company.name: Abdiel Capital
company.description: Abdiel Capital is a New York-based investment firm that takes a long-term, concentrated approach to public equity investing. The firm typically holds a small number of high-conviction positions, focusing on businesses it believes have strong fundamentals and significant growth potential. Its strategy is driven by in-depth research and a focus on long-term performance.

company.name: MTS Partners
company.description: MTS Health Partners is a New York-based boutique investment bank focused exclusively on the healthcare sector. Founded in 1999, the firm provides strategic and financial advisory services to healthcare companies, including biopharma, medical devices, healthcare services, and digital health. MTS advises on a wide range of transactions, including mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, licensing agreements, and private placements, with a strong emphasis on long-term value creation and strategic fit. The firm is known for its deep sector expertise, independent structure, and senior-led approach, often working closely with management teams, boards, and investors to guide high-impact decisions. By avoiding conflicts from lending or trading activities, MTS maintains a pure advisory model and builds relationships grounded in trust, discretion, and domain knowledge.

company.name: BNP Paribas
company.description: BNP Paribas is one of Europe’s largest banking groups, providing retail, corporate, and investment banking services across more than 70 countries. Headquartered in Paris, it was formed through the merger of Banque Nationale de Paris and Paribas in 2000. The group operates with a strong presence in continental Europe while maintaining global capabilities in capital markets, financing, asset management, and insurance. BNP Paribas is also active in ESG financing and sustainable investment, aligning its services with global climate and development goals.

company.name: KKR
company.description: KKR (Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co.) is a global investment firm headquartered in New York, known for its leadership in private equity and expansion into asset classes including credit, real estate, infrastructure, and insurance. Founded in 1976, KKR manages over $500 billion in assets and serves institutional investors, family offices, and sovereign wealth funds. The firm pioneered the leveraged buyout model and remains highly active in buyouts, growth equity, and platform investments across sectors and geographies. KKR also invests heavily in impact strategies and ESG-aligned portfolios, while its credit division is one of the largest non-bank lenders globally. With a global footprint and a strong operator-focused investment approach, KKR combines capital, operational expertise, and strategic partnerships to drive long-term value creation across public and private markets.

company.name: Optiver
company.description: Optiver is a global proprietary trading firm and market maker headquartered in Amsterdam, with offices in key financial centres including London, Chicago, and Sydney. The firm trades a wide range of financial instruments—including equities, options, futures, and ETFs—across global exchanges, using a combination of quantitative research, low-latency technology, and risk management. Known for providing liquidity and tight spreads, Optiver plays a key role in ensuring efficient and transparent markets. It operates solely with its own capital, and maintains a strong internal culture focused on collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous improvement in both technology and trading strategy.

company.name: Roark Capital Group
company.description: Roark Capital Group is a US-based private equity firm specialising in consumer and franchise-focused businesses. Headquartered in Atlanta, the firm manages over $30 billion in assets and is known for its investments in multi-unit brands, particularly in food, retail, and business services. Its portfolio includes names like Dunkin’, Inspire Brands, and Massage Envy, and it typically takes a long-term approach to value creation through operational improvement and brand expansion. Roark’s investment model is built around supporting experienced management teams and maintaining consistency across customer-facing operations.

company.name: Neuberger Berman
company.description: Neuberger Berman is a US-based, employee-owned investment management firm headquartered in New York, managing a wide range of strategies across equities, fixed income, private equity, hedge funds, and multi-asset solutions. Serving institutional and individual investors globally, the firm is known for its long-term focus, deep research capabilities, and commitment to ESG integration. It offers both traditional and alternative strategies, with particular strength in credit, emerging markets, and customised portfolio solutions. Neuberger Berman places strong emphasis on internal ownership, client alignment, and investment autonomy, and continues to expand its global footprint while maintaining a collaborative and research-driven culture.

company.name: Johnson Lambert
company.description: Johnson Lambert is a leading certified public accounting firm, specializing in audit, tax, and advisory services. Founded in 1982 and with offices across the East Coast, the firm primarily serves clients within the insurance industry and employee benefit plan sectors. It is known for its deep industry specialization, technical expertise, and client centric approach. The firm provides tailored solutions that help clients navigate complex regulatory environments and achieve their financial goals, focusing on quality and responsive service.

company.name: MUFG
company.description: MUFG (Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group) is Japan’s largest financial group and one of the world’s leading banks, offering commercial banking, investment banking, asset management, and leasing services. Headquartered in Tokyo, MUFG has a significant global footprint across Asia, the Americas, and EMEA, serving corporates, governments, and institutions with lending, treasury, capital markets, and advisory services. It is known for its conservative risk profile, strong balance sheet, and role in financing infrastructure, energy, and large-scale projects globally. MUFG has made strategic investments in fintech and ESG-linked lending, and continues to pursue digital transformation across its banking and investment divisions.

company.name: Susquehanna Growth Equity
company.description: Susquehanna Growth Equity is a growth-stage investment firm backing rapidly scaling technology and software companies. Based in the US and part of the Susquehanna International Group, SGE targets capital-efficient businesses in sectors such as fintech, healthcare IT, and vertical SaaS. The firm is known for its long-term, flexible capital and active support model, helping founders accelerate growth without pressure to exit prematurely. SGE emphasizes alignment, data-driven execution, and deep sector knowledge.

company.name: Graham Capital Management
company.description: Graham Capital Management is a leading alternative investment firm specialising in quantitative and discretionary macro strategies across global markets. Founded in 1994 and based in Rowayton, Connecticut, the firm manages capital on behalf of institutional investors, including pension funds, endowments, and sovereign wealth funds. Graham is known for its proprietary trading technology, rigorous research capabilities, and disciplined approach to risk management. It combines systematic models with fundamental human insight to generate uncorrelated returns across fixed income, currency, equity, and commodity markets.

company.name: Ziegler
company.description: Ziegler is a US-based investment bank and asset management firm specialising in sectors such as healthcare, senior living, education, and religious organisations. Headquartered in Chicago, the firm provides capital raising, M&A advisory, and strategic consulting services, particularly to non-profit and mission-driven clients. Ziegler is one of the top underwriters of tax-exempt bonds in the healthcare and senior living space and has been a key player in financing large-scale community development projects. The firm also manages venture capital funds focused on healthcare innovation, and is known for combining financial expertise with deep sector knowledge and social impact focus.

company.name: Flow Traders
company.description: Flow Traders is a global electronic trading firm and liquidity provider, headquartered in Amsterdam with offices across Europe, Asia, and the Americas. The firm specialises in high-frequency and algorithmic trading of exchange-traded products (ETPs), derivatives, and fixed income instruments. It acts as a market maker, ensuring continuous pricing and liquidity across thousands of instruments globally. Flow Traders leverages proprietary technology and low-latency infrastructure to execute trades at high speed, often competing with firms like Optiver and IMC. It is also involved in digital asset trading and has expanded into crypto market making. Flow Traders combines quantitative research, data science, and real-time risk management to optimise market efficiency and maintain a strong presence on over 150 trading venues.

company.name: Berkeley Research Group
company.description: Berkeley Research Group (BRG) is a global consulting firm that provides expert advice in disputes, investigations, corporate finance, and performance improvement. Headquartered in California and founded in 2010, BRG serves law firms, corporations, and government agencies, often in high-stakes or litigation-heavy environments. Its teams include economists, former regulators, forensic specialists, and industry experts. BRG is known for its deep analytical work and credibility in expert testimony, particularly in complex regulatory or financial matters.

company.name: KeyBank
company.description: KeyBank is a US-based regional bank headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, operating as the primary banking subsidiary of KeyCorp. The bank offers a full range of financial services including commercial and retail banking, investment management, and corporate finance to individuals, small businesses, and middle-market clients across 15 states. KeyBank has strong franchises in mortgage lending, equipment finance, and public sector banking, and also operates a growing investment banking division through KeyBanc Capital Markets. The bank is focused on digital transformation and financial inclusion, offering tools for financial wellness and small business growth. It is known for its community engagement, sustainable finance initiatives, and commitment to supporting underbanked populations, while maintaining a strong regional identity and client-centric operating model.

BNP Paribas is also active in ESG financing and sustainable investment, aligning its services with global climate and development goals.

company.name: Waterfall Asset Management
company.description: Waterfall Asset Management is a New York-based alternative investment firm specialising in structured credit, real estate debt, and private equity. The firm manages capital across public and private strategies, often targeting asset-backed securities, loan portfolios, and distressed credit. Waterfall serves institutional investors including pensions, insurers, and endowments, and is known for its deep credit expertise and niche sourcing capabilities. The firm combines bottom-up research with active risk management and focuses on generating consistent, income-driven returns.

company.name: RSM US
company.description: RSM US is the fifth-largest accounting firm in the United States and the US member of RSM International. It provides audit, tax, and consulting services to middle market businesses across industries such as manufacturing, financial services, real estate, and technology. Headquartered in Chicago, RSM US is known for its deep industry knowledge, personalised client relationships, and national reach. The firm also offers digital, risk, and transaction advisory services, and places a strong emphasis on values-led leadership, innovation, and long-term client development. It is a prominent employer of early-career professionals and maintains strong ties with the business community.

company.name: Prairie Capital Advisors
company.description: Prairie Capital Advisors is a financial advisory firm that specializes in employee stock ownership plans, mergers and acquisitions, and corporate valuation services. Founded in 1996 and based in Oakbrook Terrace, Illinois, the firm provides strategic advice to middle market companies throughout the United States. Prairie Capital Advisors focuses on helping business owners navigate complex ownership transitions while implementing succession planning strategies. It is known for its expertise in providing objective financial analysis and helping organizations transition to employee ownership models.

company.name: Qatalyst Partners
company.description: Qatalyst Partners is a leading US-based technology-focused investment bank, advising high-growth and large-cap tech companies on M&A, IPOs, and strategic alternatives. Founded by Frank Quattrone, the firm has built a reputation for its role in many of the tech sector’s most high-profile transactions, including mergers involving LinkedIn, GitHub, and Slack. Headquartered in San Francisco, Qatalyst is known for its discreet, senior-led execution model and its long-standing relationships with the tech industry’s top founders and investors. The firm operates with a focused mandate, typically advising on landmark deals in software, internet, and semiconductor industries.

company.name: PIMCO
company.description: PIMCO (Pacific Investment Management Company) is one of the world’s leading fixed income investment managers, overseeing over $2 trillion in assets for institutions, governments, and individuals globally. Headquartered in Newport Beach, California, the firm offers a wide range of bond strategies, including core fixed income, credit, emerging markets debt, and alternative income. PIMCO is known for its macroeconomic research, active management style, and risk-controlled portfolios. It also operates in real estate, private credit, and ESG-integrated strategies. A subsidiary of Allianz, PIMCO plays a central role in global bond markets and has a strong presence in both public and private asset classes.

company.name: Aeris Partners
company.description: Aeris Partners is a boutique investment bank focused on advising high-growth technology companies. Sixth Street employs a flexible, long-term approach, partnering with companies and management teams to drive growth and create value. The firm has a reputation for its deep sector expertise and its ability to execute complex transactions.

company.name: Davenport & Co.
company.description: Davenport & Co. is a prominent independent financial services firm providing investment management, wealth management, and capital markets services. Founded in 1863 and based in Richmond, Virginia, the firm serves individuals, families, and institutions through a network of regional offices. Davenport & Co. is recognized for its longevity and commitment to a client-first advisory model. It offers personalized financial planning and research-driven investment strategies while maintaining a focus on long-term capital growth and wealth preservation.

company.name: UBS
company.description: UBS is a global financial services firm headquartered in Zurich, offering wealth management, investment banking, asset management, and retail banking. With a particularly strong presence in global wealth management, UBS serves high-net-worth and institutional clients across Europe, the Americas, and Asia-Pacific. The firm also operates a sizeable investment banking division and is active in advisory, capital markets, and equities trading. UBS has placed increased emphasis on sustainable investing, digital innovation, and its integrated client model following its 2023 acquisition of Credit Suisse, reshaping the landscape of European banking.

company.name: Perella Weinberg Partners
company.description: Perella Weinberg Partners is an independent global advisory firm focused on M&A, financial restructuring, and strategic advisory for corporates, institutions, and governments. Headquartered in New York, with offices in London, Houston, San Francisco, and other financial centres, the firm is known for its senior-led model and focus on complex, high-stakes transactions. Its restructuring practice is one of the most prominent in the industry, advising clients through distressed and special situations, while its M&A practice regularly works on cross-border deals and board-level strategy. Perella Weinberg combines deep sector expertise with an emphasis on discretion and unbiased advice.

company.name: Boulay
company.description: Boulay is a professional services firm offering accounting, tax, and advisory solutions to businesses and individuals. Founded in 1934 and headquartered in Minneapolis, the firm serves a diverse range of industries including manufacturing, retail, professional services, and real estate. Boulay is known for its client focused approach and its ability to provide personalized financial guidance alongside technical expertise. It combines a long history of local service with modern strategies to help clients navigate complex tax landscapes, audit requirements, and business growth objectives.

company.name: Orion Group
company.description: Orion Group is a global recruitment and staffing firm specialising in placing professionals across engineering, life sciences, energy, and construction sectors. Founded in Scotland and operating across Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, the company provides permanent and contract workforce solutions to clients in industries undergoing rapid change and large-scale projects. Orion supports major infrastructure, energy transition, and life sciences programmes, supplying technical and managerial talent. It is known for its compliance standards, international mobility support, and ability to manage complex staffing across geographies and regulatory environments.

company.name: Provident Healthcare Partners
company.description: Provident Healthcare Partners is a leading investment banking firm that specializes in mergers and acquisitions advisory services for the healthcare industry. Founded in 1996 and based in Boston, the firm focuses on representing middle market companies across various healthcare sectors including provider services, health technology, and life sciences. Provident Healthcare Partners is known for its deep domain expertise and its ability to navigate complex regulatory landscapes while connecting clients with strategic and private equity buyers. It leverages a boutique approach to provide tailored guidance throughout the transaction process and maintains a consistent track record of executing successful outcomes for healthcare organizations.

company.name: Sands Capital
company.description: Sands Capital is a US-based investment management firm specialising in long-term growth equity strategies. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, it manages concentrated portfolios across public and private markets, focusing on companies with strong competitive advantages and secular growth drivers. Sands Capital serves institutional and individual investors globally and is known for its bottom-up, high-conviction investment style. In addition to public equities, the firm has expanded into venture and private growth investing, targeting innovation-led sectors like technology, healthcare, and consumer. It places strong emphasis on research, portfolio discipline, and sustainability integration.

company.name: Bessemer Venture Partners
company.description: Bessemer Venture Partners is a US-based venture capital firm with a long history of backing early-stage technology companies. Originating in the 1910s as part of a family office and formally becoming a VC firm in the 1970s, Bessemer has since invested in hundreds of startups across sectors including enterprise software, healthcare, fintech, and consumer internet. The firm has offices in Silicon Valley, New York, and internationally, and is known for being an early backer of companies like LinkedIn, Shopify, and Pinterest. Bessemer combines sector-focused investment teams with a strong emphasis on founder support and long-term growth.

company.name: Geneva Trading
company.description: Geneva Trading is a proprietary trading firm headquartered in Chicago, specialising in derivatives, commodities, and foreign exchange markets. The firm operates globally and leverages quantitative strategies, algorithmic execution, and high-speed trading infrastructure to capture market opportunities. Geneva Trading is active in both electronic and voice-brokered markets and trades futures, options, and spot instruments across asset classes including energy, metals, rates, and digital assets. It is known for a flat, entrepreneurial culture and invests heavily in technology and talent development. Geneva supports its traders with in-house risk systems and data science tools, fostering an environment that balances autonomy with robust infrastructure. The firm is a key player in global derivatives liquidity and is growing its footprint across European and Asian markets.

company.name: Enterprise Mobility
company.description: Enterprise Mobility is a global leader in transportation solutions, encompassing car rental, fleet management, car sharing, and truck rental services. Founded in 1957 by Jack C. Taylor and headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, the company serves a wide range of customers from individual travelers to large corporations and government entities. Enterprise Mobility is known for its extensive network, customer service excellence, and a diversified portfolio of brands including Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental, and Alamo. It combines a vast global presence with innovative technology to provide convenient, flexible, and sustainable mobility options across various markets.

company.name: Citi
company.description: Citi (Citigroup Inc.) is a global banking group headquartered in New York, offering a wide range of financial services including consumer banking, corporate lending, wealth management, and investment banking. With operations in over 90 countries, Citi serves governments, corporations, institutions, and individuals worldwide. Its Institutional Clients Group handles global markets, treasury, and advisory services, while its retail banking and cards business is a major player in the US and international consumer finance markets. Citi is also a significant issuer of global bonds and structured finance products.

company.name: InfiniteQuant
company.description: InfiniteQuant is a technology firm that specializes in quantitative trading strategies and algorithmic solutions for financial markets. Based on advanced data modeling and high speed execution, the company develops proprietary software to identify market inefficiencies and capture trading opportunities. It focuses on systematic investment approaches that rely on mathematical research rather than human discretion. By leveraging large datasets and complex statistical analysis, InfiniteQuant provides infrastructure and services designed to optimize trading performance for institutional clients.

company.name: CCK Strategies
company.description: CCK Strategies is a leading accounting and advisory firm, providing comprehensive services in tax, audit, and consulting. Based in Tulsa, Oklahoma, the firm serves a diverse clientele including businesses, individuals, and non-profit organizations across various industries. CCK Strategies is known for its client-centric approach, offering strategic financial guidance and proactive solutions to help clients navigate complex financial landscapes. It combines deep expertise with personalized service, aiming to deliver measurable value and support sustainable growth and compliance.

company.name: Fidelity International
company.description: Fidelity International is a global asset management firm headquartered in London and spun out from its US counterpart in 1969. It serves institutional clients, intermediaries, and individual investors across Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East. The firm offers a wide range of equity, fixed income, multi-asset, and sustainable investment strategies, with a strong focus on fundamental research and long-term value creation. Fidelity International is also a prominent provider of workplace pensions and retirement solutions, particularly in the UK. The firm has embraced ESG integration across its strategies and engages actively with portfolio companies on governance, climate risk, and shareholder responsibility. With a presence in more than 20 countries and significant investment in technology platforms, Fidelity International continues to grow its influence in both developed and emerging markets.

company.name: Standard Chartered
company.description: Standard Chartered is a British multinational bank with a strong emerging markets focus, operating across Asia, Africa, and the Middle East. Headquartered in London with major operations in Singapore and Hong Kong, the bank offers retail, corporate, and institutional banking services, as well as wealth and trade finance. It is particularly active in cross-border transactions, infrastructure finance, and sustainable finance in high-growth markets. Standard Chartered positions itself as a bridge between developed and developing economies, with a growing emphasis on fintech partnerships, digital platforms, and ESG-aligned lending across its global network.

company.name: Verition Fund Management
company.description: Verition is a multi-strategy hedge fund founded in 2008, with offices in Greenwich, Connecticut, and London. The firm operates a platform model, allocating capital to internal portfolio managers who trade across relative value, macro, credit, equities, and event-driven strategies. Verition has grown significantly in recent years, with a focus on attracting experienced PMs and maintaining tight risk controls. The firm is known for its collaborative culture and disciplined capital allocation framework, competing with other top-tier multi-manager platforms.

company.name: Geffen Mesher
company.description: Geffen Mesher is a prominent public accounting and consulting firm based in Portland, Oregon. Founded in 1934, the firm provides a comprehensive range of services including tax planning, audit and assurance, business consulting, and wealth management. It serves a diverse client base ranging from closely held businesses and high net worth individuals to large corporations across various industries. Geffen Mesher is recognized for its commitment to local expertise combined with sophisticated technical knowledge, focusing on long term strategic partnerships to help clients achieve their financial goals.

company.name: Moore Colson
company.description: Moore Colson is a full service accounting and advisory firm headquartered in Atlanta. Founded in 1981, the firm provides services including tax, audit, consulting, and business process outsourcing to a diverse range of clients from small businesses to large corporations. Moore Colson is recognized for its collaborative approach and industry expertise across sectors such as manufacturing, distribution, and real estate. The firm focuses on delivering personalized solutions and strategic guidance to help clients manage financial health and achieve long term growth objectives.

company.name: Rothesay
company.description: Rothesay is a UK-based specialist insurer focused on securing pension liabilities through buy-ins, buyouts, and longevity swaps. Founded in 2007, it manages over £60 billion in assets and provides long-term security for millions of pension scheme members. Rothesay operates as a leading player in the de-risking market, helping corporate pension trustees transfer defined benefit obligations off balance sheet. It is known for its strong actuarial expertise, robust risk management, and focus on long-term financial resilience. The firm invests its capital across a broad portfolio of high-quality, low-risk fixed income and real assets to meet future liabilities.

company.name: Renaissance Strategic Advisors
company.description: Renaissance Strategic Advisors is a specialized management consulting firm focused on the aerospace, defense, and government services sectors. Founded in 2005 and headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, the firm provides strategic advice to corporate leadership and financial sponsors navigating complex defense industrial bases. Renaissance Strategic Advisors is known for its deep sector expertise and analytical approach to market entry, growth strategy, and mergers and acquisitions. It helps clients understand policy trends and competitive dynamics to drive long-term business performance in highly regulated global markets.

company.name: ATLAS SP Partners
company.description: ATLAS SP Partners is a structured credit and fixed income investment firm formed out of the restructured legacy of Credit Suisse’s securitised products group. Backed by Apollo Global Management, it focuses on asset-backed securities, collateralised loan obligations, and other structured instruments. ATLAS SP provides financing and investment solutions to originators and institutional investors, operating with a broad mandate across consumer, real estate, and corporate credit.

company.name: Morgan Stanley
company.description: Morgan Stanley is a global financial services firm headquartered in New York, offering investment banking, wealth management, institutional securities, and asset management services. With a strong presence in both the US and international markets, the firm advises clients on mergers and acquisitions, IPOs, debt and equity financing, and strategic investments. Its institutional arm is active in trading, research, and capital markets, while its wealth management division, bolstered by the acquisition of E*TRADE, serves millions of clients globally. Morgan Stanley is widely regarded for its advisory work with corporates and financial sponsors, and it continues to invest in digital platforms, sustainability, and global expansion to maintain its position as one of the world’s top financial institutions.

company.name: Belvedere Trading
company.description: Belvedere Trading is a prominent proprietary trading firm based in Chicago that specializes in equity index and volatility derivatives. Founded in 2002, the company utilizes sophisticated technology and quantitative analysis to provide liquidity across various financial exchanges. It focuses on market making and arbitrage strategies while maintaining a collaborative culture centered on trading education and risk management. The firm is known for its lean operational structure and its commitment to developing talent through internal training programs in both technology and trading.

company.name: Quantbot Technologies
company.description: Quantbot Technologies is a quantitative investment firm founded in 2008 that develops fully automated trading strategies using statistical arbitrage, data science, and machine learning. The company operates globally with offices in New York, London, and Hong Kong and focuses on building scalable systems for strategy development, rigorous risk management, and leveraging cloud and large-scale data infrastructure to stay at the cutting edge of quantitative finance.

company.name: Capula Investment Management
company.description: Capula Investment Management is a global alternative asset manager specialising in fixed income, macro, and absolute return strategies. Founded in 2005 and headquartered in London, the firm manages capital for institutional investors such as pension funds, endowments, and sovereign wealth funds. Capula’s investment strategies are often focused on interest rate and volatility trading, and it is known for operating with a disciplined, risk-managed approach. The firm also maintains offices in Tokyo, Hong Kong, and New York.

company.name: CIFC Asset Management
company.description: CIFC Asset Management is a leading alternative credit asset manager, specializing in sub-investment grade credit strategies. Founded in 2005 and based in New York, the firm manages capital for institutional investors globally. CIFC focuses primarily on leveraged finance markets, including collateralized loan obligations and opportunistic credit. It is known for its rigorous fundamental credit analysis, active management approach, and commitment to generating alpha. The firm leverages deep research capabilities and a disciplined investment process to identify value across the credit spectrum.

company.name: Hudson River Trading
company.description: Hudson River Trading (HRT) is a quantitative trading firm headquartered in New York City, operating across global financial markets using algorithmic strategies and cutting-edge technology. Founded in 2002, HRT combines expertise in mathematics, computer science, and finance to build models that trade equities, derivatives, and other instruments at high speed and large scale. The firm maintains a flat, research-oriented structure and relies on large-scale simulations, real-time data processing, and proprietary infrastructure to execute trades across hundreds of markets. HRT is known for being secretive, highly competitive, and at the forefront of low-latency and high-frequency trading. It competes with other elite quant firms such as Citadel Securities and Jane Street and attracts top technical talent from academia and industry. HRT also invests in infrastructure development, contributing to open-source tools and operating with a long-term mindset in an industry dominated by short-term opportunities.

company.name: Lloyds Banking Group
company.description: Lloyds Banking Group is one of the UK’s largest financial services institutions, providing banking, insurance, and wealth management services to individuals, businesses, and corporate clients. Headquartered in London and Edinburgh, the group’s major brands include Lloyds Bank, Halifax, Bank of Scotland, and Scottish Widows. It holds a dominant position in UK retail banking, mortgage lending, and current accounts, and also provides commercial banking services to SMEs and large corporates. Following the financial crisis, the group underwent significant restructuring and returned to private ownership in 2017. Today, it is focused on digital transformation, sustainability, and financial inclusion, with a strategic aim to become a UK-focused, customer-centric, low-risk financial services provider.

company.name: JMI Equity
company.description: JMI Equity is a growth equity firm based in Baltimore and San Diego, focused on investing in enterprise software businesses across North America. Founded in 1992, the firm targets companies with proven business models, recurring revenue, and strong management teams, providing both capital and strategic guidance to accelerate growth and scale. JMI typically invests in sectors such as vertical SaaS, cybersecurity, HR tech, healthcare IT, and analytics, and often partners with founder-led companies to support expansion, M&A, and operational improvement. The firm takes minority and majority positions and is known for its long-term investment horizon, deep domain knowledge, and collaborative approach. With a track record of more than 170 investments and numerous successful exits, JMI remains a prominent investor in high-growth B2B software.

company.name: BTIG
company.description: BTIG is a global financial services firm specialising in brokerage, investment banking, trading, and research. Headquartered in New York, the firm serves institutional clients and corporates across equities, fixed income, derivatives, and real estate. BTIG is active in capital raising, M&A advisory, and special situations, with a strong focus on client execution and market access. It maintains offices across the US, Europe, Asia, and Australia, and is known for its fast-growing, high-touch model.

company.name: ITW
company.description: ITW is a global manufacturer of specialized industrial equipment, consumables, and related service businesses. Founded in 1912 and based in Glenview, Illinois, the company operates through several segments including automotive OEM, food equipment, test and measurement, and welding. ITW is known for its decentralized business model and its focus on the 80/20 principle to drive operational efficiency and profitability. The company serves a diverse range of industries worldwide by providing high engineered solutions that improve performance and reliability for its customers.

PwC’s UK member firm is a major employer of graduates and professionals across audit, consulting, and technology functions, while its global network is structured to combine local market expertise with international reach. The firm also invests heavily in upskilling, ESG advisory, and automation, positioning itself at the forefront of industry change.

company.name: Moelis & Co
company.description: Moelis & Company is a global independent investment bank that provides M&A, restructuring, capital markets, and strategic advisory services to clients across sectors and geographies. Headquartered in New York, the firm operates through a network of offices in major financial centres, advising corporates, financial sponsors, and governments on high-stakes transactions. Moelis is particularly active in cross-border M&A, private capital markets, and special situations, with a strong presence in healthcare, technology, consumer, and industrials. The firm is known for its conflict-free model, senior-led execution, and strong culture of client advocacy, often competing directly with larger full-service banks on marquee deals.

company.name: Nomura
company.description: Nomura is a Japanese multinational financial services group headquartered in Tokyo, with operations in investment banking, asset management, and retail brokerage. The firm serves corporates, governments, and institutional clients globally, offering advisory, capital markets, and trading services. Nomura is a market leader in Asia and maintains a growing presence in EMEA and the Americas, with particular strengths in structured finance, macro trading, and cross-border dealmaking. It also provides a wide range of public and private market investment strategies through Nomura Asset Management. The firm blends domestic scale with international ambition, and is actively investing in digital platforms and sustainability-led finance.

company.name: Nonantum Capital Partners
company.description: Nonantum Capital Partners is a Boston-based private equity firm focused on investing in mid-market companies undergoing growth or transition. The firm partners with management teams and founders across industries including consumer, business services, healthcare, and industrials. Nonantum specialises in complex ownership situations, such as corporate carve-outs, family successions, or founder recapitalisations, and provides hands-on support to accelerate growth and operational transformation. The firm’s team brings deep experience from both investing and operating backgrounds, and pursues long-term value creation through a collaborative and flexible investment approach.

company.name: Brinley Partners
company.description: Brinley Partners is an investment firm focused on private credit and alternative fixed income strategies, operating as a subsidiary of MassMutual. The firm provides capital solutions to mid-market businesses, including direct lending, structured credit, and special situations. With a flexible investment mandate, Brinley Partners works with sponsors, corporates, and originators across North America and Europe. It aims to capitalise on inefficiencies in private credit markets through fundamental credit underwriting and tailored deal structuring.

company.name: Citrin Cooperman
company.description: Citrin Cooperman is one of the leading accounting, tax, and business consulting firms in the United States, specialising in assurance, advisory services, and wealth management. Founded in 1979 and based in New York, the firm serves middle-market enterprises, high-net-worth individuals, and private equity sponsors across various sectors. Citrin Cooperman is known for its deep industry expertise, client-first approach, and expansive regional presence. It combines technical proficiency with strategic financial guidance and has a track record of driving sustainable growth for its clients.

company.name: LV Collective
company.description: LV Collective is a premier real estate development firm specializing in student housing, multifamily residential, and mixed-use projects. Founded in 2012 and based in Austin, Texas, the company develops properties across major university markets and high-growth urban centers in the United States. LV Collective is known for its design-forward approach, integrating hospitality-inspired amenities, innovative architecture, and local culture into every project. It combines full-service development expertise with a focus on elevated living experiences to drive sustained value for residents and investment partners alike.

company.name: Freestone Capital Management
company.description: Freestone Capital Management is an independent wealth advisory and asset management firm, specialising in comprehensive financial planning, personalized portfolio management, and alternative investments. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, the firm manages capital on behalf of high-net-worth individuals, families, and business owners. Freestone is known for its fiduciary approach, high-touch client service, and access to proprietary private market opportunities. It combines disciplined asset allocation with specialized private equity and real estate strategies to preserve and grow long-term wealth.

company.name: GTCR
company.description: GTCR is a long-established private equity firm based in Chicago, focused on building growth-oriented companies in partnership with experienced executives. Founded in 1980, the firm is known for its “Leaders Strategy,” which involves identifying attractive sectors and backing management teams to pursue transformational growth through M&A and operational improvement. GTCR primarily targets investments in healthcare, technology, financial services, and business services—sectors where regulation, data, and recurring revenue models create opportunities for value creation. The firm is highly involved in platform building and industry consolidation, often executing multi-year growth strategies alongside its portfolio companies. With a reputation for disciplined investing and deep sector knowledge, GTCR remains a key name in US mid-market private equity.

company.name: Sensiba
company.description: Sensiba is a leading accounting and business consulting firm, specialising in audit, tax, wealth management, and advisory services. Founded in 1977 and based in Northern California, the firm serves privately held companies, non profits, and high net worth individuals. Sensiba is known for its client focused approach, industry expertise, and commitment to technological innovation. It combines comprehensive service offerings with a deep understanding of client needs and has a track record of helping businesses achieve their financial and operational goals.

company.name: Perella Weinberg Partners
company.description: Perella Weinberg Partners is an independent global advisory firm focused on M&A, financial restructuring, and strategic advisory for corporates, institutions, and governments. Headquartered in New York, with offices in London, Houston, San Francisco, and other financial centres, the firm is known for its senior-led model and focus on complex, high-stakes transactions. Its restructuring practice is one of the most prominent in the industry, advising clients through distressed and special situations, while its M&A practice regularly works on cross-border deals and board-level strategy. Perella Weinberg combines deep sector expertise with an emphasis on discretion and unbiased advice.

company.name: DRW
company.description: DRW is a diversified proprietary trading firm headquartered in Chicago, operating at the intersection of trading, technology, and quantitative research. Founded in 1992, the firm trades across asset classes including fixed income, FX, equities, and digital assets, using both systematic and discretionary strategies. DRW also invests in financial market infrastructure and early-stage technologies through its venture arm. Known for its data-centric and collaborative culture, DRW has built a strong global presence in high-frequency and options trading.

company.name: SBF Advisors
company.description: SBF Advisors is a boutique corporate finance and advisory firm based in London, focused on M&A, fundraising, and strategic advisory for high-growth businesses. The firm typically works with technology, media, and consumer companies, often supporting founder-led or private equity-backed clients through growth transactions and exits. SBF Advisors offers hands-on execution and tailored advice, particularly in complex or cross-border deals. Its team brings experience from larger investment banks and combines technical capability with deep sector knowledge, positioning it as a trusted partner for businesses navigating key strategic inflection points.

company.name: Aquatic Capital Management
company.description: Aquatic Capital Management is a Chicago-based quantitative investment firm specializing in systematic strategies that combine rigorous quantitative research, robust software engineering, and disciplined risk management to generate consistent, repeatable returns. Registered with the SEC and CFTC and managing approximately $5.5 billion in assets as of March 2024, the firm advises private funds grouped into structured “master/feeder” models and employs a unified, collaborative approach to trading.

company.name: Cornerstone Research
company.description: Cornerstone Research is a leading economic and financial consultancy that provides expert analysis in litigation and regulatory investigations. Based in the US with offices in major financial and legal hubs, the firm supports law firms and corporations in complex commercial disputes, antitrust matters, securities litigation, and intellectual property cases. Its experts include academic affiliates and in-house economists who produce high-quality reports and testify in court and arbitration settings. Cornerstone is known for its rigorous analysis, strong research standards, and deep experience in financial markets and economics.

company.name: BlackEdge Capital
company.description: BlackEdge Capital is a proprietary trading firm that specializes in volatility-based strategies across global derivatives markets. Founded in 2010 and based in Chicago, the firm focuses on liquidity provision and market making using automated trading systems and quantitative analysis. BlackEdge Capital operates primarily within the equity and index options spaces, leveraging low-latency technology to manage risk and capture market inefficiencies. The firm maintains a lean structure that emphasizes rigorous statistical modeling and high-frequency execution to generate consistent returns in diverse market environments.

company.name: Schneider Downs
company.description: Schneider Downs is a US-based accounting and advisory firm offering audit, tax, technology, and business consulting services to mid-market and enterprise clients. Headquartered in Pittsburgh, the firm serves industries including manufacturing, financial services, real estate, and nonprofits. Schneider Downs also provides cybersecurity, risk advisory, transaction support, and wealth management through affiliated practices. Known for its regional presence and personalised service, the firm balances technical depth with hands-on client relationships and continues to invest in areas like digital transformation and data analytics.

company.name: Moore Colson
company.description: Moore Colson is a full service accounting and advisory firm headquartered in Atlanta. Founded in 1981, the firm provides services including tax, audit, consulting, and business process outsourcing to a diverse range of clients from small businesses to large corporations. Moore Colson is recognized for its collaborative approach and industry expertise across sectors such as manufacturing, distribution, and real estate. The firm focuses on delivering personalized solutions and strategic guidance to help clients manage financial health and achieve long term growth objectives.

company.name: Union Square Advisors
company.description: Union Square Advisors is a US-based investment bank focused on M&A and capital raising for technology companies. Headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, the firm advises public and private tech clients across enterprise software, fintech, and digital media. Union Square is known for working with high-growth and mid-cap firms, often providing founder-focused advisory and strategic positioning for exits or strategic partnerships. It combines deep sector knowledge with hands-on execution and has built strong ties with both strategic acquirers and growth investors.

company.name: Fidelity Investments
company.description: Fidelity Investments is one of the world’s largest asset managers and financial services providers, offering investment management, retirement services, brokerage, and financial planning to individuals, institutions, and advisors. Founded in 1946 and headquartered in Boston, Fidelity manages trillions in client assets across mutual funds, ETFs, and separately managed accounts. The firm is also a major custodian for registered investment advisers (RIAs) and operates one of the largest retail brokerage platforms in the US. Fidelity is known for its strong research capability, investor education tools, and a client-first culture that blends innovation with scale. It has been an early adopter of digital trends including zero-commission trading, fractional shares, and crypto access, while also investing heavily in AI and cloud infrastructure. Fidelity continues to be a dominant force in both institutional and retail investing, driven by long-term thinking and deep operational capacity.

company.name: AlphaSights
company.description: AlphaSights is a global professional services firm that connects business leaders and investment professionals with industry experts to support decision-making through primary research. Headquartered in London, with offices in New York, Dubai, Hong Kong, and other major cities, the firm facilitates one-on-one consultations, expert interviews, and custom knowledge sourcing across virtually every industry. AlphaSights works with private equity firms, strategy consultancies, asset managers, and corporate clients, helping them access timely, specialised insights during due diligence, market entry, or strategic planning. It operates under strict compliance frameworks and is known for its fast-paced culture, client focus, and rapidly growing global footprint.

company.name: Greenhill
company.description: Greenhill is an independent investment bank focused on M&A, restructuring, and capital advisory services for corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. Founded in 1996 and headquartered in New York, the firm operates globally with offices in North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America. Greenhill is known for its conflict-free model, avoiding lending or trading activities to offer clients fully independent strategic advice. It has advised on a wide range of high-profile transactions across sectors including financial services, healthcare, infrastructure, and consumer goods. The firm also maintains a strong presence in restructuring advisory, including both creditor and debtor-side mandates. Greenhill’s lean structure and senior-led execution model appeal to clients seeking discretion and deep expertise. In 2023, it was acquired by Mizuho Financial Group, enabling it to maintain independence while gaining greater access to global capital markets.

company.name: Ares Management
company.description: Ares Management is a global alternative investment firm headquartered in Los Angeles, managing assets across credit, private equity, real estate, and infrastructure. Founded in 1997, the firm has grown significantly, offering a range of strategies to institutional and retail investors. Ares is known for its scale in private credit and direct lending, and for investing across the capital structure of companies in North America, Europe, and Asia. Its integrated platform allows the firm to deploy capital across market cycles and evolving macro conditions.

company.name: Lazard
company.description: Lazard is a global financial advisory and asset management firm known for its independent, client-centric approach to M&A, restructuring, capital markets, and investment strategy. Headquartered in New York and Paris, the firm operates across more than 40 countries and serves corporations, governments, and institutional investors. Lazard’s financial advisory division is one of the most prestigious in the world, regularly advising on complex, high-value transactions, activist defence, and strategic reviews. Its asset management arm offers a broad range of strategies across equities, fixed income, and alternatives, with a strong presence in fundamental research and emerging markets. With roots dating back to the 19th century, Lazard is known for its discretion, deep bench of senior advisers, and emphasis on long-term client relationships across sectors and regions.

company.name: The Riverside Company
company.description: The Riverside Company is a global private equity firm focused on investing in growing businesses at the smaller end of the middle market. Headquartered in New York and Cleveland, the firm targets companies with strong potential for operational improvement, international expansion, and add-on acquisitions. Riverside invests across a variety of sectors, including healthcare, technology, consumer products, and business services. It is known for its hands-on, partnership-driven approach and for supporting portfolio companies with dedicated in-house resources and strategic guidance through growth-focused initiatives.

company.name: Guidehouse
