company.description: TIAA (Teachers Insurance and Annuity Association of America) is a US-based financial services organisation that primarily serves individuals in academic, medical, cultural, and non-profit sectors. Headquartered in New York, it offers retirement plans, asset management, and life insurance, with a strong reputation for low-cost, long-term investment strategies. TIAA is also the parent of Nuveen, which manages a wide range of public and private market investment products. Known for its mission-driven approach and fiduciary standards, TIAA plays a significant role in managing retirement outcomes for millions of educators and professionals across the United States.

company.name: Cohen & Company
company.description: Cohen & Company is a US-based accounting and advisory firm providing audit, tax, and consulting services to public and private companies. Headquartered in Cleveland, the firm serves a wide range of industries with a particular focus on financial services, investment funds, and digital assets. Cohen & Company is known for its technical expertise in SEC reporting, regulated industries, and emerging financial products. It combines a national footprint with a strong emphasis on personalised service and regulatory insight.

company.name: Brown Gibbons Lang & Company
company.description: Brown Gibbons Lang & Company (BGL) is a US-based investment bank specialising in middle-market M&A advisory and capital markets services. Headquartered in Cleveland, with offices across the US, the firm advises both private and public companies on transactions across healthcare, industrials, consumer, and services sectors. BGL offers sell-side and buy-side advisory, debt placement, and financial restructuring. It is known for its sector focus, research-driven process, and access to both domestic and international buyer networks.

company.name: Temasek
company.description: Temasek is a Singapore-based state-owned investment company managing a diversified global portfolio across sectors including financial services, technology, life sciences, and infrastructure. With a long-term, active ownership model, Temasek invests in both listed and unlisted companies, often taking significant strategic stakes. The firm has a strong focus on innovation, sustainable development, and transformation of national and regional economies. Temasek publishes detailed annual reviews and maintains a AAA credit rating, positioning itself as a transparent, forward-looking sovereign investor with a strong presence across Asia and beyond.

company.name: L.E.K. Consulting
company.description: L.E.K. Consulting is a global management consultancy known for its deep analytical approach and focus on strategy, transaction advisory, and performance improvement. Headquartered in Boston and London, the firm operates across the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, advising clients in sectors such as healthcare, consumer, life sciences, industrials, and private equity. L.E.K. supports clients with strategic growth initiatives, pricing optimisation, market entry, and commercial due diligence, often working closely with C-level executives and investment teams. The firm is distinguished by its rigorous problem-solving, data-heavy consulting style, and strong graduate recruitment pipeline. It is particularly active in pre-deal strategy and post-acquisition value creation, making it a trusted adviser to many of the world’s leading private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies.

company.name: Baird
company.description: Baird is a US-based financial services firm offering investment banking, wealth management, asset management, and equity research. Founded in 1919 and headquartered in Milwaukee, Baird is employee-owned and operates with a focus on long-term client relationships. Its investment banking division serves middle-market clients across M&A, capital raising, and financial advisory, while its wealth and asset management arms support individuals and institutions. Baird is known for its collaborative culture, stability, and strong reputation in both advisory and investing services.

company.name: HarbourVest
company.description: HarbourVest is a global private markets investment firm headquartered in Boston, managing more than $100 billion across primary fund investments, secondaries, and direct co-investments. The firm offers clients diversified access to private equity, private credit, infrastructure, and venture capital, supporting both commingled funds and custom mandates. HarbourVest is known for its global reach, data-driven approach, and strong manager relationships, which allow it to source and execute deals across the private markets spectrum. It also invests directly alongside GPs through co-investment programmes and supports clients with detailed reporting and ESG integration. With decades of experience and a wide institutional client base, HarbourVest is a core allocator in the alternatives landscape.

company.name: OC&C
company.description: OC&C is a global strategy consulting firm that works with senior executives on growth, pricing, organisation, and commercial due diligence. Founded in London, it has expanded internationally with offices across Europe, the US, and Asia. The firm focuses on sectors where it has deep expertise, including consumer goods, retail, media, B2B services, and private equity. OC&C is known for its analytical depth, straightforward style, and long-term client relationships. Its private equity practice is particularly active, supporting investors with pre-deal diligence and post-deal value creation. While smaller than the MBB firms, OC&C maintains a focused and high-impact consulting model, valued for its clarity, sector depth, and actionable insight.

company.name: Ensis Partners
company.description: Ensis Partners is a boutique investment banking firm that specializes in providing strategic advisory and capital raising services to middle market companies. Based in London, the firm focuses on mergers and acquisitions, debt advisory, and private capital solutions across a range of sectors. Ensis Partners is recognized for its personalized approach, leveraging deep industry expertise to guide clients through complex financial transactions. It prioritizes long term relationships and tailored execution strategies to help businesses achieve their growth objectives and navigate critical financial milestones.

company.name: Harrison Street
company.description: Harrison Street is a real assets investment manager based in Chicago, specialising in alternative real estate sectors driven by demographic and technological shifts. These include student housing, senior living, medical office, life sciences, storage, and data centres. The firm manages over $50 billion across core, value-add, and opportunistic strategies, with investments in North America and Europe. Harrison Street partners with operators to manage assets efficiently and is committed to sustainability and social impact through its ESG framework. It is one of the most prominent players in non-traditional property investing and continues to grow through new platform strategies and global partnerships.

company.name: Akuna Capital
company.description: Akuna Capital is a proprietary trading firm that focuses on derivatives market making and quantitative trading strategies. Launched in 2011 in Chicago, it leverages in-house technology and data-driven models to trade a range of financial instruments. The firm has expanded globally, with offices in Sydney, Shanghai, and additional locations in the US.

company.name: Musket
company.description: Musket Corporation is a privately held trading and logistics company based in Houston, Texas, focused on petroleum products, natural gas liquids (NGLs), biofuels, and renewable fuels. It is part of the Love’s Family of Companies and serves refiners, retailers, and commercial consumers through a combination of wholesale supply, risk management, and logistics coordination. Musket leverages its access to storage, transport, and distribution infrastructure to manage price volatility and supply chain complexity for its clients. It is active in environmental fuel credits and sustainability-linked fuels and continues to expand its reach in renewable energy markets. The firm plays a niche yet influential role in North American energy trading.

company.name: Kline Hill Partners
company.description: Kline Hill Partners is a private equity firm that focuses on the secondary market for alternative assets. Based in Greenwich, Connecticut, the firm specializes in acquiring portfolios of limited partnership interests in private equity funds from institutional and private investors. It is known for its expertise in smaller, complex transactions and its ability to provide liquidity solutions to diverse market participants. By targeting niche areas of the secondary market, the firm aims to generate risk adjusted returns while offering a streamlined process for buyers and sellers of fund interests.

company.name: Belvedere Trading
company.description: Belvedere Trading is a prominent proprietary trading firm based in Chicago that specializes in equity index and volatility derivatives. Founded in 2002, the company utilizes sophisticated technology and quantitative analysis to provide liquidity across various financial exchanges. It focuses on market making and arbitrage strategies while maintaining a collaborative culture centered on trading education and risk management. The firm is known for its lean operational structure and its commitment to developing talent through internal training programs in both technology and trading.

company.name: Stifel
company.description: Stifel Financial Corp. is a US-based financial services firm offering investment banking, brokerage, and wealth management to individuals and institutions. Headquartered in St. Louis, the firm has a growing global footprint and a strong reputation in middle-market advisory, equity research, and capital markets execution. Stifel’s investment banking division is particularly active in healthcare, technology, and industrials, while its private client group manages significant assets for individuals and family offices. The firm has grown through acquisitions and is known for its integrated approach across research, advisory, and execution.

company.name: Scotiabank
company.description: Scotiabank (The Bank of Nova Scotia) is one of Canada’s Big Five banks and a major financial institution across the Americas. Headquartered in Toronto, it offers retail banking, commercial lending, wealth management, and capital markets services to individuals and institutions. Scotiabank has a strong international footprint, particularly in Latin America and the Caribbean, where it operates under its “International Banking” division. Its global banking and markets arm provides M&A advisory, fixed income, equities, and FX trading. Known for its emerging markets exposure and bilingual North American-LATAM coverage, Scotiabank is focused on digital transformation, inclusion, and sustainable finance.

company.name: Oliver Wyman
company.description: Oliver Wyman is a global management consultancy known for its work in strategy, risk management, and transformation across a wide range of industries. Headquartered in New York and part of Marsh McLennan, the firm operates in over 30 countries and serves clients in financial services, healthcare, automotive, retail, energy, and the public sector. Oliver Wyman combines analytical rigour with industry-specific expertise and has a strong presence in areas such as financial regulation, climate risk, operational resilience, and digital transformation. It is also highly active in advising central banks, fintechs, insurers, and institutional investors on market structure, competition, and strategic positioning. The firm is noted for its fast-paced environment and data-driven approach to complex business problems.

company.name: Perella Weinberg Partners
company.description: Perella Weinberg Partners is an independent global advisory firm focused on M&A, financial restructuring, and strategic advisory for corporates, institutions, and governments. Headquartered in New York, with offices in London, Houston, San Francisco, and other financial centres, the firm is known for its senior-led model and focus on complex, high-stakes transactions. Its restructuring practice is one of the most prominent in the industry, advising clients through distressed and special situations, while its M&A practice regularly works on cross-border deals and board-level strategy. Perella Weinberg combines deep sector expertise with an emphasis on discretion and unbiased advice.

company.name: MTS Partners
company.description: MTS Health Partners is a New York-based boutique investment bank focused exclusively on the healthcare sector. Founded in 1999, the firm provides strategic and financial advisory services to healthcare companies, including biopharma, medical devices, healthcare services, and digital health. MTS advises on a wide range of transactions, including mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, licensing agreements, and private placements, with a strong emphasis on long-term value creation and strategic fit. The firm is known for its deep sector expertise, independent structure, and senior-led approach, often working closely with management teams, boards, and investors to guide high-impact decisions. By avoiding conflicts from lending or trading activities, MTS maintains a pure advisory model and builds relationships grounded in trust, discretion, and domain knowledge.

company.name: LyondellBasell
company.description: LyondellBasell is one of the world’s largest chemical, plastics, and refining companies, specialising in the production of polymers, chemicals, and fuel products. Formed in 2007 and with operational headquarters in Houston and London, the company supplies essential materials to industries such as packaging, automotive, construction, and healthcare. LyondellBasell is known for its proprietary technology licensing, global manufacturing scale, and leadership in polyolefin production. It combines extensive operational capabilities with material science expertise and has a strong focus on developing sustainable and circular plastic solutions.

company.name: M. Klein & Company
company.description: M. Klein & Company is a boutique strategic advisory and investment firm founded by Michael Klein, a former Citigroup executive, known for advising on high-profile M&A transactions and special purpose acquisition companies (SPACs). Based in New York, the firm offers bespoke advice to corporates, sovereign entities, and high-net-worth individuals, with a strong focus on deal structuring, capital markets access, and cross-border advisory. M. Klein & Company gained prominence during the SPAC boom, advising and sponsoring a number of multi-billion-dollar transactions involving high-growth companies and complex valuation scenarios. The firm operates with a lean team and relationship-driven approach, often playing a behind-the-scenes role in transformative corporate deals.

company.name: Rockefeller Capital Management
company.description: Rockefeller Capital Management is a US-based financial advisory and investment firm serving ultra-high-net-worth individuals, family offices, and institutions. Originally part of the Rockefeller family office, the firm relaunched in 2018 as an independent entity offering private wealth management, asset management, strategic advisory, and family office services. It combines traditional financial planning with institutional-grade investment access, focusing on long-term stewardship and multi-generational wealth. Rockefeller Capital Management also emphasises sustainability, philanthropy, and impact investing as part of its holistic client offering, operating with a boutique model supported by national scale.

company.name: Shea & Company
company.description: Shea & Company is a boutique investment bank headquartered in Boston, focused exclusively on software and technology M&A. The firm advises private and public software companies, as well as private equity investors, on buy-side and sell-side transactions. With a research-driven approach and deep sector expertise, Shea & Company often supports vertical and horizontal consolidation plays, growth equity deals, and strategic exits. Its team is known for its disciplined execution and long-term client relationships, operating across enterprise software segments such as SaaS, infrastructure, security, and analytics.

company.name: Pinion
company.description: Pinion is a US-based agricultural consulting and accounting firm offering integrated services to agribusinesses, family farms, and food system enterprises. The firm provides financial planning, tax strategy, estate planning, and business advisory tailored to the needs of producers, landowners, and agri-cooperatives. Pinion also supports clients in succession planning, sustainability reporting, and technology adoption. With offices across rural and agricultural regions of the US, Pinion combines technical accounting with deep industry knowledge, helping clients make informed decisions across volatile commodity and policy environments. Its work spans both traditional farming and increasingly complex agrifood ecosystems.

company.name: PGIM
company.description: PGIM is the global investment management business of Prudential Financial, managing more than $1.2 trillion in assets across public and private markets. Headquartered in Newark, New Jersey, PGIM operates through specialised affiliates including PGIM Fixed Income, PGIM Real Estate, and Jennison Associates, each with its own investment expertise. The firm serves institutional and retail clients worldwide, offering strategies in fixed income, equities, real estate, private credit, and alternatives. PGIM is known for its scale, long-term thinking, and research-led approach to managing portfolios in both traditional and less liquid markets.

company.name: Harris Williams
company.description: Harris Williams is a global investment bank headquartered in Richmond, Virginia, focused exclusively on M&A advisory for middle-market companies. The firm serves both private equity and corporate clients across industries including healthcare, technology, consumer, business services, and industrials. Harris Williams is known for its strong sell-side execution, sector-focused teams, and high-quality marketing materials. The firm operates internationally, with offices across the US and Europe, and is particularly active in transactions involving sponsor-backed businesses. It maintains a strong reputation for process discipline and strategic positioning of assets in competitive sale environments.

company.name: BDO Global
company.description: BDO Global is a network of independent accounting and advisory firms operating in more than 160 countries. The organisation offers audit, tax, advisory, and business services to clients ranging from startups to large corporates and public sector bodies. Founded in 1963, BDO has grown to become one of the largest professional services networks in the world. Its member firms are locally rooted but aligned under shared values and international quality standards, enabling cross-border support for clients navigating global financial, operational, and regulatory challenges.

Its global banking and markets arm provides M&A advisory, fixed income, equities, and FX trading. Known for its emerging markets exposure and bilingual North American-LATAM coverage, Scotiabank is focused on digital transformation, inclusion, and sustainable finance.

company.name: BCG
company.description: Boston Consulting Group (BCG) is one of the world’s leading management consulting firms, known for helping organisations solve complex strategic and operational challenges. Founded in 1963 and headquartered in Boston, BCG works with global corporations, governments, and non-profits across sectors including technology, healthcare, finance, and energy. The firm is known for its deep analytical rigour, innovation-led thinking, and collaborative style. With offices in over 50 countries, BCG plays a key role in shaping business strategy and transformation worldwide.

company.name: Solomon Partners
company.description: Solomon Partners is a US-based investment bank headquartered in New York, known for its advisory work in M&A and restructuring across sectors such as retail, healthcare, technology, media, and industrials. Originally founded in 1989, the firm became an affiliate of Natixis in 2016, expanding its global reach and sector capabilities. Solomon Partners is recognised for its senior-led execution, deep industry expertise, and close client relationships, often advising on complex, high-stakes transactions in competitive sectors. The firm focuses exclusively on advisory, with no lending or trading activity, ensuring an independent approach to dealmaking.

programmes.notes: Apply by sending CV and a cover letter to info@ethicalcapitalpartners.com

company.name: Ethical Capital Partners
company.description: Ethical Capital Partners is a private equity firm focused on investing in companies that demonstrate a commitment to ethical and sustainable business practices. The firm seeks to partner with management teams to improve operational efficiency, drive revenue growth, and enhance long-term value. Ethical Capital Partners differentiates itself by integrating environmental, social, and governance considerations into its investment process. The firm targets investments across various sectors, emphasising businesses with strong potential for positive social and environmental impact.

company.name: Bellwether
company.description: Bellwether is a global advisory firm that provides strategic solutions to help businesses enhance enterprise value and solve complex challenges. Founded to support clients through the entire business lifecycle, the firm specializes in growth strategy execution, transaction management, and operational transformation. Bellwether manages, analyzes, and reports on more than 35 billion dollars in assets under management across a diverse range of real estate and corporate platforms in North America, Europe, and Asia. The firm is privately held and operates out of offices in Los Angeles, Newport Beach, London, and Dallas.

company.name: Bank of America
company.description: Bank of America is one of the largest financial institutions in the world, offering banking, investment, and wealth management services to individuals, businesses, and governments. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, the bank operates across more than 35 countries and serves tens of millions of clients globally. It has a significant presence in consumer banking, corporate and investment banking, and asset management through its Merrill and Private Bank brands. Bank of America plays a central role in US capital markets and is consistently ranked among the world’s systemically important financial institutions.

company.name: BNY Mellon
company.description: BNY Mellon (The Bank of New York Mellon) is a US-based global financial institution specialising in investment servicing and management. Headquartered in New York, the bank was formed in 2007 through the merger of The Bank of New York and Mellon Financial Corporation. It is one of the largest custodians in the world, providing asset servicing, fund administration, and data solutions to institutional clients. BNY Mellon also manages investments across equities, fixed income, and alternatives through its investment arm, offering services in more than 35 countries.

company.name: Scotiabank
company.description: Scotiabank (The Bank of Nova Scotia) is one of Canada’s Big Five banks and a major financial institution across the Americas. Headquartered in Toronto, it offers retail banking, commercial lending, wealth management, and capital markets services to individuals and institutions. Scotiabank has a strong international footprint, particularly in Latin America and the Caribbean, where it operates under its “International Banking” division. Its global banking and markets arm provides M&A advisory, fixed income, equities, and FX trading. Known for its emerging markets exposure and bilingual North American-LATAM coverage, Scotiabank is focused on digital transformation, inclusion, and sustainable finance.

company.name: CliftonLarsonAllen
company.description: CliftonLarsonAllen (CLA) is a US-based professional services firm providing audit, tax, and advisory services to privately held businesses, public sector entities, and individuals. Headquartered in Minnesota, CLA operates over 100 offices across the United States and serves a broad range of industries including healthcare, construction, nonprofit, and agribusiness. The firm offers personalised service and industry-specific insight, with a focus on owner-managed businesses and long-term client relationships.

company.name: Affinius Capital
company.description: Affinius Capital is a prominent investment manager focused on commercial real estate equity and debt. Formed in 2022 by the merger of USAA Real Estate and Square Mile Capital, the firm is based in New York and San Antonio. It manages capital for institutional investors, high net worth individuals, and family offices across a broad range of investment strategies. Affinius Capital is known for its deep sector expertise, integrated platform, and comprehensive suite of solutions across various property types. The firm combines a strong understanding of market fundamentals with robust underwriting to deliver value and build long term relationships.

company.name: Raymond James
company.description: Raymond James is a US-headquartered financial services firm providing investment banking, wealth management, asset management, and capital markets services. With a strong network of independent financial advisers and offices across North America and Europe, the firm serves individual investors, corporates, and institutions. Its investment banking arm advises on middle-market M&A, debt and equity financing, and strategic transactions across a range of sectors. Raymond James is known for its decentralised structure, long-term focus, and client-centric culture, and maintains a strong reputation among private wealth clients and family businesses.

company.name: Elixirr
company.description: Elixirr is a London-based management consultancy known for its entrepreneurial approach to business strategy, transformation, and innovation. Founded in 2009 and publicly listed, the firm serves clients across financial services, retail, tech, and healthcare, blending consulting with direct investment through its "House of Brands." Elixirr focuses on helping corporates compete with startups by bringing digital agility and challenger thinking. It has grown rapidly through a mix of organic growth and acquisitions, and maintains offices in Europe, the US, and Africa.

company.name: Bracebridge Capital
company.description: Bracebridge Capital is a Boston-based hedge fund that manages assets for endowments, foundations, and other institutional clients. Founded in 1994 by Nancy Zimmerman, the firm is known for its conservative, risk-aware investment approach and its focus on absolute return strategies. Bracebridge invests across fixed income, sovereign debt, derivatives, and event-driven strategies, with a strong emphasis on liquidity and downside protection. It maintains a low profile in the industry but is considered one of the most consistent performers in the alternative asset management space.

company.name: Morgan Stanley
company.description: Morgan Stanley is a global financial services firm headquartered in New York, offering investment banking, wealth management, institutional securities, and asset management services. With a strong presence in both the US and international markets, the firm advises clients on mergers and acquisitions, IPOs, debt and equity financing, and strategic investments. Its institutional arm is active in trading, research, and capital markets, while its wealth management division, bolstered by the acquisition of E*TRADE, serves millions of clients globally. Morgan Stanley is widely regarded for its advisory work with corporates and financial sponsors, and it continues to invest in digital platforms, sustainability, and global expansion to maintain its position as one of the world’s top financial institutions.

company.name: Bellwether
company.description: Bellwether is a global advisory firm that provides strategic solutions to help businesses enhance enterprise value and solve complex challenges. Founded to support clients through the entire business lifecycle, the firm specializes in growth strategy execution, transaction management, and operational transformation. Bellwether manages, analyzes, and reports on more than 35 billion dollars in assets under management across a diverse range of real estate and corporate platforms in North America, Europe, and Asia. The firm is privately held and operates out of offices in Los Angeles, Newport Beach, London, and Dallas.

company.name: TransMarket Group
company.description: TransMarket Group is a global proprietary trading firm that specializes in quantitative strategies across various asset classes including futures, equities, and options. Founded in 1980 and headquartered in Chicago, the firm utilizes sophisticated mathematical models and high-speed technology to provide liquidity to electronic markets worldwide. It focuses on identifying and capturing price inefficiencies through rigorous data analysis and automated execution. TransMarket Group maintains a reputation for its collaborative culture and its commitment to developing advanced trading infrastructure in an increasingly digitized financial landscape.

company.name: Qatalyst Partners
company.description: Qatalyst Partners is a leading US-based technology-focused investment bank, advising high-growth and large-cap tech companies on M&A, IPOs, and strategic alternatives. Founded by Frank Quattrone, the firm has built a reputation for its role in many of the tech sector’s most high-profile transactions, including mergers involving LinkedIn, GitHub, and Slack. Headquartered in San Francisco, Qatalyst is known for its discreet, senior-led execution model and its long-standing relationships with the tech industry’s top founders and investors. The firm operates with a focused mandate, typically advising on landmark deals in software, internet, and semiconductor industries.

company.name: Jump Trading
company.description: Jump Trading is a proprietary trading firm and technology company based in Chicago, known for its expertise in algorithmic and high-frequency trading across global financial markets. Founded in 1999, the firm trades a broad range of asset classes including equities, fixed income, futures, options, and cryptocurrencies, operating on over 100 exchanges worldwide. Jump places a strong emphasis on quantitative research, advanced hardware and software development, and low-latency infrastructure, competing with firms such as DRW, Citadel Securities, and Jane Street. It is also involved in crypto through Jump Crypto, a dedicated division focused on trading, venture investments, and protocol development. The firm is privately held and secretive, known for its flat structure, highly selective hiring, and deep investment in proprietary technology and applied science.

company.name: Vista Equity Partners
company.description: Vista Equity Partners is a US-based private equity firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Vista manages a large portfolio of companies through its flagship private equity, credit, and permanent capital strategies. The firm is known for its operational playbook and active approach to scaling B2B software businesses. Vista partners with management teams to accelerate growth, improve efficiency, and drive product innovation, and is considered one of the leading tech-focused investment firms globally.

company.name: General Atlantic
company.description: General Atlantic is a leading global growth equity firm that partners with high-growth companies across technology, consumer, healthcare, and financial services. Founded in 1980 and headquartered in New York, the firm manages over $70 billion in assets and operates with a long-term, research-driven investment approach. General Atlantic typically invests in later-stage growth companies with strong competitive positioning, helping them scale through strategic guidance, international expansion, and operational support. The firm is known for backing category leaders such as ByteDance, Duolingo, Slack, and Klarna, and it often works closely with founders and CEOs as a hands-on minority investor. With a global presence spanning six continents, General Atlantic combines local insight with global connectivity and deep sector expertise to support innovation and sustainable growth.

company.name: Citi
company.description: Citi (Citigroup Inc.) is a global banking group headquartered in New York, offering a wide range of financial services including consumer banking, corporate lending, wealth management, and investment banking. With operations in over 90 countries, Citi serves governments, corporations, institutions, and individuals worldwide. Its Institutional Clients Group handles global markets, treasury, and advisory services, while its retail banking and cards business is a major player in the US and international consumer finance markets. Citi is also a significant issuer of global bonds and structured finance products.

company.name: Weiss Asset Management
company.description: Weiss Asset Management is a Boston-based hedge fund and investment firm known for its global, multi-strategy approach. Founded in the early 1990s, the firm uses a mix of quantitative analysis, fundamental research, and arbitrage strategies to uncover opportunities across global equity and credit markets. Weiss manages capital for institutional investors including pensions, endowments, and foundations, and places strong emphasis on intellectual rigour, data-driven decision-making, and risk control. The firm maintains a low public profile but is widely respected for its research capabilities and contrarian investment style.

company.name: TD Securities
company.description: TD Securities is the investment banking and capital markets arm of Toronto-Dominion Bank, offering services in M&A advisory, equity and debt underwriting, global markets, and risk management. With operations in Canada, the US, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, the firm serves corporate, institutional, and government clients. TD Securities has strong franchises in fixed income, currencies, and commodities trading, and is also active in syndicated lending and infrastructure finance. It is known for its stability, cross-border execution, and growing capabilities in sustainable finance and ESG-linked transactions.

company.name: Stellex
company.description: Stellex is a private equity firm focused on investments in middle-market companies undergoing operational or financial transitions. With offices in New York and London, the firm invests across sectors including industrials, manufacturing, aerospace, defence, and transportation. Stellex typically targets complex or special situations where it can drive value through operational improvement, strategic repositioning, or carve-outs. The firm takes an active approach, working closely with management teams to stabilise and grow portfolio companies, often in capital-intensive or cyclical industries.

company.name: Maven Securities
company.description: Maven Securities is a proprietary trading firm based in London, specialising in options market-making and quantitative trading across global derivatives and equity markets. The firm operates on major exchanges in Europe, Asia, and the US, using advanced technology and data analytics to provide liquidity and capture short-term inefficiencies. Maven combines research, software development, and risk management in a flat, collaborative structure, attracting talent from both academia and industry. It trades a wide array of products, including ETFs, volatility instruments, and index options, and has a growing presence in crypto derivatives. The firm is known for its low-profile culture, fast-paced trading environment, and commitment to continuous improvement through experimentation and analysis.

company.name: Raine Group
company.description: The Raine Group is a global merchant bank focused on technology, media, telecoms, and sports, offering M&A advisory, capital raising, and principal investing. Headquartered in New York, with offices in London, San Francisco, Mumbai, and Shanghai, the firm is known for advising on high-profile transactions involving digital content, gaming, and entertainment rights. Raine also operates growth equity funds that invest in sectors like esports, streaming platforms, and sports franchises. The firm has built a strong reputation for its access to founders, cultural relevance, and strategic execution in fast-evolving industries.

company.name: Dodge & Cox
company.description: Dodge & Cox is a long-established investment management firm based in San Francisco, known for its disciplined, value-driven approach to equity and fixed income investing. Founded in 1930, the firm offers a suite of mutual funds and separately managed accounts for institutions and individuals. Dodge & Cox maintains a low-cost structure, long-term horizon, and collaborative research process that focuses on identifying fundamentally strong companies trading at attractive valuations. The firm is employee-owned and maintains high client alignment and stability.

company.name: Insight Partners
company.description: Insight Partners is a New York-based global venture capital and private equity firm that invests in high-growth technology and software companies. Founded in 1995, the firm has backed over 750 companies across stages and geographies, offering capital as well as operational support through its dedicated ScaleUp platform. Insight is particularly active in enterprise SaaS, cybersecurity, fintech, and dev tools, and is known for helping businesses accelerate growth, professionalise operations, and prepare for strategic exits. The firm takes both minority and control positions and is often a long-term partner throughout multiple funding rounds. With offices in North America and Europe, Insight has built a reputation for founder-friendly investing, data-driven decision-making, and deep expertise in scaling B2B software businesses into global leaders.

company.name: BlackEdge Capital
company.description: BlackEdge Capital is a proprietary trading firm that specializes in volatility-based strategies across global derivatives markets. Founded in 2010 and based in Chicago, the firm focuses on liquidity provision and market making using automated trading systems and quantitative analysis. BlackEdge Capital operates primarily within the equity and index options spaces, leveraging low-latency technology to manage risk and capture market inefficiencies. The firm maintains a lean structure that emphasizes rigorous statistical modeling and high-frequency execution to generate consistent returns in diverse market environments.

company.name: Northborne Partners
company.description: Northborne Partners is a US-based boutique investment bank headquartered in Minneapolis, specialising in M&A advisory services for founder- and family-owned businesses. The firm focuses on the lower middle market, working across a range of industries including industrials, consumer, business services, and healthcare. Northborne provides both sell-side and buy-side advisory, with a focus on privately held businesses seeking strategic growth, succession planning, or liquidity events. It is known for its relationship-driven approach, tailored execution, and deep experience in navigating complex, privately negotiated transactions.

company.name: PEAK6
company.description: PEAK6 is a financial services and investment firm that focuses on options trading, proprietary technology, and strategic investments. Founded in 1997 and based in Chicago, the firm utilizes advanced quantitative models and proprietary software to provide liquidity and manage risk across global capital markets. PEAK6 operates across several sectors, including financial technology, insurance, and sports management. The firm is known for its data driven approach to decision making and its history of fostering innovation by integrating technology into diverse business lines to create competitive advantages.

company.name: Long Ridge
company.description: Long Ridge Equity Partners is a US-based private equity firm focused on growth investments in financial services, technology, and business services companies. Headquartered in New York, the firm typically partners with founder-led or entrepreneur-owned businesses, offering capital and strategic support to scale operations, expand into new markets, and enhance product capabilities. Long Ridge takes a thematic approach to investing, with particular interest in vertical SaaS, payments infrastructure, wealthtech, and compliance technologies. It is known for its collaborative style, strong industry networks, and ability to support companies through growth transitions without imposing rigid control structures. The firm’s portfolio includes a mix of bootstrapped success stories and high-growth platforms backed by deep sector expertise.

company.name: Scotiabank
company.description: Scotiabank (The Bank of Nova Scotia) is one of Canada’s Big Five banks and a major financial institution across the Americas. Headquartered in Toronto, it offers retail banking, commercial lending, wealth management, and capital markets services to individuals and institutions. Scotiabank has a strong international footprint, particularly in Latin America and the Caribbean, where it operates under its “International Banking” division. Its global banking and markets arm provides M&A advisory, fixed income, equities, and FX trading. Known for its emerging markets exposure and bilingual North American-LATAM coverage, Scotiabank is focused on digital transformation, inclusion, and sustainable finance.

company.name: Wells Fargo
company.description:
Wells Fargo is one of the largest financial institutions in the world, with more than $2.1 trillion in assets and over 200,000 employees globally. Within Corporate & Investment Banking, the firm serves approximately 15,000 clients and lends to 70% of the S&P 500, helping companies raise capital, finance growth, manage risk and execute strategic transactions.

The business has built significant momentum in recent years. Between 2019 and 2025, Banking revenue increased by 35%, Markets revenue grew by 48%, and Commercial Real Estate revenue rose by 28%. The firm has also climbed league tables across investment banking, markets and commercial real estate, establishing itself as one of the strongest growth stories on Wall Street.

For students interested in financial services, Wells Fargo offers exposure to a franchise that combines scale, capital strength and an expanding market presence. Analysts work alongside teams advising on major acquisitions, capital raises, financing transactions and risk management solutions for some of the world's largest companies and investors.

company.name: BlackRock
company.description: BlackRock is the world’s largest asset manager, overseeing trillions in assets across index funds, ETFs, active strategies, and alternatives. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in New York, the firm serves institutional, corporate, and retail investors worldwide. Its product suite includes iShares, the world’s most widely used ETF platform, and Aladdin, its proprietary risk and portfolio management system. BlackRock plays a major role in global capital markets, with influence over long-term investment trends, ESG integration, and financial technology innovation.

company.name: Advantage Capital
company.description: Advantage Capital is a leading impact investment firm specializing in growth capital, small business lending, and renewable energy financing. Founded in 1992 and based in New Orleans, the firm provides debt and equity financing to businesses located in underserved and economically distressed communities. Advantage Capital is known for its focus on job creation, regional economic development, and leveraging public-private partnerships. It combines flexible capital solutions with a mission-driven investment strategy and has a track record of fostering sustainable growth in overlooked markets.

company.name: SBF Advisors
company.description: SBF Advisors is a boutique corporate finance and advisory firm based in London, focused on M&A, fundraising, and strategic advisory for high-growth businesses. The firm typically works with technology, media, and consumer companies, often supporting founder-led or private equity-backed clients through growth transactions and exits. SBF Advisors offers hands-on execution and tailored advice, particularly in complex or cross-border deals. Its team brings experience from larger investment banks and combines technical capability with deep sector knowledge, positioning it as a trusted partner for businesses navigating key strategic inflection points.

company.name: Abdiel Capital
company.description: Abdiel Capital is a New York-based investment firm that takes a long-term, concentrated approach to public equity investing. The firm typically holds a small number of high-conviction positions, focusing on businesses it believes have strong fundamentals and significant growth potential. Its strategy is driven by in-depth research and a focus on long-term performance.

company.name: Global Atlantic
company.description: Global Atlantic Financial Group is a US-based retirement and life insurance company that provides annuities, life insurance, and reinsurance solutions to individuals and institutions. Originally part of Goldman Sachs, it became independent in 2013 and was acquired by KKR in 2021, enhancing its access to capital and long-term investment capabilities. Global Atlantic manages over $100 billion in assets and is known for its innovation in fixed annuities, indexed products, and pension risk transfer (PRT) solutions. It works with institutions such as corporate pension plans, insurance companies, and reinsurers to manage long-duration liabilities. The company also offers retirement income products through a broad distribution network, including independent financial advisers and broker-dealers. Global Atlantic combines actuarial expertise with investment acumen to support retirement security and institutional balance sheet optimisation.

company.name: Armanino
company.description: Armanino is a US-based accounting and consulting firm providing audit, tax, and advisory services to clients ranging from early-stage companies to established enterprises. Headquartered in California, it has grown into one of the top independent firms in the country, with particular strength in technology, nonprofit, and cannabis sectors. Armanino also offers consulting in areas like digital transformation, M&A, and ESG strategy, supporting businesses through periods of change and growth. It blends traditional financial services with forward-thinking advisory work.

company.name: Truist
company.description: Truist Financial Corporation is a US-based bank formed from the 2019 merger of BB&T and SunTrust, creating one of the largest financial institutions in the country. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, Truist offers a wide range of retail, commercial, and wealth management services across the southeastern and mid-Atlantic US. It also operates a corporate and investment banking division, serving middle-market and institutional clients. Truist focuses on combining digital innovation with a community banking model, and has continued to invest in technology, inclusion initiatives, and financial wellness platforms.

company.name: LionTree
company.description: LionTree is a global investment and merchant banking firm headquartered in New York, specialising in the technology, media, and telecommunications (TMT) sectors. The firm advises corporates, entrepreneurs, and private equity sponsors on M&A, capital raising, and strategic partnerships, and is known for its deep industry relationships and thematic insight into digital transformation. LionTree has worked on some of the most high-profile TMT transactions in recent years, and also operates a merchant banking arm that invests directly in clients and sector opportunities. The firm is recognised for its relationship-driven model, long-term advisory approach, and thought leadership, including its Kindred Media platform. With offices in New York, San Francisco, London, and Paris, LionTree plays a significant role in shaping strategy and capital flows in the global media and tech ecosystem.

company.name: Marshall Wace
company.description: Marshall Wace is a London-based hedge fund and one of Europe’s largest alternative asset managers, specialising in long/short equity strategies and systematic investing. The firm manages over $60 billion across a range of strategies including its flagship TOPS (Trade Optimised Portfolio System), which aggregates fundamental insights from a network of external managers. Marshall Wace is known for its innovation in data science, quantitative finance, and portfolio construction, and has a global presence with offices in London, New York, and Hong Kong. The firm maintains a flexible, performance-driven culture and is selective in capital allocation, often focusing on scalable, repeatable sources of alpha with strong risk controls.

company.name: State Street
company.description: State Street Corporation is a US-based financial services firm providing custody, investment servicing, asset management, and data analytics to institutional investors worldwide. Headquartered in Boston, State Street is one of the world’s largest custodians, with over $40 trillion in assets under custody and administration. Its investment arm, State Street Global Advisors, is a major passive asset manager and the creator of the SPDR ETF family. The firm also offers technology and data services through State Street Alpha, supporting asset managers and owners with front-to-back investment lifecycle tools. State Street plays a central role in financial infrastructure, particularly for pensions, sovereign wealth funds, and asset managers.

company.name: Evercore
company.description: Evercore is a premier global independent investment banking advisory firm, known for advising on complex M&A, capital markets, restructuring, and strategic transactions. Headquartered in New York and founded in 1995, Evercore operates across major financial centres in the Americas, Europe, and Asia. The firm is consistently ranked among the top M&A advisers globally, having advised on some of the largest and most transformative deals in recent decades. Evercore focuses exclusively on advisory—without lending or trading conflicts—positioning itself as a trusted, conflict-free partner to boards, CEOs, and private equity sponsors. The firm also provides institutional equity research and sells insights through its equities division. Known for its talent density, discretion, and analytical rigour, Evercore competes with top-tier Wall Street banks while maintaining an independent, client-focused culture.

company.name: FTI Consulting
company.description: FTI Consulting is a global business advisory firm that helps organisations manage risk, navigate change, and resolve complex challenges. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., the firm operates in over 30 countries and offers services across five key segments: Corporate Finance & Restructuring, Forensic & Litigation Consulting, Economic Consulting, Strategic Communications, and Technology. FTI is widely known for its work in legal disputes, crisis management, and financial investigations, often supporting law firms, boards, and governments during high-profile events such as regulatory actions, mergers, bankruptcies, and cyber incidents. Its experts include former regulators, bankers, economists, journalists, and technologists who bring cross-functional insight to complex matters. FTI is also active in sectors like energy, healthcare, financial services, and media, and is frequently retained in litigation support and expert testimony roles.

company.name: Stephens
company.description: Stephens is a US-based independent financial services firm providing investment banking, research, wealth management, and insurance brokerage. Headquartered in Little Rock, Arkansas, Stephens has a strong presence in the middle market and works with both private and public companies on M&A, equity and debt offerings, and strategic advisory. The firm is known for its family ownership, long-term client focus, and deep sector expertise in areas such as industrials, consumer, and financial services. It maintains a strong commitment to relationship-driven advisory and independent research.

company.name: PSP Investments
company.description: Public Sector Pension Investment Board (PSP Investments) is one of Canada’s largest pension investment managers, overseeing over C$200 billion in assets for federal public service employees, the Canadian Forces, and the Royal Canadian Mounted Police. Headquartered in Montreal, with global offices in London, New York, and Hong Kong, PSP invests across public equities, private equity, infrastructure, credit, natural resources, and real estate. The organisation takes a long-term, active approach, often pursuing direct and co-investment opportunities. PSP is known for its global diversification, in-house expertise, and focus on responsible investing and climate-related financial risk.

company.name: Schneider Downs
company.description: Schneider Downs is a US-based accounting and advisory firm offering audit, tax, technology, and business consulting services to mid-market and enterprise clients. Headquartered in Pittsburgh, the firm serves industries including manufacturing, financial services, real estate, and nonprofits. Schneider Downs also provides cybersecurity, risk advisory, transaction support, and wealth management through affiliated practices. Known for its regional presence and personalised service, the firm balances technical depth with hands-on client relationships and continues to invest in areas like digital transformation and data analytics.

company.name: Five Rings
company.description: Five Rings is a proprietary trading firm and quantitative research house headquartered in New York City. Founded in 2006, the firm trades globally across a wide range of asset classes including equities, commodities, currencies, and fixed income—using both discretionary and algorithmic strategies. It operates with a flat, team-based structure and is known for its collaborative culture, high-calibre technical talent, and emphasis on innovation. Five Rings relies on sophisticated modelling, real-time data analysis, and proprietary trading infrastructure to identify and capture inefficiencies in global markets. The firm is highly secretive but is widely recognised within the quant trading community for its performance and rigorous hiring standards, often competing with the likes of Jane Street, Hudson River Trading, and Citadel.

company.name: Scotiabank
company.description: Scotiabank (The Bank of Nova Scotia) is one of Canada’s Big Five banks and a major financial institution across the Americas. Headquartered in Toronto, it offers retail banking, commercial lending, wealth management, and capital markets services to individuals and institutions. Scotiabank has a strong international footprint, particularly in Latin America and the Caribbean, where it operates under its “International Banking” division. Its global banking and markets arm provides M&A advisory, fixed income, equities, and FX trading. Known for its emerging markets exposure and bilingual North American-LATAM coverage, Scotiabank is focused on digital transformation, inclusion, and sustainable finance.

company.name: Leerink Partners
company.description: Leerink Partners is a healthcare-focused investment bank based in Boston, providing advisory, equity research, and capital markets services to clients across biotech, medtech, diagnostics, and healthcare services. Now part of SVB Securities, the firm has built a strong reputation for its scientific depth, investor access, and transaction execution in one of the most complex and dynamic sectors in finance. Leerink advises growth-stage and publicly listed healthcare companies on IPOs, follow-ons, M&A, and strategic partnerships, and maintains one of the top-ranked healthcare equity research teams in the US. The firm is widely respected by life sciences CEOs, venture capitalists, and institutional investors, and plays a central role in helping companies navigate the regulatory, scientific, and market risks associated with healthcare innovation.

company.name: Bending Spoons
company.description: Bending Spoons is a Milan-based technology company focused on developing mobile apps and digital products across health, creativity, and productivity. Founded in 2013, the company has become one of Europe’s top app developers by global downloads. Its portfolio includes widely used apps for photo editing, fitness, document scanning, and AI-enhanced tools. Bending Spoons is known for its high standards in product design, in-house engineering, and a culture that emphasises innovation and speed.

company.name: Warburg Pincus
company.description: Warburg Pincus is a leading global private equity firm with a long-standing focus on growth investing. Founded in 1966 and headquartered in New York, the firm manages over $80 billion in assets across sectors including technology, healthcare, energy, financial services, and real estate. Warburg Pincus partners with founders and management teams to support strategic growth, global expansion, and operational excellence. The firm operates with a flexible, long-term approach, and maintains a global network of offices across major financial markets.

company.name: Ducera Partners
company.description: Ducera Partners is a boutique investment bank based in New York, focused on complex advisory assignments in restructuring, M&A, recapitalisation, and special situations. Founded in 2015 by senior dealmakers from top Wall Street firms, Ducera operates across sectors and capital structures, serving both companies and creditor groups. The firm is frequently retained for large Chapter 11 processes, liability management, and capital structure optimisation. Its approach is highly analytical, conflict-free, and senior-led.

company.name: Appian
company.description: Appian is a software company that provides a low-code platform for building enterprise applications and automating complex business processes. Founded in 1999 and based in Virginia, the company focuses on helping organizations unify their data and streamline operations through automation and artificial intelligence. Appian is known for its ability to integrate disparate systems and create scalable solutions for large enterprises and government agencies. It combines workflow management, process mining, and data fabric technology to help businesses accelerate digital transformation and improve operational efficiency.

company.name: AEW Capital Management
company.description: AEW Capital Management is a global real estate investment firm managing assets on behalf of institutional investors, including pension funds, insurers, and sovereign wealth funds. Founded in 1981 in Boston, the firm invests across office, residential, industrial, and retail sectors through a mix of direct investments, joint ventures, and listed vehicles. AEW operates in North America, Europe, and Asia, and is known for integrating research, market analytics, and local expertise into its investment process. Its platform spans both core and opportunistic strategies, managing capital across economic cycles.

company.name: Guggenheim Partners
company.description: Guggenheim Partners is a diversified global financial services firm offering investment management, investment banking, and insurance services, with over $300 billion in assets under management. Headquartered in New York and Chicago, Guggenheim serves institutional clients including pension funds, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, and governments. It is particularly known for its strength in fixed income and structured credit, and for developing innovative solutions in areas like infrastructure financing and private placements. Its investment banking division, Guggenheim Securities, provides M&A and capital markets advisory with a strong presence in healthcare, tech, and media. The firm combines a long-term, research-led investment philosophy with a flexible capital approach, and continues to expand its reach into alternative investments and sustainable finance.

company.name: Performance Trust Capital Partners
company.description: Performance Trust Capital Partners is a specialized investment firm focused on fixed income and advisory services for community financial institutions. Founded in 1994 and based in Chicago, the firm provides investment banking, capital markets, and strategic balance sheet management solutions to banks and credit unions. It is known for its proprietary analytical approach, which emphasizes bond portfolio optimization and the strategic deployment of capital. Performance Trust focuses on helping its clients improve long term financial performance through education, data driven insights, and disciplined investment strategies.

company.name: Houlihan Lokey
company.description: Houlihan Lokey is a global investment bank headquartered in Los Angeles, specialising in M&A advisory, capital markets, financial restructuring, and valuation services. The firm is widely recognised for its leading role in middle-market transactions and has consistently ranked as the top global M&A advisor by volume. In restructuring, Houlihan Lokey is a dominant player, often advising both creditors and debtors on high-profile bankruptcies and distressed situations. It also has one of the largest dedicated financial valuation teams globally, supporting litigation, tax, and financial reporting mandates. With offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, the firm serves public and private companies, financial sponsors, and government entities. Houlihan Lokey’s sector coverage spans consumer, healthcare, tech, energy, and industrials, and it is particularly known for its rigorous analytics, high-touch advisory model, and long-term client relationships.

company.name: Grant Thornton
company.description: Grant Thornton is one of the world’s leading networks of independent audit, tax, and advisory firms, serving clients in over 140 countries. The UK member firm, Grant Thornton UK LLP, is one of the largest in the network and provides services to mid-market businesses, large corporates, public sector organisations, and not-for-profits. The firm is known for its strengths in audit, corporate finance, forensic accounting, and restructuring, with growing capabilities in ESG, digital transformation, and cyber risk. Grant Thornton positions itself as a challenger to the Big Four, offering high partner access, commercial insight, and a collaborative style tailored to growth-focused clients. It is also a major player in private business advisory, particularly for family-owned companies and PE-backed firms. The network’s shared values of transparency and trust underpin its cross-border collaboration and sector-led client service model.

company.name: Anthelion Capital
company.description: Anthelion Capital is a merchant banking and investment firm that focuses on the media, entertainment, and technology sectors. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Los Angeles, the firm provides advisory services alongside direct principal investments. It operates at the intersection of creative content and capital, helping clients navigate complex strategic transactions, capital raises, and corporate restructurings. Anthelion Capital is recognized for its specialized industry expertise and its ability to connect media companies with institutional investors to facilitate growth and long term value creation.

company.name: Guidehouse
company.description: Guidehouse is a global consulting firm that advises public sector bodies, regulated industries, and private companies on strategy, risk, operations, and technology. Created from PwC’s former US public sector business and strengthened by its acquisition of Navigant, Guidehouse has become a major player in advisory work across healthcare, energy, national security, and financial services. The firm provides support on issues like digital transformation, ESG reporting, cybersecurity, and compliance, working with both government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. Known for its blend of mission-driven consulting and commercial execution, Guidehouse offers multidisciplinary teams with deep regulatory and sector experience. It is especially active in advising on energy transition, public health infrastructure, and financial crime risk management.

company.name: Agentis Capital
company.description: Agentis Capital is a financial advisory firm focused on infrastructure finance, project development, and mid-market transactions. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Canada, it advises on public-private partnerships and large-scale investments in transport, energy, and social infrastructure. With offices in Toronto, Vancouver, London, and Mumbai, the firm serves clients globally across both public and private sectors.

company.name: Ares Management
company.description: Ares Management is a global alternative investment firm headquartered in Los Angeles, managing assets across credit, private equity, real estate, and infrastructure. Founded in 1997, the firm has grown significantly, offering a range of strategies to institutional and retail investors. Ares is known for its scale in private credit and direct lending, and for investing across the capital structure of companies in North America, Europe, and Asia. Its integrated platform allows the firm to deploy capital across market cycles and evolving macro conditions.

company.name: Abrams Bison Investments
company.description: Abrams Bison Investments is an investment firm focused on long term equity positions in public companies. Founded in 1999 and based in New York, the firm employs a concentrated value investing strategy that emphasizes deep fundamental research and high conviction ideas. It seeks to identify undervalued businesses with strong management teams and durable competitive advantages. The firm manages capital for institutional clients and focuses on maintaining a disciplined approach to capital allocation while holding investments for extended periods to maximize growth.

company.name: UBS
company.description: UBS is a global financial services firm headquartered in Zurich, offering wealth management, investment banking, asset management, and retail banking. With a particularly strong presence in global wealth management, UBS serves high-net-worth and institutional clients across Europe, the Americas, and Asia-Pacific. The firm also operates a sizeable investment banking division and is active in advisory, capital markets, and equities trading. UBS has placed increased emphasis on sustainable investing, digital innovation, and its integrated client model following its 2023 acquisition of Credit Suisse, reshaping the landscape of European banking.

company.name: PwC
company.description: PwC (PricewaterhouseCoopers) is one of the world’s largest professional services networks, providing audit, tax, consulting, and deals advisory services to clients across sectors. Operating in over 150 countries, the firm works with multinational corporations, governments, and private enterprises on matters ranging from digital transformation and regulatory compliance to mergers, restructuring, and sustainability strategy. PwC’s UK member firm is a major employer of graduates and professionals across audit, consulting, and technology functions, while its global network is structured to combine local market expertise with international reach. The firm also invests heavily in upskilling, ESG advisory, and automation, positioning itself at the forefront of industry change.

company.name: Citadel
company.description: Citadel is a global financial institution operating one of the world’s largest and most successful hedge funds, alongside a leading market-making business through Citadel Securities. Founded in 1990 by Kenneth Griffin and headquartered in Miami, the firm manages capital across equities, credit, commodities, and global macro strategies. Citadel is known for its research-intensive, data-driven approach and emphasis on risk management. It attracts top talent in quantitative research, software engineering, and investment analysis across its global offices.

company.name: Connor Group
company.description: Connor Group is a professional services firm focused on financial consulting for high-growth and pre-IPO companies. Based in California, the firm advises on technical accounting, IPO readiness, finance transformation, and transaction support. Its clients range from venture-backed startups to Fortune 500 companies, particularly in technology, life sciences, and consumer industries. Connor Group is known for helping companies navigate rapid growth and public market transitions with deep expertise in complex accounting standards and operational scaling.

company.name: Roark Capital Group
company.description: Roark Capital Group is a US-based private equity firm specialising in consumer and franchise-focused businesses. Headquartered in Atlanta, the firm manages over $30 billion in assets and is known for its investments in multi-unit brands, particularly in food, retail, and business services. Its portfolio includes names like Dunkin’, Inspire Brands, and Massage Envy, and it typically takes a long-term approach to value creation through operational improvement and brand expansion. Roark’s investment model is built around supporting experienced management teams and maintaining consistency across customer-facing operations.

company.name: Santander
company.description: Banco Santander is a global banking group headquartered in Spain, with a strong presence in Europe, Latin America, and the US. It offers a broad range of retail, commercial, and investment banking services, serving individuals, SMEs, corporates, and institutions. Santander is one of the largest banks in the eurozone by market capitalisation and assets, with major operations in markets like Brazil, Spain, the UK, and Mexico. The bank is focused on digitalisation, efficiency, and inclusive banking, and is investing heavily in fintech, sustainability, and global transaction services. It operates both through local brands and its unified global platform.

company.name: Protiviti
company.description: Protiviti is a global consulting firm providing internal audit, risk, technology, and business performance services to clients across industries. Headquartered in California and operating as a subsidiary of Robert Half, the firm serves multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector organisations. Protiviti advises on areas such as cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, data analytics, process improvement, and digital transformation. It is known for blending risk management with operational insight, supporting clients through major change initiatives and long-term planning. The firm operates across North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific, with a strong emphasis on governance and technology integration.

company.name: MUFG
company.description: MUFG (Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group) is Japan’s largest financial group and one of the world’s leading banks, offering commercial banking, investment banking, asset management, and leasing services. Headquartered in Tokyo, MUFG has a significant global footprint across Asia, the Americas, and EMEA, serving corporates, governments, and institutions with lending, treasury, capital markets, and advisory services. It is known for its conservative risk profile, strong balance sheet, and role in financing infrastructure, energy, and large-scale projects globally. MUFG has made strategic investments in fintech and ESG-linked lending, and continues to pursue digital transformation across its banking and investment divisions.

company.name: GIC
company.description: GIC is Singapore’s sovereign wealth fund, responsible for managing the city-state’s foreign reserves with a long-term, global investment mandate. Established in 1981, GIC invests across asset classes including public equities, fixed income, private equity, real estate, infrastructure, and venture capital. With a presence in key financial hubs including New York, London, San Francisco, Beijing, and São Paulo, GIC takes a highly diversified and research-driven approach, focusing on sustainable returns over decades. The firm is known for its disciplined portfolio construction, rigorous risk management, and strong in-house macroeconomic research. GIC is also a leading investor in technology and emerging markets, and has significantly increased its focus on sustainability, climate risk, and corporate governance as part of its investment strategy. It operates independently from the Singapore government but is ultimately accountable to the Ministry of Finance.

company.name: JMI Equity
company.description: JMI Equity is a growth equity firm based in Baltimore and San Diego, focused on investing in enterprise software businesses across North America. Founded in 1992, the firm targets companies with proven business models, recurring revenue, and strong management teams, providing both capital and strategic guidance to accelerate growth and scale. JMI typically invests in sectors such as vertical SaaS, cybersecurity, HR tech, healthcare IT, and analytics, and often partners with founder-led companies to support expansion, M&A, and operational improvement. The firm takes minority and majority positions and is known for its long-term investment horizon, deep domain knowledge, and collaborative approach. With a track record of more than 170 investments and numerous successful exits, JMI remains a prominent investor in high-growth B2B software.

company.name: Blackstone
company.description: Blackstone is one of the world’s leading investment firms, specialising in private equity, real estate, credit, and infrastructure. Founded in 1985 and based in New York, the firm manages capital on behalf of pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, and individual investors. Blackstone is known for its scale, global reach, and ability to take large, complex positions across industries. It combines deep operational support with financial engineering and has a track record of building value in both private and public market investments.

company.name: AQR Capital Management
company.description: AQR Capital Management is a global investment management firm known for its quantitative, research-driven approach to asset management. Founded in 1998 and headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, AQR applies academic and data-intensive methods to invest across a range of asset classes including equities, fixed income, commodities, and alternative strategies. The firm serves institutional investors, financial advisors, and sovereign wealth funds worldwide. AQR is particularly recognized for its expertise in factor investing, risk premia strategies, and portfolio construction techniques rooted in financial economics. With a strong emphasis on transparency and systematic investing, AQR maintains close ties to academic research and regularly publishes white papers and thought leadership. The firm operates offices in London, Hong Kong, and Sydney, and is known for its rigorous intellectual culture, long-term perspective, and disciplined risk management.
