company.name: Bank of America
company.description: Bank of America is one of the largest financial institutions in the world, offering banking, investment, and wealth management services to individuals, businesses, and governments. Headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, the bank operates across more than 35 countries and serves tens of millions of clients globally. It has a significant presence in consumer banking, corporate and investment banking, and asset management through its Merrill and Private Bank brands. Bank of America plays a central role in US capital markets and is consistently ranked among the world’s systemically important financial institutions.

company.name: Cornerstone Research
company.description: Cornerstone Research is a leading economic and financial consultancy that provides expert analysis in litigation and regulatory investigations. Based in the US with offices in major financial and legal hubs, the firm supports law firms and corporations in complex commercial disputes, antitrust matters, securities litigation, and intellectual property cases. Its experts include academic affiliates and in-house economists who produce high-quality reports and testify in court and arbitration settings. Cornerstone is known for its rigorous analysis, strong research standards, and deep experience in financial markets and economics.

company.name: Long Ridge
company.description: Long Ridge Equity Partners is a US-based private equity firm focused on growth investments in financial services, technology, and business services companies. Headquartered in New York, the firm typically partners with founder-led or entrepreneur-owned businesses, offering capital and strategic support to scale operations, expand into new markets, and enhance product capabilities. Long Ridge takes a thematic approach to investing, with particular interest in vertical SaaS, payments infrastructure, wealthtech, and compliance technologies. It is known for its collaborative style, strong industry networks, and ability to support companies through growth transitions without imposing rigid control structures. The firm’s portfolio includes a mix of bootstrapped success stories and high-growth platforms backed by deep sector expertise.

company.name: Shell
company.description: Shell is one of the world’s largest energy companies, specialising in the exploration, production, refining, and marketing of oil and natural gas. Formed in 1907 and headquartered in London, the company operates across dozens of countries, supplying fuel, chemicals, and electricity to consumers and businesses globally. Shell is known for its vast operational scale, extensive retail network, and leading position in liquefied natural gas. It combines deep engineering expertise with global supply chains and is increasingly investing in renewable energy and low-carbon solutions.

company.name: Freestone Capital Management
company.description: Freestone Capital Management is an independent wealth advisory and asset management firm, specialising in comprehensive financial planning, personalized portfolio management, and alternative investments. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, the firm manages capital on behalf of high-net-worth individuals, families, and business owners. Freestone is known for its fiduciary approach, high-touch client service, and access to proprietary private market opportunities. It combines disciplined asset allocation with specialized private equity and real estate strategies to preserve and grow long-term wealth.

company.name: Santander
company.description: Banco Santander is a global banking group headquartered in Spain, with a strong presence in Europe, Latin America, and the US. It offers a broad range of retail, commercial, and investment banking services, serving individuals, SMEs, corporates, and institutions. Santander is one of the largest banks in the eurozone by market capitalisation and assets, with major operations in markets like Brazil, Spain, the UK, and Mexico. The bank is focused on digitalisation, efficiency, and inclusive banking, and is investing heavily in fintech, sustainability, and global transaction services. It operates both through local brands and its unified global platform.

company.name: The McLean Group
company.description: The McLean Group is an investment bank and financial advisory firm that provides mergers and acquisitions services, strategic advice, and valuation expertise to middle market companies. Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, the firm focuses on sectors such as aerospace, defense, government services, and technology. The company specializes in assisting business owners with liquidity events, capital raises, and corporate divestitures. It is recognized for its industry focused approach and its ability to connect private companies with strategic buyers and private equity investors.

company.name: The Riverside Company
company.description: The Riverside Company is a global private equity firm focused on investing in growing businesses at the smaller end of the middle market. Headquartered in New York and Cleveland, the firm targets companies with strong potential for operational improvement, international expansion, and add-on acquisitions. Riverside invests across a variety of sectors, including healthcare, technology, consumer products, and business services. It is known for its hands-on, partnership-driven approach and for supporting portfolio companies with dedicated in-house resources and strategic guidance through growth-focused initiatives.

company.name: Starwood Capital Group
company.description: Starwood Capital Group is a US-based private investment firm focused on global real estate, energy infrastructure, and private equity. Founded by Barry Sternlicht and headquartered in Miami Beach, the firm manages tens of billions in assets across residential, hospitality, office, and retail sectors. Starwood is known for opportunistic, value-driven investing, often acquiring and repositioning distressed or underperforming assets. It also runs publicly traded REITs and has significant exposure to hotel chains, logistics, and real estate-backed credit strategies. The firm combines real estate operating expertise with global investment reach and often takes a hands-on approach to asset development and management.

company.name: Anthelion Capital
company.description: Anthelion Capital is a merchant banking and investment firm that focuses on the media, entertainment, and technology sectors. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Los Angeles, the firm provides advisory services alongside direct principal investments. It operates at the intersection of creative content and capital, helping clients navigate complex strategic transactions, capital raises, and corporate restructurings. Anthelion Capital is recognized for its specialized industry expertise and its ability to connect media companies with institutional investors to facilitate growth and long term value creation.

company.name: LionTree
company.description: LionTree is a global investment and merchant banking firm headquartered in New York, specialising in the technology, media, and telecommunications (TMT) sectors. The firm advises corporates, entrepreneurs, and private equity sponsors on M&A, capital raising, and strategic partnerships, and is known for its deep industry relationships and thematic insight into digital transformation. LionTree has worked on some of the most high-profile TMT transactions in recent years, and also operates a merchant banking arm that invests directly in clients and sector opportunities. The firm is recognised for its relationship-driven model, long-term advisory approach, and thought leadership, including its Kindred Media platform. With offices in New York, San Francisco, London, and Paris, LionTree plays a significant role in shaping strategy and capital flows in the global media and tech ecosystem.

company.name: Musket
company.description: Musket Corporation is a privately held trading and logistics company based in Houston, Texas, focused on petroleum products, natural gas liquids (NGLs), biofuels, and renewable fuels. It is part of the Love’s Family of Companies and serves refiners, retailers, and commercial consumers through a combination of wholesale supply, risk management, and logistics coordination. Musket leverages its access to storage, transport, and distribution infrastructure to manage price volatility and supply chain complexity for its clients. It is active in environmental fuel credits and sustainability-linked fuels and continues to expand its reach in renewable energy markets. The firm plays a niche yet influential role in North American energy trading.

company.name: ZS
company.description: ZS is a global professional services firm that provides consulting, technology, and analytics solutions primarily for life sciences and healthcare clients. Headquartered in Evanston, Illinois, the firm works with pharmaceutical companies, biotech firms, medtech manufacturers, and healthcare providers to solve complex business challenges in areas such as market access, patient engagement, clinical development, and commercial strategy. ZS integrates consulting with data science, AI, and custom software development, supporting clients through every stage of the product lifecycle. With over 35 offices worldwide, ZS is known for its analytical depth, collaborative culture, and continued expansion into digital health and value-based care.

company.name: Invesco
company.description: Invesco is a global independent investment management firm headquartered in Atlanta, managing over $1.4 trillion in assets across equity, fixed income, alternatives, and multi-asset strategies. With offices in more than 20 countries, the firm serves institutional clients, financial intermediaries, and retail investors through a diverse set of investment vehicles, including ETFs, mutual funds, and private market solutions. Invesco owns well-known brands such as Invesco QQQ, Perpetual (in the UK), and Invesco Real Estate, and offers ESG-integrated and thematic strategies tailored to evolving investor preferences. The firm is known for combining local investment expertise with a global distribution platform, and it places a strong focus on technology-enabled client experience, active stewardship, and product innovation. Invesco has a broad client base and continues to grow its presence in retirement, wealth, and institutional markets.

company.name: Geneva Trading
company.description: Geneva Trading is a proprietary trading firm headquartered in Chicago, specialising in derivatives, commodities, and foreign exchange markets. The firm operates globally and leverages quantitative strategies, algorithmic execution, and high-speed trading infrastructure to capture market opportunities. Geneva Trading is active in both electronic and voice-brokered markets and trades futures, options, and spot instruments across asset classes including energy, metals, rates, and digital assets. It is known for a flat, entrepreneurial culture and invests heavily in technology and talent development. Geneva supports its traders with in-house risk systems and data science tools, fostering an environment that balances autonomy with robust infrastructure. The firm is a key player in global derivatives liquidity and is growing its footprint across European and Asian markets.

company.name: Stone Point Capital
company.description: Stone Point Capital is a US-based private equity firm specialising in financial services investments, including insurance, asset management, fintech, and specialty lending. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, the firm manages capital through its Trident funds and works closely with management teams to grow and transform portfolio companies. Stone Point often pursues platform builds and strategic partnerships, and its network includes longstanding relationships across the financial services ecosystem. The firm’s focused mandate and operational knowledge have made it a key player in sector-specific private equity.

company.name: Schneider Downs
company.description: Schneider Downs is a US-based accounting and advisory firm offering audit, tax, technology, and business consulting services to mid-market and enterprise clients. Headquartered in Pittsburgh, the firm serves industries including manufacturing, financial services, real estate, and nonprofits. Schneider Downs also provides cybersecurity, risk advisory, transaction support, and wealth management through affiliated practices. Known for its regional presence and personalised service, the firm balances technical depth with hands-on client relationships and continues to invest in areas like digital transformation and data analytics.

company.name: Bessemer Venture Partners
company.description: Bessemer Venture Partners is a US-based venture capital firm with a long history of backing early-stage technology companies. Originating in the 1910s as part of a family office and formally becoming a VC firm in the 1970s, Bessemer has since invested in hundreds of startups across sectors including enterprise software, healthcare, fintech, and consumer internet. The firm has offices in Silicon Valley, New York, and internationally, and is known for being an early backer of companies like LinkedIn, Shopify, and Pinterest. Bessemer combines sector-focused investment teams with a strong emphasis on founder support and long-term growth.

company.name: Piper Sandler
company.description: Piper Sandler is a US-based investment bank focused on the middle market, providing M&A advisory, equity and debt capital markets services, and institutional brokerage. Headquartered in Minneapolis, the firm works with clients across healthcare, consumer, energy, financial services, and technology sectors. Piper Sandler is particularly active in advising growth companies and private equity sponsors on strategic transactions and public offerings. It is known for its industry expertise, research capabilities, and strong client relationships, and continues to expand through acquisitions and sector-focused growth. The firm operates internationally, with a growing presence in Europe and Asia.

company.name: Five Rings
company.description: Five Rings is a proprietary trading firm and quantitative research house headquartered in New York City. Founded in 2006, the firm trades globally across a wide range of asset classes including equities, commodities, currencies, and fixed income—using both discretionary and algorithmic strategies. It operates with a flat, team-based structure and is known for its collaborative culture, high-calibre technical talent, and emphasis on innovation. Five Rings relies on sophisticated modelling, real-time data analysis, and proprietary trading infrastructure to identify and capture inefficiencies in global markets. The firm is highly secretive but is widely recognised within the quant trading community for its performance and rigorous hiring standards, often competing with the likes of Jane Street, Hudson River Trading, and Citadel.

company.name: Gunvor
company.description: Gunvor is one of the world’s largest independent commodities trading houses, with a focus on energy and energy transition markets. Headquartered in Geneva, with trading hubs in Singapore, London, and Houston, Gunvor trades crude oil, refined products, natural gas, and power, as well as metals and renewables. The company integrates logistics, storage, and shipping capabilities with sophisticated market analytics to optimize global supply chains. In recent years, Gunvor has significantly expanded its investments in low-carbon energy and sustainability initiatives.

company.name: SMBC
company.description: Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (SMBC) is a major Japanese bank and part of the SMBC Group, offering a broad range of corporate, investment, and retail banking services. Headquartered in Tokyo, SMBC has a global presence, particularly in Asia, the Americas, and EMEA. The bank provides services in project finance, trade finance, syndicated lending, and capital markets, with a strong reputation in infrastructure and energy financing. It works with multinational corporates, financial institutions, and public sector entities, and has expanded its footprint in sustainable finance, ESG advisory, and cross-border investment solutions.

company.name: D.E. Shaw
company.description: The D.E. Shaw Group is a global investment and technology development firm known for its quantitative and discretionary investment strategies. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in New York, it manages capital across hedge fund, private credit, and venture strategies for institutional investors. D.E. Shaw combines advanced mathematical modelling, data science, and proprietary technology in its investment approach, and attracts talent from both financial and scientific backgrounds. The firm is one of the most prominent quantitative hedge funds in the industry.

company.name: Barclays
company.description: Barclays is a British multinational bank offering retail, corporate, and investment banking services across the UK and globally. With roots dating back to 1690, it has played a central role in the evolution of modern banking. Headquartered in London, the firm is a major player in global capital markets, advising on M&A, underwriting debt and equity, and providing financing solutions. Its retail and commercial divisions serve millions of customers, while its investment bank operates across Europe, the Americas, Asia, and the Middle East.

company.name: Quantbot Technologies
company.description: Quantbot Technologies is a quantitative investment firm founded in 2008 that develops fully automated trading strategies using statistical arbitrage, data science, and machine learning. The company operates globally with offices in New York, London, and Hong Kong and focuses on building scalable systems for strategy development, rigorous risk management, and leveraging cloud and large-scale data infrastructure to stay at the cutting edge of quantitative finance.

company.name: AgWest Farm Credit
company.description: AgWest Farm Credit is a leading agricultural lending cooperative, providing a full range of financial services exclusively to farmers, ranchers, timber producers, and agribusinesses. As part of the nationwide Farm Credit System, it operates as a member-owned organization, with a core mission to support the vitality of agriculture and rural communities across its extensive service territory. AgWest offers specialized solutions including real estate loans, operating capital, equipment financing, and crop insurance. The cooperative is known for its deep expertise in agricultural finance, its commitment to building long term relationships, and its crucial role in providing reliable, tailored capital to the agricultural industry.

company.name: CBIZ
company.description: CBIZ is a leading national provider of financial, tax, and advisory services, along with benefits and HR solutions. Founded in 1996 and headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, the firm serves a diverse client base that includes small and mid-sized businesses, as well as individuals. CBIZ is recognized for its integrated approach, combining local market expertise with extensive national resources to deliver comprehensive solutions. It aims to help clients manage their finances, grow their businesses, and maximize their human capital effectively.

company.name: TD Securities
company.description: TD Securities is the investment banking and capital markets arm of Toronto-Dominion Bank, offering services in M&A advisory, equity and debt underwriting, global markets, and risk management. With operations in Canada, the US, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, the firm serves corporate, institutional, and government clients. TD Securities has strong franchises in fixed income, currencies, and commodities trading, and is also active in syndicated lending and infrastructure finance. It is known for its stability, cross-border execution, and growing capabilities in sustainable finance and ESG-linked transactions.

company.name: AArete
company.description: AArete is a global management and technology consulting firm, specialising in data-driven operational performance, digital transformation, and strategic cost reduction. AArete is known for its proprietary analytics tools, industry expertise, and ability to execute complex strategic initiatives. It combines advanced data insights with actionable consulting and has a track record of driving sustainable profitability and operational efficiency for organizations worldwide.

The firm is known for its data driven approach to asset management and its expertise in navigating the specialized needs of the collegiate housing sector.

company.name: Federated Insurance
company.description: Federated Insurance is a commercial insurance provider that specializes in serving specific industries such as manufacturing, equipment dealers, and contractors. Founded in 1904 and based in Owatonna, Minnesota, the company provides property and casualty coverage, workers compensation, and risk management services. It operates primarily in the United States and emphasizes a consultative approach to helping businesses identify and mitigate potential hazards. The company is structured as a mutual organization, which focuses on long term stability and support for its policyholders rather than outside shareholders.

company.name: Raymond James
company.description: Raymond James is a US-headquartered financial services firm providing investment banking, wealth management, asset management, and capital markets services. With a strong network of independent financial advisers and offices across North America and Europe, the firm serves individual investors, corporates, and institutions. Its investment banking arm advises on middle-market M&A, debt and equity financing, and strategic transactions across a range of sectors. Raymond James is known for its decentralised structure, long-term focus, and client-centric culture, and maintains a strong reputation among private wealth clients and family businesses.

company.name: Berkeley Research Group
company.description: Berkeley Research Group (BRG) is a global consulting firm that provides expert advice in disputes, investigations, corporate finance, and performance improvement. Headquartered in California and founded in 2010, BRG serves law firms, corporations, and government agencies, often in high-stakes or litigation-heavy environments. Its teams include economists, former regulators, forensic specialists, and industry experts. BRG is known for its deep analytical work and credibility in expert testimony, particularly in complex regulatory or financial matters.

company.name: PNC
company.description: PNC Financial Services is a diversified financial services institution headquartered in the United States, providing a broad range of banking, asset management, and corporate finance services to individuals, small businesses, and large corporates. The firm operates through key segments including retail banking, corporate and institutional banking, and asset management, offering products such as lending, treasury management, capital markets advisory, and investment services. PNC serves clients across various industries, supporting activities such as day-to-day banking, expansion financing, and strategic transactions, and is known for its strong regional presence, disciplined risk management, and focus on long-term client relationships.

company.name: DV Trading
company.description: DV Trading is a multi-asset proprietary trading firm headquartered in Chicago, with additional offices in Toronto, London, and Singapore. The firm trades in global futures, options, fixed income, FX, and equities using a mix of quantitative models and discretionary execution. It supports its traders with in-house risk systems, technology infrastructure, and proprietary research tools. DV Trading is known for its agility, flat structure, and strong track record in volatile and fragmented markets, including energy and interest rate derivatives.

company.name: Kearney
company.description: Kearney is a global management consulting firm that provides strategic and operational advice to corporations, governments, and non-profits across industries. Founded in 1926 and headquartered in Chicago, the firm operates in more than 40 countries and is known for its collaborative culture, deep sector expertise, and focus on implementation. Kearney advises clients on supply chain optimisation, digital transformation, procurement, sustainability, and organisational change, often combining analytical frameworks with hands-on delivery. The firm works with C-suite executives to design and execute transformation programmes and is especially active in manufacturing, energy, life sciences, and consumer industries. Kearney places strong emphasis on people development, diversity, and innovation, and continues to invest in digital tools, proprietary data, and sustainability-focused consulting practices.

company.name: LyondellBasell
company.description: LyondellBasell is one of the world’s largest chemical, plastics, and refining companies, specialising in the production of polymers, chemicals, and fuel products. Formed in 2007 and with operational headquarters in Houston and London, the company supplies essential materials to industries such as packaging, automotive, construction, and healthcare. LyondellBasell is known for its proprietary technology licensing, global manufacturing scale, and leadership in polyolefin production. It combines extensive operational capabilities with material science expertise and has a strong focus on developing sustainable and circular plastic solutions.

company.name: Agentis Capital
company.description: Agentis Capital is a financial advisory firm focused on infrastructure finance, project development, and mid-market transactions. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Canada, it advises on public-private partnerships and large-scale investments in transport, energy, and social infrastructure. With offices in Toronto, Vancouver, London, and Mumbai, the firm serves clients globally across both public and private sectors.

company.name: Grant Thornton
company.description: Grant Thornton is one of the world’s leading networks of independent audit, tax, and advisory firms, serving clients in over 140 countries. The UK member firm, Grant Thornton UK LLP, is one of the largest in the network and provides services to mid-market businesses, large corporates, public sector organisations, and not-for-profits. The firm is known for its strengths in audit, corporate finance, forensic accounting, and restructuring, with growing capabilities in ESG, digital transformation, and cyber risk. Grant Thornton positions itself as a challenger to the Big Four, offering high partner access, commercial insight, and a collaborative style tailored to growth-focused clients. It is also a major player in private business advisory, particularly for family-owned companies and PE-backed firms. The network’s shared values of transparency and trust underpin its cross-border collaboration and sector-led client service model.

company.name: Waterfall Asset Management
company.description: Waterfall Asset Management is a New York-based alternative investment firm specialising in structured credit, real estate debt, and private equity. The firm manages capital across public and private strategies, often targeting asset-backed securities, loan portfolios, and distressed credit. Waterfall serves institutional investors including pensions, insurers, and endowments, and is known for its deep credit expertise and niche sourcing capabilities. The firm combines bottom-up research with active risk management and focuses on generating consistent, income-driven returns.

company.name: Barings
company.description: Barings is a global investment management firm headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, managing investments across public and private markets. A subsidiary of MassMutual, the firm oversees strategies in credit, real estate, private equity, and multi-asset portfolios. Barings serves institutional clients such as pensions, endowments, and insurers, with a strong focus on credit and alternative investments. It operates across the Americas, Europe, and Asia, with a commitment to fundamental research and long-term asset stewardship.

company.name: Chartwell Financial Advisory
company.description: Chartwell Financial Advisory is a boutique investment banking firm that provides corporate finance services to middle market companies. Based in Minneapolis and founded in 1995, the firm specializes in mergers and acquisitions, private placement of debt and equity, and business valuations. Chartwell is known for its expertise in advising employee stock ownership plans and helping family owned businesses navigate complex ownership transitions. It focuses on providing independent financial advice and strategic planning to support long term growth and liquidity objectives for its clients.

company.name: Houlihan Lokey
company.description: Houlihan Lokey is a global investment bank headquartered in Los Angeles, specialising in M&A advisory, capital markets, financial restructuring, and valuation services. The firm is widely recognised for its leading role in middle-market transactions and has consistently ranked as the top global M&A advisor by volume. In restructuring, Houlihan Lokey is a dominant player, often advising both creditors and debtors on high-profile bankruptcies and distressed situations. It also has one of the largest dedicated financial valuation teams globally, supporting litigation, tax, and financial reporting mandates. With offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, the firm serves public and private companies, financial sponsors, and government entities. Houlihan Lokey’s sector coverage spans consumer, healthcare, tech, energy, and industrials, and it is particularly known for its rigorous analytics, high-touch advisory model, and long-term client relationships.

company.name: Stifel
company.description: Stifel Financial Corp. is a US-based financial services firm offering investment banking, brokerage, and wealth management to individuals and institutions. Headquartered in St. Louis, the firm has a growing global footprint and a strong reputation in middle-market advisory, equity research, and capital markets execution. Stifel’s investment banking division is particularly active in healthcare, technology, and industrials, while its private client group manages significant assets for individuals and family offices. The firm has grown through acquisitions and is known for its integrated approach across research, advisory, and execution.

company.name: Capula Investment Management
company.description: Capula Investment Management is a global alternative asset manager specialising in fixed income, macro, and absolute return strategies. Founded in 2005 and headquartered in London, the firm manages capital for institutional investors such as pension funds, endowments, and sovereign wealth funds. Capula’s investment strategies are often focused on interest rate and volatility trading, and it is known for operating with a disciplined, risk-managed approach. The firm also maintains offices in Tokyo, Hong Kong, and New York.

company.name: Tudor Group
company.description: Tudor Investment Corporation, often referred to as Tudor Group, is a US-based hedge fund founded by Paul Tudor Jones. The firm is known for its macro trading strategies, investing across currencies, commodities, interest rates, and equities based on global economic and geopolitical trends. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, Tudor manages capital for institutional investors and high-net-worth individuals. It has historically operated with a discretionary trading model, though it has expanded into quantitative strategies over time. Tudor remains one of the most well-known names in global macro investing.

It places strong emphasis on research, portfolio discipline, and sustainability integration.

OMERS is recognized for its significant direct investment capabilities and its focus on acquiring and growing high quality assets across international markets.

The firm has built a strong reputation for its access to founders, cultural relevance, and strategic execution in fast-evolving industries.

Global Atlantic combines actuarial expertise with investment acumen to support retirement security and institutional balance sheet optimisation.

company.description: Perella Weinberg Partners is an independent global advisory firm focused on M&A, financial restructuring, and strategic advisory for corporates, institutions, and governments. Headquartered in New York, with offices in London, Houston, San Francisco, and other financial centres, the firm is known for its senior-led model and focus on complex, high-stakes transactions. Its restructuring practice is one of the most prominent in the industry, advising clients through distressed and special situations, while its M&A practice regularly works on cross-border deals and board-level strategy. Perella Weinberg combines deep sector expertise with an emphasis on discretion and unbiased advice.

company.name: Millennium Management
company.description: Millennium Management is a global multi-manager hedge fund founded in 1989, operating a platform of independent investment teams across asset classes and geographies. Headquartered in New York, the firm manages over $60 billion in assets and allocates capital to hundreds of portfolio managers running diverse, often uncorrelated strategies. Millennium is known for its robust risk management, proprietary infrastructure, and intense focus on performance and discipline. The firm operates offices across the US, Europe, and Asia, and competes with other multi-manager funds such as Citadel and Point72. With a highly selective hiring process and rigorous oversight model, Millennium continues to be one of the most sought-after and closely watched firms in the hedge fund industry.

company.name: Shea & Company
company.description: Shea & Company is a boutique investment bank headquartered in Boston, focused exclusively on software and technology M&A. The firm advises private and public software companies, as well as private equity investors, on buy-side and sell-side transactions. With a research-driven approach and deep sector expertise, Shea & Company often supports vertical and horizontal consolidation plays, growth equity deals, and strategic exits. Its team is known for its disciplined execution and long-term client relationships, operating across enterprise software segments such as SaaS, infrastructure, security, and analytics.

company.name: Guggenheim Partners
company.description: Guggenheim Partners is a diversified global financial services firm offering investment management, investment banking, and insurance services, with over $300 billion in assets under management. Headquartered in New York and Chicago, Guggenheim serves institutional clients including pension funds, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, and governments. It is particularly known for its strength in fixed income and structured credit, and for developing innovative solutions in areas like infrastructure financing and private placements. Its investment banking division, Guggenheim Securities, provides M&A and capital markets advisory with a strong presence in healthcare, tech, and media. The firm combines a long-term, research-led investment philosophy with a flexible capital approach, and continues to expand its reach into alternative investments and sustainable finance.

company.name: Aberdeen Group
company.description: Aberdeen Group is a global investment company headquartered in the UK, offering asset management and financial planning services to a broad client base. The firm, previously known as Standard Life Aberdeen, rebranded in 2021 as part of a shift towards a more digital and modern identity. Aberdeen Group manages a wide range of investment strategies across asset classes, working with both institutional and individual investors.

company.name: Insight Partners
company.description: Insight Partners is a New York-based global venture capital and private equity firm that invests in high-growth technology and software companies. Founded in 1995, the firm has backed over 750 companies across stages and geographies, offering capital as well as operational support through its dedicated ScaleUp platform. Insight is particularly active in enterprise SaaS, cybersecurity, fintech, and dev tools, and is known for helping businesses accelerate growth, professionalise operations, and prepare for strategic exits. The firm takes both minority and control positions and is often a long-term partner throughout multiple funding rounds. With offices in North America and Europe, Insight has built a reputation for founder-friendly investing, data-driven decision-making, and deep expertise in scaling B2B software businesses into global leaders.

company.name: DV Trading
company.description: DV Trading is a multi-asset proprietary trading firm headquartered in Chicago, with additional offices in Toronto, London, and Singapore. The firm trades in global futures, options, fixed income, FX, and equities using a mix of quantitative models and discretionary execution. It supports its traders with in-house risk systems, technology infrastructure, and proprietary research tools. DV Trading is known for its agility, flat structure, and strong track record in volatile and fragmented markets, including energy and interest rate derivatives.

company.name: CohnReznick
company.description: CohnReznick is one of the largest advisory, assurance, and tax firms in the United States, offering a comprehensive suite of services. The firm provides audit, tax, and consulting solutions to businesses of all sizes, from emerging companies to large enterprises. CohnReznick serves a diverse range of industries, including real estate, private equity, healthcare, technology, and not for profit. It is known for its specialized industry knowledge, client centric approach, and integrated services designed to help clients navigate complex financial and operational challenges. The firm focuses on delivering strategic insights and practical advice to drive sustainable growth.

company.name: Cleveland Research Company
company.description: Cleveland Research Company is an independent investment research firm that provides equity analysis and proprietary market intelligence to institutional investors. Founded in 2006 and based in Cleveland, the firm focuses on gathering data from supply chains and industry participants to forecast trends in sectors like retail, technology, and industrials. It is known for its investigative approach and primary research model which seeks to identify inflection points before they are reflected in consensus estimates. The firm serves a diverse client base of hedge funds, mutual funds, and asset managers by delivering actionable insights through rigorous field research.

company.name: bp
company.description: BP is one of the world’s largest integrated energy companies, specialising in oil, natural gas, refining, and renewable energy. Founded in 1909 and headquartered in London, the company operates across every segment of the energy sector to supply fuel and power globally. BP is known for its extensive upstream and downstream operations, global distribution networks, and massive technical infrastructure. It combines traditional resource exploration with expanding investments in low-carbon energy transition projects and has a track record of managing large-scale industrial assets worldwide.

company.name: Maven Securities
company.description: Maven Securities is a proprietary trading firm based in London, specialising in options market-making and quantitative trading across global derivatives and equity markets. The firm operates on major exchanges in Europe, Asia, and the US, using advanced technology and data analytics to provide liquidity and capture short-term inefficiencies. Maven combines research, software development, and risk management in a flat, collaborative structure, attracting talent from both academia and industry. It trades a wide array of products, including ETFs, volatility instruments, and index options, and has a growing presence in crypto derivatives. The firm is known for its low-profile culture, fast-paced trading environment, and commitment to continuous improvement through experimentation and analysis.

company.name: Carr, Riggs & Ingram
company.description: Carr, Riggs & Ingram is a prominent accounting and advisory firm offering services in audit, tax, consulting, and wealth management. Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Enterprise, Alabama, the firm has grown into one of the largest certified public accounting practices in the United States through a focus on regional expansion. It serves a diverse range of clients across industries such as healthcare, construction, government, and manufacturing. The firm is recognized for combining the technical expertise of a large national practice with the personalized service and accessibility of a local office.

company.name: CIFC Asset Management
company.description: CIFC Asset Management is a leading alternative credit asset manager, specializing in sub-investment grade credit strategies. Founded in 2005 and based in New York, the firm manages capital for institutional investors globally. CIFC focuses primarily on leveraged finance markets, including collateralized loan obligations and opportunistic credit. It is known for its rigorous fundamental credit analysis, active management approach, and commitment to generating alpha. The firm leverages deep research capabilities and a disciplined investment process to identify value across the credit spectrum.

company.name: Ares Management
company.description: Ares Management is a global alternative investment firm headquartered in Los Angeles, managing assets across credit, private equity, real estate, and infrastructure. Founded in 1997, the firm has grown significantly, offering a range of strategies to institutional and retail investors. Ares is known for its scale in private credit and direct lending, and for investing across the capital structure of companies in North America, Europe, and Asia. Its integrated platform allows the firm to deploy capital across market cycles and evolving macro conditions.

company.name: Lead Edge Capital
company.description: Lead Edge Capital is a US-based growth equity firm that invests in technology-enabled businesses globally, with a focus on consumer internet, enterprise software, and digital infrastructure. Founded in 2009 and headquartered in New York, the firm has backed companies such as Alibaba, Spotify, Uber, Toast, and BlaBlaCar. Lead Edge is known for its network-driven investment model, leveraging a large group of operators, executives, and investors to source deals and support portfolio companies. The firm typically invests at the growth stage but maintains a flexible approach to deal structure and size. With a reputation for founder-friendly capital and active post-investment support, Lead Edge plays an influential role in helping high-growth businesses scale operations and expand into global markets.

company.name: Readystate
company.description: Readystate Asset Management is a unified, multi-strategy investment firm that invests across the full spectrum of financial assets. The firm applies research from a broad range of disciplines, building its investment process on a deep understanding of the relationship among credit, equity, and volatility. Readystate focuses on the full distribution of underlying asset values and the related evolution of firm liabilities. Its integrated approach to people, culture, and investment process drives its competitive advantage, supported by a multi-disciplinary team with extensive industry experience and a successful track record across asset classes and economic cycles.
